jobs.title: ASIC Design Engineering Manager, Lund
jobs.description:
Lead the Next Generation of ARTPEC™ Innovation! High-quality, innovative SoC/ASIC designs are critical to Axis's continued growth and future success. As we push the boundaries of cutting-edge technology with demanding requirements for low power, high performance, and security, we're expanding our ASIC department to meet the evolving challenges of next-generation data processing.

Latest news on Axis SoC: https://newsroom.axis.com/tag/artpec

What is Axis?
Axis is a fast growing and highly innovative company that offers intelligent security solutions. We are market leaders in network and surveillance cameras and are using this as the core around our solutions to create a safer and smarter world. Our success is largely due to our highly skilled staff and our strong culture of daring to succeed and allowing ourselves to constantly break new ground. The people here at Axis are innovative, dedicated and energetic and for us it is not just about creating products - we form and shape industry leading solutions giving highest values to our customers.

Now we are looking for a passionate leader to head our ASIC Design team.

What will I do?
As the Engineering Manager you will have overall responsibility for the ASIC Design team.

    You will lead, coach and develop a team of highly skilled ASIC and FPGA engineers, creating a collaborate environment for people to perform, grow and take ownership. You will build a strong and inclusive team culture, set clear expectations and priorities, and support both experienced experts and emerging talents in their development.
    You are comfortable leading highly experienced specialists and creating the arena for them to succeed. You know when to provide direction, when to challenge and when to step back and let the experts lead.
    You will work close with your project manager and the Technology department to develop the next generation of ARTPECs, driving strategic technical direction and ensuring alignment with our product roadmap and future vision.
    You will do the planning, budgeting, resource allocation and day-to-day operations, ensuring optimal team performance, project delivery, and efficient resource utilization across multiple complex ASIC development cycles.
    You will be part of dynamic and expanding management teams in the ASIC and in the Technology departments, contributing to strategic decision-making and shaping the future direction of hardware innovation at Axis.
    You will lead and support organizational, methodology and process development, spearheading advancements in our design methodologies, tools, and processes to maintain our cutting-edge capabilities and efficiency.
    You will participate in cross functional project steering groups representing the ASIC team and ensuring seamless integration and collaboration with broader product development initiatives.
    …and depending on your interests and ambitions maybe even more?

Who are we looking for?
We seek a visionary leader with a profound passion for both cutting-edge technology development and empowering high-performing engineering teams. You thrive on fostering a stimulating, creative, and collaborative environment.

With a track record in technically demanding landscapes, you confidently provide architectural oversight and strategic vision, successfully navigating the complexities of advanced R&D environments.

Parallel to managing your own team we want you to have an enthusiasm for active participation in our leadership team to drive strategic initiatives, cross-functional alignment, and foster a healthy, unified culture across the entire multi-site department.

You are an ambitious and initiative-taking person that has good leadership skills with the ability to motivate the people around you and visualize the direction going ahead.

You have previous experience leading engineering teams as a team lead, project manager or formal people management.

The ASIC Design team
Your team, the core of our ARTPEC innovation, is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing the sophisticated hardware modules that provide Axis with an undeniable competitive edge. We tackle complex challenges in real-time image processing, advanced video compression, and state-of-the-art computer vision, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in surveillance technology using the latest techniques and tools.

The team also hosts the competence center for FPGA design at Axis. The FPGA designers assist in technology selections, methodology setup as well as participating in exciting product projects.

The team takes pride in delivering top-quality work using the latest techniques.

What Axis has to offer
Axis is an organization that values creativity and promotes teamwork and openness. With us, you will grow both personally and professionally within areas such as:

    Impact: Influence the next generations of ARTPEC and technology that is at the heart of Axis' products.
    Leadership: Lead highly skilled engineers in a culture where expertise, innovation and collaboration are highly valued.
    Strategic exposure: Be part of management teams and contribute to decisions shaping the future direction of hardware development.
    Growth: Develop your leadership, organizational and strategic capabilities in a global technology company. We have both Leadership and Mentorship programs supporting you in your journey.
    Culture: Work in an open and collaborative environment with strong technical communities and opportunities to build relationships across the organization.

Ready to act?
Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. Would you like to grow with us?

Find out more from our recruiting Director Patrik Lislén on phone +46 46 272 1800.

We review applications continuously.

See you around!

jobs.title: Miljøterapaut/miljøarbeider medleverstillig
jobs.employer: HUMAN CARE AS AVD BPA NORD
jobs.description:
Vår avdeling i Tromsø har behov for flere miljøterapeuter og miljøarbeidere til medleverturnus 3/7/4/7, for å bygge et solid og faglig sterkt team for vår beboer.

I Humana jobber vi ut fra visjonen om at alle har rett til et godt liv. Ja, alle. Hver dag gjør våre ansatte en innsats som betyr alt for menneskene vi er her for. Som medlever hos oss blir du en helt avgjørende del av løsningen for enkeltmennesker og en uunnværlig partner for det offentlige.

Vi ser etter miljøterapeuter/miljøarbeidere som ønsker å være med å bygge rammene opp på nytt, skape trygghet og sikre faglig kvalitet i alle ledd. Robusthet er en egenskap du må kjenne deg igjen i. Hos oss handler ikke robusthet om å være hard. Det handler om å være rolig, tydelig, forutsigbar og profesjonell når krevende situasjoner oppstår. Det handler også om å se menneske bak atferden, være tro til tiltak vi har bestemt sammen, og ikke minst stå stødig også for dine kolleger. Får vi til dette kommer også de gode dagene, der ski, turer, matlaging og resturantbesøk er en del av hverdagen.

Dette er en mulighet for deg som har lyst til å bli utfordret, men motta store endringer i gevinst. Du må like å jobbe målrettet, og holde fokus på hvor vi skal. Du må like å samarbeide, tenke nytt sammen med andre, og ikke gi opp når vi ikke lykkes går på første forsøk.

I tillegg vil vi gjerne at du har:

  • Bachelor innen helse- og sosialfag.

  • Erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker med utviklingshemming/rus/psykiatri, kan kompensere for utdanning.

  • Arbeidet med håndtering av fysisk/verbal utagering

  • Stillingen krever gode norskferdigheter, og gode skriftlige ferdigheter, da journalføring og rapportering er en del av arbeidshverdagen.

  • Du må ha gyldig førerkort klasse B.

  • Godkjent politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse.

Hos oss blir du en del av et faglig sterkt miljø og en bærebjelke i samfunnet vårt. Vi har et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø preget av glede, med nært og stedlig lederskap. Du vil få mulighet til personlig utvikling, påvirkning av egen hverdag og interne karrieremuligheter i et av Norges største private velferdsselskaper. Vi tilbyr selvfølgelig også gode lønnsbetingelser samt pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: Lärare fritidshem
jobs.description:
Välkommen till den lilla och styrkebaserade kommunen med stora möjligheter!

Här har du chansen att bidra med samhällsviktiga tjänster, till de vi är till för, tillsammans med dina kollegor. Vi utgår ifrån friskfaktorer och har ett styrkebaserat förhållningssätt som fokuserar på människors samt organisationens styrkor. Det är också det vi kommunicerar och ger återkoppling på. Du ges hållbara arbetsvillkor, förutsättningar att växa och bidra till det kollegiala lärandet. Vi vägleds av utvecklingskraft, stolthet och medmänsklighet och det förväntar vi oss att du också gör.

Om verksamheten

Kinnareds skola är en trygg och familjär F-6-skola med cirka 100 elever. Tack vare skolans storlek får eleverna en nära relation till både lärare och andra vuxna på skolan, vilket skapar goda förutsättningar för trygghet, delaktighet och lärande. I vissa klasser undervisas flera årskurser tillsammans, vilket bidrar till gemenskap över åldersgränserna och ger eleverna möjlighet att utveckla både samarbete och ansvarstagande.

Skolan har en väl tilltagen och inspirerande utemiljö som erbjuder goda möjligheter till lek, rörelse och pedagogiska aktiviteter. Här finns bland annat en stor fotbollsplan, gungor och generösa grönytor som uppmuntrar till aktivitet, kreativitet och gemenskap. Närheten till naturen ger också fina möjligheter att använda utomhusmiljön som en naturlig del av undervisningen och fritidsverksamheten.

På Kinnareds skola strävar vi efter att skapa en trygg, utvecklande och inkluderande miljö där varje elev blir sedd och får möjlighet att nå sin fulla potential.

Arbetsuppgifter

Var med och utveckla Torup & Kinnareds rektorsområde tillsammans med engagerade och behöriga kollegor!

Som lärare i fritidshem hos oss ansvarar du för att planera, genomföra och utveckla verksamheten på fritidshemmet i nära samarbete med kollegor. Du skapar en trygg, stimulerande och meningsfull vardag där eleverna får möjlighet att utvecklas utifrån sina förutsättningar, behov och intressen.

I uppdraget ingår att planera, genomföra, följa upp och utvärdera det pedagogiska arbetet utifrån fritidshemmets och skolans styrdokument. Du arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med arbetslaget för att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för elevernas lärande och utveckling.

Du ansvarar även för rastverksamheten och bidrar aktivt till en trygg och inkluderande skolmiljö. Genom ett nära samarbete med övrig skolpersonal verkar du för en god lär- och arbetsmiljö för både elever och medarbetare. Du deltar också aktivt i skolans utvecklingsarbete och är med och stärker verksamhetens kvalitet och måluppfyllelse.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är utbildad lärare i fritidshem och som vill vara med och skapa en trygg, utvecklande och inspirerande miljö för våra elever.

Som person är du engagerad, ansvarstagande och har förmåga att se både individens och gruppens behov. Du skapar goda relationer och bidrar till ett positivt samarbetsklimat med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare. Du trivs med ett flexibelt arbetssätt och ser värdet av att ge elever inflytande och delaktighet i verksamheten.

Rollen innebär nära samarbete med rektor, vårdnadshavare och övrig personal. Därför är det viktigt att du har ett professionellt bemötande, god samarbetsförmåga och en tydlig kommunikativ förmåga. Vi söker dig som är lösningsorienterad, ser möjligheter i förändringar och bidrar med engagemang och utvecklingsvilja i verksamheten.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Krav för tjänsten

    Utbildning som lärare i fritidshem.
    God förmåga att skapa och utveckla relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor.
    Förmåga att arbeta både självständigt och i nära samarbete med andra.
    Ett flexibelt och lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt.
    Förmåga att skapa en trygg, inkluderande och stimulerande lärmiljö för alla elever.

Övrig information

Skollagen kräver att samtliga medarbetare inom verksamheter skola/förskola skall visa upp ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret innan anställning kan påbörjas. Handläggningstiden för att få detta dokument kan ta lång tid. Du beställer ett utdrag på polisen.se, https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/skola-eller-forskola/

Ansökan

Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningstiden. I denna rekryteringsprocess ansöker du enbart med CV. Vi tillämpar kompetensbaserad rekrytering med stöd i arbetsprover som urvalsmetod för att säkerställa en rättvis och träffsäker rekryteringsprocess.

jobs.title: HVDC System Design Engineer for backbone
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about engineering and problem solving? Maybe you are – or want to become – an expert within HVDC?  Then this opportunity is for you!  

We are currently looking for HVDC System Design Engineers. In this role you are responsible for the electrical design and functionality of HVDC converter stations, focusing on the high-voltage system, including main circuit design, insulation coordination and harmonic design.

This advertisement is for the backbone office within HVDC System Design department, where your main task is to support the project execution offices by improving base design and ways of working.

This role is based in Ludvika or Västerås, Sweden.

How you’ll make an impact

    Ensure the base design and engineering solutions used in the HVDC converter stations are modularized, robust, productified and useful for the current HVDC market.
    Ensure ways of working (study processes, base reports & models, design principles and design rules etc.) are up to date, simple to use, robust and useful for the project execution departments.
    Actively contribute in internal transformation projects and initiatives.
    Effectively participate in problem-solving discussions where you can present your work, discuss challenges and propose a path forward on a higher level.
    Write clear technical reports describing your complex work in a professional manner.
    Take responsibility for your work activities, deliver with quality and on time.
    Living Hitachi Energy core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business

Your background

    You hold a university degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with focus on Power Systems or Power Electronics.
    You have a general understanding of electrical power systems and its equipments.
    You encounter problems with a practical engineering mindset, understanding that models and calculations are estimations. But also, that input data could be arbitrary and that some requirements must be challenged and discussed to solve real problems.
    You are a team player with excellent communication and report writing skills.
    Fluent in English both written and verbal.
    Programming experience in MATLAB and Python, and experience of EMT tools like PSCAD is highly advantageous. Experience of working in Azure DevOps is also beneficial.
    Experience in high voltage system engineering, and especially within HVDC, is highly advantageous.

jobs.title: Geophysicist
jobs.description:
Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come.  

Geophysicist, Exploration Geophysics Department

Do you want to combine cutting-edge geophysics with real-world impact? Join a collaborative team of experts working at the forefront of mineral exploration and mining. Here, you'll tackle complex challenges, work with advanced technologies, and collaborate with colleagues and partners from around the world. If you're curious, proactive, and excited by both people and technology, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for!

Who you will work with

As a Geophysicist at the Exploration Geophysics department, you'll join an experienced and highly skilled team of geophysicists with diverse backgrounds and expertise. The team works closely with exploration geologists, exploration technicians, development engineers and external partners across several countries. You will be part of an international environment where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are key to success.

What you will do

    Your primary responsibilities will include planning and overseeing geophysical survey campaigns, as well as processing, quality assuring, and modelling geophysical data in line with Boliden's standards.
    You will analyse and interpret geophysical data to support mineral exploration projects and contribute to informed decision-making.
    You will communicate findings, recommendations, and insights to a variety of stakeholders across the business.
    You will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of geophysical methods, workflows, and best practices within the department.
    Collaboration is central to Boliden's culture. Through knowledge sharing and close teamwork, you will help solve complex exploration challenges and contribute to a positive and supportive working environment.

What you bring

    University degree in Geophysics, Geosciences.
    Professional experience in geophysics or geoscience disciplines.
    Experience in electromagnetic and potential field methods
    Experience with geophysical data QA/QC & processing, modelling, and interpretation with industry-standard software.
    Great teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate closely with a team of geophysicists and exploration geologists.
    Professional proficiency in English.
    A valid driver's license and ability to travel as required

It is an advantage if you have

    Knowledge of seismic methods.
    Extensive experience from mineral exploration.
    Experience of fieldwork and geophysical surveys.

Location

    The head office resides in the small town of Boliden, Sweden, but living options expand to several nearby villages, towns and cities. Relocation support for you and your family. Alternatively, the position can be based at one of our other exploration offices in Sweden: Garpenberg, Zinkgruvan, or Gällivare.

Why work with us

At Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a workplace where we believe in collaboration and where what you contribute will have a direct impact on future generations. We are a company made up of responsible and creative people all working towards the same vision; to become the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world.

jobs.title: Sökes till en ung kille i Alingsås
jobs.description:
Särnmark är ett av Sveriges äldsta företag inom personlig assistans och grundades av nuvarande ägare i början av 1990-talet. Vi arbetar med utgångspunkt i en tydlig och uttalad värdegrund och vår främsta drivkraft är att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för en individanpassad personlig assistans utifrån varje persons unika behov. Särnmark har idag över 3500 medarbetare och våra kunder och medarbetare finns över hela Sverige. Särnmarks huvudkontor ligger i Sundbyberg men vi har även kontor i andra delar i Sverige.

Vi söker nu personliga assistenter till kund som bor i Alingsås.

Om jobbet som personlig assistent

Som personlig assistent arbetar du nära en person med funktionsnedsättning i dennes dagliga liv. Du assisterar och stöttar personen både i vardagen och på fritiden. Din arbetsplats är där kunden befinner sig och dina arbetsuppgifter innebär övergripande att du assisterar kunden så att kunden får förutsättningar att leva det liv som hen önskar.

Arbetsuppgifter

Dina arbetsuppgifter beror på kundens behov och livsstil. De kan innebära allt ifrån personlig hygien, assistans vid förflyttningar, hushållarbete, matlagning till att assistera kunden på jobbet eller vid aktiviteter utanför hemmet.

Vi söker dig som:

Vi söker dig som är ansvarsfull, lyhörd och har lätt för att lära dig nya arbetsuppgifter. På Särnmark får du alltid introduktion hos kunden samt tillgång till utbildning om rollen som personlig assistent.

Är du en positiv, kreativ och engagerad person som tycker om att göra skillnad i någon annans vardag? Då kan det här vara jobbet för dig!

Vi söker nu timvikarier och fast tjänst till en härlig 24-årig kille, med goda möjligheter till några fasta pass.

Som personlig assistent blir du en viktig del av kundens vardag. Vi söker dig som är tålmodig, pålitlig, strukturerad och pedagogisk, med ett stort hjärta och en genuin vilja att skapa trygghet, glädje och utveckling.

Kunden tycker om musik, promenader och böcker, så det är ett stort plus om du delar eller uppskattar dessa intressen. Du har gärna nära till skratt, vågar bjuda på dig själv och tycker om att sjunga, skämta och hitta på roliga aktiviteter tillsammans. Ett barnasinne är en tillgång – så länge du samtidigt är ansvarstagande och professionell.

Vi söker dig som ser möjligheter istället för hinder och som vill bygga en långsiktig relation med kunden. Personlig lämplighet värderas mycket högt.

Arbetstider:

    09.00–19.15
    10.00–21.30

Arbetspassen är förlagda både vardagar och helger.

Känner du igen dig i beskrivningen? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig!

Om anställningen

Anställningsformen är För viss tid så länge assistansuppdraget varar och löneformen är timlön. Arbestiderna varierar utifrån kundens behov: dag, kväll, natt (aktiv samt jour), vardag som helg.

Lön och övriga anställningsvillkor enligt kollektivavtal Personlig assistans, Vårdföretagarna - Kommunal.

Så här ansöker du

Du ansöker genom att klicka på knappen "ansök" längst ned till höger på sidan och svara på ett antal urvalsfrågor. Du ska även bifoga ditt CV. Du behöver inte bifoga något personligt brev.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

I din ansökan ska du ange medborgarskap. Om du inte är medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz måste du kunna styrka att du har ett permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige för att kunna få anställning i Särnmark. Om du söker arbete som personlig assistent hos en vuxen kund behöver du uppvisa ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Du beställer registerutdraget via Polisens hemsida, här: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/arbete-i-hemmet-med-aldre-och-personer-med-funktionsnedsattning-e-tjanst/ Om du söker arbete som personlig assistent hos ett barn som är under 18 år behöver du också kunna uppvisa ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret innan du får börja arbeta. Du beställer registerutdraget via Polisens hemsida, här: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/barn-med-funktionsnedsattning/

jobs.title: Trygg, kreativ og strukturert? Da kan du være assistenten jeg ser etter 🌸
jobs.description:
Hei! 😊

Jeg er en kreativ og bestemt dame på 36 år som bor i Eidsberg i Indre Østfold. Jeg elsker gaming, matlaging og baking, dyrking av planter, sesong-pynting og alt som handler om orden, system og gode rutiner. Jeg har mange hobbyer og prosjekter, og en god dose galgenhumor som følger meg gjennom dagene.

Jeg har et sammensatt sykdomsbilde, er delvis sengeliggende og har nedsatt immunforsvar. Formen varierer mye, og jeg trenger derfor en assistent som kan bidra til at hverdagen min blir trygg, stabil og håndterbar. Noen dager er rolige og krever mye hvile, mens andre dager gir rom for mer aktivitet og prosjekter.

Stilling og arbeidstid

Jeg søker nå en fast assistent til 6t i uken (1 vakt i uken, hvilken dag avtales nærmere mellom oss) samt 1 tilkallingsvikar. Fra januar 2027 vil det også være mulighet for å gå inn i et vikariat i større stilling.

Det er et pluss at du har fleksibilitet i forhold til arbeidstidene, da bistandsbehovet mitt varierer med dagsformen min. Det er også en fordel om du kan ta ekstra vakter i ferier, ved sykdom og ellers ved behov.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Husarbeid og rengjøring (jeg verdsetter god hygiene og orden)

  • Matlaging og tilrettelegging

  • Hjelp til trening/ tøying

  • Handling og ærender

  • Bistand til avtaler og transport

  • Bistand med personlig hygiene

  • Bistand og støtte ved forflytning

  • Organisering og struktur i hjemmet

  • Tilrettelegging i hverdagen etter dagsform

  • Avlastning for ektefelle

  • Støtte til å kunne delta mer sosialt og utenfor hjemmet når helsen tillater det

Personlige egenskaper

  • Selvstendig og trygg

  • Tålmodig og rolig

  • Lærevillig og fleksibel

  • Komfortabel med både rolige og mer aktive dager (forståelse for variert funksjon)

  • God kjemi og trygghet er avgjørende

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Førerkort og trygg på å kjøre stor bil (Sprinter)

  • Kan forstå og snakke Norsk på en god måte

  • Er ikke allergisk samt trygg med håndtering av hund og katt- jeg har to små hunder og to katter

  • Det er en fordel med erfaring, men ikke et krav

  • Det er fordel med egen bil, da kollektivtilbudet er begrenset der jeg bor.

Grunnet stillingens art oppfordres kvinner til å søke.

Jeg ser etter en person som ønsker å være en stabil del av hverdagen min, som møter meg med respekt, forståelse og humor, og som ser mennesket bak sykdommen. Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i dette, håper jeg du søker – jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg.

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Hanna Brurås på epost: hanna.bruras@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 225,40,-, kveldstillegg på 60,- og helgetillegg på 57,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Residential Care Worker
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Are you passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of children? Do you thrive in a dynamic and supportive work environment? We have the perfect opportunity for you! Join our team at Ashdale Care (Ireland), on our journey to transform the lives of young people with complex, emotional and behavioural needs. No two days are the same here in Ashdale Care, this job description is designed to be flexible and adaptable, providing guiding principles for the work rather than strict limitations. It will undergo periodic review to ensure alignment with evolving organisational needs. You will be part of a unique team who will work together to facilitate excellent practice and be part of rebuilding children’s lives. Our vision is for every young person who lives with us to experience a safe, happy and nurturing present and a future that is filled with hope and optimism. Cultivate genuine and caring connections with the young people, always interact with the young people and their families with dignity and respect, promoting a culture of unconditional positive regard. Contribute to the promotion, creation, and maintenance of a welcoming, safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment. Advocate for the rights and responsibilities of each young person while promoting physical, emotional, social, cultural, ethnic, and spiritual wellbeing. Ensure that young people are not subjected to any forms of abuse and report any concerns according to policy and procedures. Supervise outings from the home and undertake daily household activities such as cooking and cleaning, as part of positive modelling. Actively participate in working within the Model of Therapeutic Care. Be physically able to support with challenging behaviours when needed. Provide emotional support during difficult or stressful times and encourage young people's participation in care planning, placement planning, decision-making and service delivery. Integrate understanding of youth trauma and past experiences into practice through specialised training such as Developmental Trauma and Attachment from the Therapeutic Support Team. Collaborate with support networks, including social workers and educators, guardians and family members. Collaborate effectively within a team, engaging in regular communication through daily handovers, team meetings, and various reviews and planning sessions. Give and receive feedback on performance with colleagues and managers. Maintain consistency in execution of childcare plans. Complete and maintain accurate records and reports for each young person in line with statutory requirements and Ashdale Care policies and procedures. Take on key worker duties including the handling of daily petty cash, accurately documenting receipts, securely storing money and valuable items and serving as a primary point of contact for professionals/family/young person.

jobs.title: Fantastiskt mysiga och drivna assistenter sökes till  ung kille i Alingsås
jobs.description:
Särnmark är ett av Sveriges äldsta företag inom personlig assistans och grundades av nuvarande ägare i början av 1990-talet. Vi arbetar med utgångspunkt i en tydlig och uttalad värdegrund och vår främsta drivkraft är att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för en individanpassad personlig assistans utifrån varje persons unika behov. Särnmark har idag över 3500 medarbetare och våra kunder och medarbetare finns över hela Sverige. Särnmarks huvudkontor ligger i Sundbyberg men vi har även kontor i andra delar i Sverige.

Vi söker nu personliga assistenter till kund som bor i Alingsås.

Om jobbet som personlig assistent

Som personlig assistent arbetar du nära en person med funktionsnedsättning i dennes dagliga liv. Du assisterar och stöttar personen både i vardagen och på fritiden. Din arbetsplats är där kunden befinner sig och dina arbetsuppgifter innebär övergripande att du assisterar kunden så att kunden får förutsättningar att leva det liv som hen önskar.

Arbetsuppgifter

Dina arbetsuppgifter beror på kundens behov och livsstil. De kan innebära allt ifrån personlig hygien, assistans vid förflyttningar, hushållarbete, matlagning till att assistera kunden på jobbet eller vid aktiviteter utanför hemmet.

Vi söker dig som:

Är du en positiv, kreativ och engagerad person som tycker om att göra skillnad i någon annans vardag? Då kan det här vara jobbet för dig!

Vi söker nu timvikarier och fast tjänst till en härlig 24-årig kille.

Som personlig assistent blir du en viktig del av kundens vardag. Vi söker dig som är tålmodig, pålitlig, strukturerad och pedagogisk, med ett stort hjärta och en genuin vilja att skapa trygghet, glädje och utveckling.

Kunden tycker om musik, promenader och böcker, så det är ett stort plus om du delar eller uppskattar dessa intressen. Du har gärna nära till skratt, vågar bjuda på dig själv och tycker om att sjunga, skämta och hitta på roliga aktiviteter tillsammans. Ett barnasinne är en tillgång – så länge du samtidigt är ansvarstagande och professionell.

Vi söker dig som ser möjligheter istället för hinder och som vill bygga en långsiktig relation med kunden. Personlig lämplighet värderas mycket högt.

Arbetstider:

    09.00–19.15
    10.00–21.30

Arbetspassen är förlagda både vardagar och helger.

Känner du igen dig i beskrivningen? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig!

Om anställningen

Anställningsformen är För viss tid så länge assistansuppdraget varar och löneformen är timlön. Arbestiderna varierar utifrån kundens behov: dag, kväll, natt (aktiv samt jour), vardag som helg.

Lön och övriga anställningsvillkor enligt kollektivavtal Personlig assistans, Vårdföretagarna - Kommunal.

Så här ansöker du

Du ansöker genom att klicka på knappen "ansök" längst ned till höger på sidan och svara på ett antal urvalsfrågor. Du ska även bifoga ditt CV. Du behöver inte bifoga något personligt brev.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

I din ansökan ska du ange medborgarskap. Om du inte är medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz måste du kunna styrka att du har ett permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige för att kunna få anställning i Särnmark. Om du söker arbete som personlig assistent hos en vuxen kund behöver du uppvisa ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Du beställer registerutdraget via Polisens hemsida, här: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/arbete-i-hemmet-med-aldre-och-personer-med-funktionsnedsattning-e-tjanst/ Om du söker arbete som personlig assistent hos ett barn som är under 18 år behöver du också kunna uppvisa ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret innan du får börja arbeta. Du beställer registerutdraget via Polisens hemsida, här: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/barn-med-funktionsnedsattning/

jobs.title: Instandhaltungstechniker (m/w/d) Teilzeit oder Werkstudent:in
jobs.description:
Du möchtest nicht irgendeine Anlage warten, sondern eine Technologie betreuen, die es so weltweit kein zweites Mal gibt? ⚡

Unser Kunde ist ein schnell wachsendes GreenTech Startup, das eines der weltweit ersten skalierbaren Straßenkraftwerke entwickelt. Die Technologie nutzt bestehende Straßeninfrastruktur, um aus dem darüberfahrenden Verkehr erneuerbare Energie zu gewinnen, ohne dafür zusätzliche Flächen zu benötigen.

Als Instandhaltungstechniker in Hamburg übernimmst du die technische Betreuung des dort installierten Straßenkraftwerks. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Anlage zuverlässig läuft, führst Wartungen und Reparaturen durch und gehst technischen Störungen systematisch auf den Grund.

Dabei übernimmst du nicht einfach bestehende Abläufe. Da es sich um eine völlig neue Technologie handelt, gestaltest du aktiv mit, wie Wartung, Service und Instandhaltung zukünftig aufgebaut werden. Deine Erfahrungen aus dem laufenden Betrieb fließen damit direkt in die weitere Entwicklung der Serviceprozesse ein.

Aufgaben

Als Instandhaltungstechniker bist du für den zuverlässigen technischen Betrieb des Straßenkraftwerks in Hamburg mitverantwortlich.

  • Wartung & Instandhaltung: Inspiziere und warte die Anlage über Mechanik, Hydraulik und Elektrik hinweg und kümmere dich unter anderem um die Pflege des Hydrauliköls.
  • Störungsbehebung: Analysiere technische Probleme, behebe Fehler und dokumentiere neben der Lösung auch die jeweilige Ursache.
  • Serviceaufbau: Erstelle und entwickle Wartungspläne, Ersatzteillisten und technische Servicedokumentationen für die Anlage.
  • Ersatzteilmanagement: Behalte die vor Ort gelagerten Ersatzteile im Blick und stelle deren strukturierte Verwaltung sicher.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst einen technischen Hintergrund in Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Energietechnik oder eine vergleichbare technische Ausbildung mit.
  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der mechanischen Wartung und Instandsetzung technischer Anlagen.
  • Du verfügst über ein solides Verständnis von hydraulischen Systemen und kannst technische Zusammenhänge selbstständig nachvollziehen.
  • Du bist für 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche verfügbar und bringst die Flexibilität mit, gelegentlich auch früh, spät oder am Wochenende zu arbeiten, wenn für Arbeiten am Terminal entsprechende Zeitfenster zur Verfügung stehen.
  • Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, arbeitest selbstständig und behältst auch bei technischen Problemen einen ruhigen Kopf.
  • Du arbeitest gerne direkt an der Anlage und im Freien und fühlst dich auch in einem aktiven Verkehrs- und Logistikumfeld wohl.
  • Das sichere Lesen von technischen Zeichnungen, Hydraulikschaltplänen und Elektroschaltplänen ist von Vorteil.

Benefits

  • Einzigartige Technologie: Betreue das weltweit erste Straßenkraftwerk im laufenden Betrieb und arbeite an einer GreenTech Technologie, die es in dieser Form bisher nirgendwo sonst gibt.
  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Baue gemeinsam mit dem Team Wartungspläne, Serviceprozesse und Instandhaltungsstrukturen auf, anstatt lediglich bestehende Abläufe zu übernehmen.
  • Flexible Teilzeit: Arbeite 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit einem Studium oder anderen Verpflichtungen verbinden lassen.
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Übernimm die technische Betreuung der Anlage in Hamburg und erhalte viel Freiraum bei Wartung, Fehleranalyse und Instandhaltung.
  • Entwicklungsperspektive: Entwickle dich gemeinsam mit der Technologie weiter und übernimm mit wachsender Erfahrung zusätzliche Verantwortung für Betrieb und Service.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Erhalte eine attraktive Bezahlung auf Verhandlungsbasis, abgestimmt auf deine Qualifikation und praktische Erfahrung.

Du möchtest eine weltweit einzigartige GreenTech Anlage nicht nur warten, sondern aktiv mitgestalten, wie ihr zukünftiger Betrieb und Service aufgebaut werden? ⚡

Dann sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und erfahre in einem kurzen 10-minütigen Kennenlerngespräch mehr über das Unternehmen, die Technologie und deine zukünftige Rolle.

jobs.description:
Der Caritasverband Rheine e. V. sucht eine Leitung (m/w/d) der Abteilung "Arbeit, Wohnen und Teilhabe", unbefristet in Vollzeit.

Die Caritas Rheine setzt sich als einer der größten Arbeitgeber der Region mit rund 50 sozialen Einrichtungen und Diensten für Menschen ein, die Unterstützung benötigen. Das umfangreiche Angebotsportfolio des Komplexträgers erstreckt sich über die Bereiche Familie, Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, Gefährdeten- und Eingliederungshilfe, Hilfe für suchterkrankte sowie psychisch kranke Menschen, ambulante und stationäre Pflege sowie Migration und Integration. Insgesamt stehen rund 1.800 hauptamtliche Mitarbeitende sowie etwa 500 ehrenamtlich Engagierte den Menschen mit ihren individuellen Bedürfnissen zur Seite.

Die Abteilung Arbeit, Wohnen und Teilhabe des Caritasverbandes Rheine e. V. begleitet Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Unterstützungs- oder Beratungsbedarfen. Menschen mit Behinderungen oder psychischen Erkrankungen befähigen wir, ihr Leben selbstbestimmt zu gestalten und aktiv am gesellschaftlichen Leben teilzuhaben. Mit den Caritas-Emstor-Werkstätten werden vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Teilhabe, Qualifizierung und persönlichen Entwicklung geschaffen. Im Jacob-Meyersohn-Wohnverbund unterstützen wir Menschen mit Behinderungen durch ambulante Angebote sowie in verschiedenen Wohnformen. Die Fachbereiche Ambulante Dienste und Existenzsicherung sowie Sozialpsychiatrische Dienste bieten Menschen in unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen umfassende Unterstützung. Dazu gehören unter anderem Wohnangebote in Gruppenform, Ambulant Betreutes Wohnen, psychosoziale Beratung, gesetzliche Betreuung sowie das Sozialkaufhaus. Im Haus St. Antonius in Bevergern erhalten Erwachsene mit psychischen Erkrankungen im Rahmen medizinischer Rehabilitationsmaßnahmen die Möglichkeit, neue Perspektiven zu entwickeln.

Aufgaben

  • Regionale und überregionale Netzwerkarbeit

Qualifikation

  • Wünschenswert sind mehrjährige Erfahrungen in leitender Funktion
  • Erfahrung in der Organisationsentwicklung und Gestaltung von Prozessen
  • Fachkompetenz in der Sozialwirtschaft und Kenntnisse in der Sozialgesetzgebung und dem Bundesteilhabegesetz
  • Ausgeprägte betriebswirtschaftliche Kompetenz sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln
  • Hohes Engagement, sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Belastbarkeit und Durchsetzungsvermögen
  • Motivierende, teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit pragmatischer und ergebnisorientierter Herangehensweise

Benefits

  • Interessantes, abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet in verantwortungsvoller Stellung mit Gestaltungsfreiraum
  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung und einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz bei einem zukunftsorientierten Arbeitgeber
  • Ein erfahrenes und multiprofessionelles Team
  • Übertarifliche Vergütung und verzinste Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (KZVK Köln)
  • Förderung der beruflichen sowie persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Wertschätzendes und mitarbeiterorientiertes Betriebsklima

  • Flexible Mobilitätsangebote wie vergünstigtes Jobticket, Dienstrad-Leasing („caribike“) und die Möglichkeit zur Überlassung eines Dienstfahrzeugs

jobs.title: Scrum Master
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about Agile delivery and empowering teams to achieve their full potential? We are looking for a Scrum Master to lead and support high-performing cross-functional teams, facilitating Agile ceremonies, removing impediments, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. In this role, you will collaborate closely with product owners, developers, architects, and business stakeholders to drive successful delivery, strengthen Agile maturity, and ensure teams remain focused on delivering exceptional business value in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

·        Lead the scrum team using Agile methodology and Scrum practices;

·        Facilitate Scrum ceremonies and ensure meetings are effective and outcome-driven;

·        Remove impediments and coach the team to address blockers independently;

·        Track delivery progress against timelines and communicate status transparently;

·        Raise, log, communicate, and escalate risks and issues as needed;

·        Partner with product owners to maintain backlog health and manage scope;

·        Collect, analyze, and report delivery metrics to support continuous improvement;

·        Coordinate day-to-day activities to keep the team focused and aligned on priorities;

·        Manage stakeholders and set clear expectations around delivery and change;

·        Resolve conflicts and support constructive team communication;

·        Improve Agile adoption by introducing best practices and reinforcing discipline;

·        Provide coaching and training to help the team reach higher Scrum maturity

Requirements:

·        Scrum Master experience leading Agile teams with complex dependencies;

·        Leadership skills to guide teams through delivery and maturity improvements;

·        Project coordination skills to track scope, timelines, and cross-team commitments;

·        Strong Agile and Waterfall knowledge and practical application experience;

·        Risk management skills to identify, communicate, and escalate delivery risks;

·        People management skills to mentor, coach, and support team performance;

jobs.title: Residential Care Worker
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Job Title: Residential Care Worker Reporting to: Social Care Leader, Social Care Manager and Service Manager. Purpose: To provide high-quality care to young people resident in Pathways Ireland and support the management team in the delivery of a safe, stable and therapeutic service. Key Duties and Responsibilities: •Work as part of a team to provide high-quality care and support to young people. •Promote and uphold the rights, dignity, welfare and best interests of young people. •Contribute to a safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment. •Support the implementation and development of care plans and programmes of care. •Support young people’s physical, emotional, educational, social and recreational development. •Develop young people’s personal, interpersonal, social and problem-solving skills. •Plan and participate in suitable recreational, community and educational activities and supervise outings. •Facilitate young people to participate actively in their own care. •Engage appropriately with young people in community and family settings. •Complete required risk assessments for activities in line with company policy. •Maintain accurate and confidential records, files and reports, including reports for reviews and case conferences. •Report accidents, incidents, complaints, allegations and other relevant developments to management and complete required documentation. •Work collaboratively with colleagues and support the effective delivery of care. •Attend staff meetings, supervision, training and induction as required. •Follow all organisational policies, procedures and health and safety requirements. •Contribute to maintaining high standards of hygiene, cleanliness and safety within the centre. •Promote positive links with families, schools, community organisations, local services and An Garda Síochána. •Administer and accurately account for centre monies. •Support adequate staffing levels and carry out other duties as directed by the Centre Manager. Essential Qualifications: Applicants must hold one of the following: QQI Level 7 in Psychology, Youth & Community, Social Science/Studies, Family Support, Disability Studies, Applied Behavioural Analysis or Early Years Care; QQI Level 7/professional qualification in Child & Adolescent Psychotherapy, Counselling/Psychotherapy or Addiction Counselling; professional qualification in Teaching (excluding TEFL) or Nursing Studies; BA in Applied Policing or equivalent; or Higher Certificate in Custodial Care (Irish Prison Service) or equivalent. Skills and Competencies: Knowledge of child development, behaviour management, attachment, leadership and childcare legislation. Strong communication, interpersonal, reflective practice and report-writing skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team, remain calm in crisis situations, support colleagues and build positive relationships with young people. Computer, counselling and recreational skills required.

jobs.title: Junior elektromonteur/ elektrotechnicus
jobs.description:
Over jou en deze functie
Opzoek naar een rol waarin je kunt groeien binnen de Industriële elektrotechniek? We zijn opzoek naar een Junior elektromonteur/ elektrotechnicus ter ondersteuning van ons team in Terneuzen, Nederland.

ls onderdeel van het maintenance team voor de LDPE en de Dowlex fabriek, bied je expertise op gebied van Elektro & Instrumentatie (E&I). Je voert preventief en correctief onderhoud uit aan een breed scala aan apparatuur binnen de vastgestelde technische expertise.

Verantwoordelijkheden

  • Uitvoeren van preventief en correctief onderhoud aan elektrische, instrumentatie- en procesinstallaties.

  • Opsporen, analyseren en verhelpen van storingen om een veilige en betrouwbare productie te waarborgen.

  • Inspecteren, kalibreren, testen en afstellen van meet- en regelapparatuur.

  • Ondersteunen bij de voorbereiding, planning en uitvoering van onderhoudswerkzaamheden, inclusief het beheren van benodigde onderdelen.

  • Samenwerken met operators, technici en andere onderhoudscollega's om installaties continu te verbeteren en de betrouwbaarheid van apparatuur te verhogen.

Kwalificaties

  • NL: Minimaal een MBO-4 diploma in een technische richting, bij voorkeur elektrotechniek/ elektronica of instrumentatie OF een MBO-3 diploma in een technische richting plus minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring.

  • BE: Minimaal een TSO diploma in een technische richting, bij voorkeur elektrotechniek/ elektronica of instrumentatie OF een BSO diploma in een technische richting plus minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring.

  • Vloeiend in het Nederlands en basiskennis van de Engelse taal.

Vaardigheden

  • Probleemoplossend vermogen - Vaardigheid om de oorzaak van problemen te onderzoeken en effectieve oplossingen te vinden.

  • Onderhoudsvaardigheden - kennis van preventief en correctief onderhoud aan elektrische systemen.

  • Mechanische vaardigheden - Basisvaardigheden in mechanisch werk om in de fabriek te kunnen helpen.

  • Communicatie vaardigheden - goede communicatie binnen de plant om op een duidelijke manier terug te koppelen hoe de problemen zijn verholpen

jobs.title: Business Controller, Purchasing & Finance
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will step into a role where finance and purchasing meet. In this assignment, you help a global company in industrial and marine solutions make better financial decisions across purchasing strategy, supplier investments, and business development. You work closely with purchasing, central Finance, and Business Control, which gives you broad exposure to both operational questions and longer-term planning.

This role suits you if you enjoy turning numbers into clear business guidance and want to influence decisions in a cross-functional environment with many stakeholders. It is an interesting opportunity because you get to combine classic controlling with purchasing-related analysis, business cases, and improvement work in a broad business setting.

Job Description

    You drive monthly closing analyses, reporting, and follow-up of KPIs and performance indicators.
    You prepare estimates, forecasts, and scenario analyses that support business and purchasing decisions.
    You analyze investments linked to vendor tooling, capacity, risk, and resourcing.
    You provide financial input to investigations, improvement initiatives, and purchasing-related projects.
    You handle supplier invoice-related issues and help resolve deviations.
    You build and evaluate business cases, including material cost assessments and financial impact analyses.
    You support buyers and project managers with guidance on financial processes, routines, and ways of working.
    You contribute to additional purchasing-related topics such as regulatory follow-up and special projects when needed.

Requirements

    Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
    2 to 5 years of experience in a Business Controller role.
    Strong knowledge of finance systems such as SAP, Essbase, or equivalent.
    Advanced skills in Excel, Power BI, and Microsoft 365.
    Fluent English, both written and spoken.
    Ability to complete a background check before start.

Nice to have

    Experience within Purchasing.
    Experience from the Automotive industry.
    You are comfortable working independently, communicating financial insights clearly, and challenging existing processes in a constructive way.
    You enjoy continuous improvement and collaboration across finance, strategy, sustainability, process development, and digitalization.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

jobs.title: Junior Analytical Technician
jobs.description:
The Analytical Center of Excellence (ACE) organization is looking for a Junior Analytical Technician (full shift) in the Chemicals lab located in Terneuzen, The Netherlands.

The Chemicals lab in is one of the Manufacturing Production Quality (MPQ) labs that performs analysis of plant-samples in Terneuzen. Servings multiple production plants such as polyurethanes and polyglycols results in the need for a 24/7 service and a full-shift roster to perform the analysis of all plant samples.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure service requests are accurately run, and the data returned as per sample plan.
  • Analytical equipment operations and troubleshooting as per procedures.
  • Provide input of quality data into LIMS, document and communicate results.
  • Perform calibration and first line-maintenance of analytical equipment. Document/administrate these maintenance activities. Communicate maintenance work when required.
  • Apply Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S), Analytical Work Process and Operating Discipline/Quality System procedures and practices as well as cGMP/pharma standards.
  • Participating in and completing of laboratory training and corporate required trainings.
  • Co-operate and communicate with co-workers and clients to maintain workflow and instrumental information, and to share and leverage problem solving and prevention expertise.
  • Contribute to value creation by continuous improvement of procedures in the analytical work processes and related tools and performance metrics.
  • Promote a well-organized, responsive, efficient workplace and work well both as a team member and independently.

Qualifications

  • MBO-4 laboratory degree or similar (bachelors degree preferred).
  • Fluent in Dutch and English.
  • Experience in an industrial laboratory (analytical)
  • Able to work in full shift (24/7 roster): morning, afternoon and night shifts.

Preferred qualifications

  • GMP/pharma experience.
  • Experience in operation, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting of analytical equipment.
  • Knowledge of quality data systems like LIMS, OpenLab, etc.
  • Good lab techniques, methodical record keeping, and the ability to work both independently and with co-workers.
  • Excellent human relations, organizational and communication skills are necessary to communicate with team members, partners and outside customers.
  • Exhibit confidence in confirming validity of methods and data.
  • Able to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure.

jobs.title: Product Engineer - Frontend (all genders)
jobs.description:
In a nutshell

koppla is building the next-gen collaborative scheduling platform for construction, helping project managers keep projects on time by identifying delays and disruptions before they impact timelines.

We are looking for a product-minded Frontend Engineers in Berlin that loves building actual products while taking ownership of the entire feature-building process. You will be mostly working on our TypeScript codebases, starting on the frontend, but excited to grow into a full stack role with us.

Compensation: €65k-90k + 25% of your base salary in equity on top
Location: Berlin (Hybrid, 2+ days/week in office); open for candidates willing to relocate to Berlin


About koppla

At koppla, we're a fun and ambitious team on a mission to help the construction industry build more efficiently. We're already partnering with top construction companies and delivering impressive results for our customers (multi-months speed-ups discovered through koppla).

Our ambitions are backed by leading VCs (Earlybird, Newion) and industry angels as we tackle a billion-dollar opportunity problem in an underdigitized and underserved market.

Our culture is core to who we are and we've built one we're genuinely proud of. We are not looking for hypergrowth - we believe in hiring slowly to create an environment of few but very high-performing team members that build a truly great product (similar to Netflix, Ashby or Linear).


What you'll be doing

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers and engineers to design and implement new features in a truly cross-functional process.
  • Build and maintain user-facing parts (in Vue) as well as backend services and APIs 
  • Contribute to the overall architecture of the entire system
  • Collaborate with and learn from senior engineers to implement best practices for software development, infrastructure, and deployment processes. Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers while learning from more experienced engineers.
Our Tech Stack: 
  • Frontend: Typescript, Vue 3, Tailwind, Netlify, GH Actions 
  • Backend: Typescript, AWS, NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, REST, Websockets, Terraform, GH Actions


Who we're looking for

This role is perfect for a Frontend/Full Stack Engineer with 2-5 years of experience looking to grow their skills and make a meaningful impact at a company that is approaching product-market fit (> €2.5M ARR). You are likely a great fit if:

  • You believe in quality and want to build the best possible experience for our end users - because you care about them.
  • You have solid engineering fundamentals, write clean and efficient code, and are eager to continue elevating your skills.
  • You are focussed on FE, but flexible to switch to BE depending on the task - it could be 50/50 at times but also 80/20 if needed. In the long run you want to become full stack
  • You understand how to balance technical trade-offs and can contribute to discussions about scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, enjoy taking ownership of your tasks, and stay proactive and pragmatic in solving challenges.

Beyond the role-specific requirements, you also see your own values reflected in our Culture Playbook.


What we offer

  • A company of co-owners through tax-optimized equity grants.
  • A culture with a focus on transparency, respect, ownership, collaboration and the well-being of each team member on this exciting journey.
  • An environment that values hard-work while still allowing work-life/family integration through 28 days PTO, flexible working hours, workation and a hybrid setup.
  • Dog-friendly with free lunch, besides beverages and snacks as well as a home office budget at start.
  • And more: Annual personal training budget of 1,500€ (FTE), Company supported pension Scheme (”BAV”, 30% contribution), Urban Sports Club Membership, Home Office budget and more.

Are you a passionate Senior Software Developer (m/f/d), who wants every single one of your changes to make hundreds of engineering hours faster and more reliable? At Checkmk, the Build & Test Platform is not plumbing, it is a product with developers as its users.

As our new Senior Developer (m/f/d) for our Build & Test Platform, your mission will be to design and build the Bazel-based build and test architecture that carries Checkmk's growth. We have ambitious and growing goals as a company, and that directly shapes our engineering environment. More developers, more tests, higher quality standards: the demands on our platform will keep increasing, year over year.   • Build architecture: Own and evolve our Bazel setup across several concurrently maintained product versions. Drive hermeticity, sane dependency boundaries, and toolchain management, and plan migrations that improve the architecture without blocking the developers who depend on it every day.
  • Make it fast: Turn build and test times into something you measure and then attack. Remote caching and execution, cache hit rates and a good Pipeline architecture.
  • Automation and developer experience: From build and release tooling to the diagnostics that let a developer understand a failure on their own.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the product teams who use the platform, with QA, and with the rest of CI. Understand how developers really work and turn their pain points into a technical roadmap.


Your profile

jobs.title: Regulatory Specialist
jobs.description:
Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world's largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Are you ready to help shape the regulatory foundation for one of Europe's most exciting space initiatives?

If you answer yes to this question, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as Regulatory Specialist within our Business Area Orbital Launch & Rocket Test. We are looking for a dedicated person who shares our core values of Customer Passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity and Courage.  

As Regulatory Specialist, you will join the team supporting the regulatory and licensing activities connected to SSC Space’s orbital launch ambitions and launch services. In this role, you will contribute to license applications, regulatory analysis and the continued development of processes for future launch operations. You will have the opportunity to develop your expertise within the team and gradually take on greater responsibility.

We believe you have:

    A university degree in Law, Political Science, Public Administration, International Relations, European Studies or a related field.
    Up to three years of relevant professional experience, or have recently graduated with strong academic credentials and a clear interest in regulatory affairs.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Swedish and English.
    Strong analytical and documentation skills with the ability to translate complex requirements into practical actions and decision material.  
    An interest in legislation, licensing, compliance and international regulatory frameworks.
    A structured, proactive and collaborative approach, with the ability to work independently while coordinating multiple stakeholders.

Experience within aerospace, defence, export control, government authorities, compliance or other regulated industries is considered an advantage but is not required.

In this role you will:

    Coordinate regulatory and licensing activities related to SSC Space orbital launch ambitions and launch services.
    Prepare, manage and follow up license applications for launch vehicles, payloads and associated space activities.
    Develop and establish regulatory processes, governance structures and compliance frameworks supporting future launch operations.
    Monitor, interpret and communicate national and international regulations affecting launch services, satellite operations, export control and related activities.
    Serve as SSC Space point of contact towards authorities, government agencies, industry stakeholders and international regulatory organizations.
    Support customers and internal stakeholders by providing guidance on licensing requirements and regulatory compliance throughout project lifecycles.

We offer you

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year and Ascension Day.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.  
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including attractive pension plans, parental pay and insurance.

Location

This is a full-time, permanent position based at Esrange Space Center in Kiruna or SSC Space Headquarters in Solna

Further Information

For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives:

Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com

Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com

Next Step

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.

When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

This position requires approved pre-employment screening. These controls are based on the role that you will fulfill within the company. Due to the security and regulatory requirements associated with this position, applicants must hold citizenship in an EU member state.  

We help Earth benefit from Space

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.

With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.

We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com.

Experience within Purchasing and/or the Automotive industry is highly desirable.

Advanced skills in Excel, Power BI, and Microsoft 365.

﻿

Preferred Profile:

Structured, proactive, and self-driven approach to work.

    

Ability to communicate financial insights clearly to various stakeholders.

    

Comfortable driving topics independently and challenging existing processes constructively.

    

Passion for continuous improvement and business development.

    

Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and strong interpersonal skills.

﻿

The successful candidate will join a multidisciplinary team with expertise spanning finance, sustainability, strategy, process development, digitalization, and new technologies. The role offers broad business exposure and the opportunity to contribute both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Hampurilaistyöntelijä, Hesburger Töölö Helsinki, Helsinki
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko osaksi maailman majointa työporukkaa?

Etsimme hampurilaistyöntekijää Hesburger Töölöön toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen.

Tarjoamme työtunnit joustavasti omaan tilanteeseesi sopien.

Palkka on 9,77-14,33 € tunnilta riippuen aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi.

Tarjoamme lisäksi Epassin kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja hyvinvointiedut. Ja mikä parasta, etuus voi olla jopa 600 € vuodessa!

Saat alennuksen ruokatuotteistamme. Työajalla alennus on -50 % ja vapaa-ajalla -25 %.

Palkitsemme työntekijöitämme hyvistä suorituksista mm. IPA-palkinnoilla.

Mikä ihmeen IPA-palkinto? Tästä ja muista kannusteistamme kerromme sinulle tarkemmin työhaastattelussa.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään? Työtehtäviisi ravintolassa kuuluu mm. asiakaspalvelu, herkullisten tuotteidemme valmistus sekä ravintolan siisteyttä ylläpitävät toimet. Kokemuksesi karttuessa omavalvontamme ja varastonhallinnalliset työtehtävät tulevat sinulle tutuiksi.

Ei aikaisempaa kokemusta? Ei hätää. Koulutamme sinut tehtäviisi ja tukenasi on ravintolamme mahtava tiimi. Meillä Hesburgerilla on kattava koulutusjärjestelmä, HeseAkatemia, joka takaa sinulle perehdytystä työsuhteesi alussa sekä sen aikana.

Kiinnostuitko? Kerrassaan mahtavaa! Tutustu ihmeessä työntekijöihimme ja heidän työpäiviinsä tarkemmin täältä: [Hesburger - Töihin Hesburgeriin](https://www.hesburger.fi/toihin-hesburgeriin)

Haluaisimme ehdottomasti kuulla sinusta lisää. Laitathan hakemuksesi tulemaan pikaisesti, sillä haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löytyessä.

Burger-In Oy on suomalainen perheyritys ja Hesburger sen rekisteröity liikemerkki. Hesburger-ravintoloita löytyy yhdeksästä maasta: Suomesta, Liettuasta, Virosta, Latviasta, Bulgariasta, Ukrainasta, Saksasta, Puolasta ja Romaniasta. Ketjun palveluksessa työskentelee noin 9 500 henkilöä. Vuonna 2025 ketjun verollinen myynti oli Suomessa 327 miljoonaa euroa ja ulkomailla 242 miljoonaa euroa.

jobs.title: Opintosihteeri pääkaupunkiseudulle
jobs.description:
Haemme opintosihteeriä Axxell Monikulttuurisuuskeskukseen pääkaupunkiseudulle. Pääasiallinen työpisteesi on Espoossa, työtehtäviä on myös Helsingin ja Vantaan toimipisteissä. Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja alkaa sopimuksen mukaan syksyn 2026 aikana. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen.

Ensisijaiset tehtävät ovat aikuisten maahanmuuttajien kotoutumiskoulutukseen liittyvä opintohallinto ja asiakaspalvelu. Lisäksi työhön kuuluu monipuolisia hallinnon tukitehtäviä, esimerkiksi sijaisjärjestelyihin osallistuminen ja yhteydenpito toimitiloihin liittyvissä asioissa. Toimit osana opintosihteereidemme tiimiä ja opetushenkilöstön työparina. Työhösi kuuluu myös yhteydenpitoa ulkoisiin sidosryhmiin. Asiakaspalvelutehtävissä käytät englannin kieltä.

Tarjoamme sinulle työpaikan, jossa kestävä kehitys on osa kaikkea toimintaamme. Pääset osaksi työyhteisöä, jossa työskentelee sitoutunut ja osaava henkilöstö. Laajennettu työterveyshuolto sekä ePassi Flex -liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointipalvelut ovat esimerkkejä tarjoamistamme eduista.

Axxellissa opiskelee yli 5000 opiskelijaa, joista noin 3500 suorittaa tutkintoa. Henkilöstömäärä on noin 280. Axxell Monikulttuurisuuskeskus järjestää aikuisten maahanmuuttajien kotoutumiskoulutuksen lisäksi ammatillista koulutusta ja toimii aktiivisesti hankkeissa. Tukenasi ovat kokeneet kollegat, toimivat työvälineet lähi- ja etätyöskentelyyn ja vakiintuneen organisaation prosessit.

Edellytämme sinulta soveltuvaa koulutusta, esimerkiksi liiketoiminnan perustutkinto, erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa sekä hyviä tietoteknisiä taitoja sekä kokemusta aikuisten maahanmuuttajien kotoutumiskoulutuksen opintohallinnon tehtävistä. Ruotsin kielen ja muun kielitaidon katsomme eduksi. Odotamme, että työotteesi on asiakaslähtöinen, yhteistyökykyinen ja oma-aloitteinen. Tehtävä vaatii tarkkuutta, järjestelmällisyyttä ja kykyä hallita samanaikaisesti useita tehtäväkokonaisuuksia.

Palkka määräytyy yksityisen opetusalan työehtosopimuksen mukaan. Palkka on 2 350,36 –2 726,42 € (100 %) kokemuksesta riippuen. Koeaika on 6 kuukautta.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV alla olevalla lomakkeella viimeistään 10.9.2026. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

jobs.title: Buukkari / ajanvaraaja (etätyö)
jobs.description:
Etsimme nyt asiakasyrityksellemme ASales Oy:lle aktiivisia ja innokkaita BUUKKAREITA / AJANVARAAJIA kokopäiväiseen työhön!

ASales Oy on B2B- ja B2C-asiakashankintaan sekä ajanvaraukseen erikoistunut yritys. Olemme kasvaneet jo yli 50 henkilön organisaatioksi, ja rekrytoimme nyt 10 uutta ajanvaraajaa vahvistamaan tiimiämme. Autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan sopimalla laadukkaita myyntitapaamisia.

Jos olet tavoitteellinen, nautit ihmisten kanssa keskustelemisesta ja haluat kehittyä myynnin ammattilaisena, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!

Buukkarin / ajanvaraajan tehtävässä sovit myyntitapaamisia asiakkaidemme puolesta ja olet tärkeässä roolissa uusien asiakkuuksien rakentamisessa. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

* Myyntitapaamisten sopiminen
* Aktiivinen uusasiakashankinta
* Potentiaalisten asiakkaiden kontaktointi puhelimitse soittojärjestelmän avulla
* Tapaamisten kirjaaminen järjestelmiin
* Omien tavoitteiden seuraaminen

Aiempi kokemus myynnistä tai puhelintyöstä on eduksi, mutta ei vaatimus!

Työskentely onnistuu kokonaan etänä - vaikka mistä päin maailmaa tahansa! Sinulle lähetetään työvälineet käyttöösi, saat kattavan perehdytyksen työhösi, etkä jää myöskään "linjoille yksin", sillä pystyt olemaan yhteydessä koko työpäivän myös muihin tiimiläisiin. ASalesin toimisto sijaitsee Helsingissä, jonne halutessaan saa toki tulla työskentelemään!

Odotamme sinulta:

* Rohkeaa ja oma-aloitteista asennetta
* Tavoitteellisuutta ja itsenäistä työotetta
* Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
* Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa (lisäksi sujuva englannin, ruotsin tai saksan kielen taito katsotaan eduksi)
* Halua oppia ja kehittyä
* Kykyä omaksua uudet IT-ohjelmat

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* Kokoaikaisen työn (soittoaika arkisin pääosin klo 9-17)
* Mahdollisuuden vakituiseen työsuhteeseen
* Kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan tuen
* Rennon ja kannustavan työyhteisön
* Aidot etenemismahdollisuudet yrityksen sisällä
* Suorarekrytoinnin ASalesille

Miltä työn aloitus näyttää?

Aloitat yhdessä neljästä ajanvaraustiimistämme, jossa saat kattavan perehdytyksen, tiiminvetäjän tuen ja mahdollisuuden kehittyä päivä päivältä. Et jää yksin, vaan ympärilläsi on kokenut tiimi auttamassa onnistumaan. Palkkamalleja on kaksi: pohjapalkka + provisio tai täysprovisio. Lopulliset ansiot määräytyvät oman aktiivisuuden ja tulosten perusteella.

Meillä työskentelevät viihtyvät hyvin; mm. aloitamme ja lopetamme päivän yhdessä, ja välillä haastamme toisiamme erilaisten myyntikilpailuiden kanssa. Eli meillä on aidosti mukavaa töissä!

Kiinnostuitko, miten hakea?

Rekrytointi toteutetaan yhteistyössä ManpowerGroupin kanssa.

Mikäli tehtävä herätti kiinnostuksesi, toimi näin:

1 Käy rekisteröimässä itsesi työnhakijaksi oheisen hakulinkin kautta lisäämällä CV:si ja halutessasi hakukirjeesi mukaan.
2 Käy vastaamassa oheisen linkin (https://eu.rivs.com/08-16-87/) kautta videohaastattelukysymyksiin heti rekisteröintisi jälkeen (ilman videohaastatteluvastauksia emme pääse etenemään kohdallasi nopeasti, joten suosittelemme vastaamista!). Videokysymyksiin vastaaminen onnistuu parhaiten läppärillä, tabletilla tai pöytäkoneella, jossa on kamera.
3 Jää odottamaan mahdollista yhteydenottoa rekrytointiprosessin etenemisestä puhelimitse.

Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja avoimet paikat täytetään välittömästi aina sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Työn aloitus ASAP / sopimuksen mukaan, uudet työsuhteet starttaavat perehdytyksillä aina maanantaisin.

Senior Delivery Manager Heidi Yrjä p. 040 1546 747, heidi.yrja@manpowergroup.fi
Talent Acquisition Consultant Miia Koivula p. 040 1930 347, miia.koivula@manpowergroup.fi
