jobs.title: IB MYP/DP Instructional Leader for Language Acquisition and Teacher
jobs.description:
The school seeks to appoint an **energetic and visionary Instructional Leader** to lead the Language Acquisition department across both the IB Middle Years Programme (MYP) and Diploma Programme (DP). This role combines strategic instructional leadership with teaching responsibilities in MYP and DP Language Acquisition. This is a full-time, permanent position within our IB World School, where inquiry-driven learning, academic rigor, critical thinking, and global citizenship are at the heart of the educational experience. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping teaching and learning across the continuum, fostering innovation, and ensuring excellence in programme implementation.

**Key Instructional Leader Responsibilities**

- **Provide strategic leadership for the Language Acquisition Faculty**, setting a clear vision for excellence and curriculum development aligned with the IB continuum. In this role, you will champion our school's vision to be a community where every student is known, inspired, and challenged.

- **Drive pedagogical innovation and instructional excellence**, inspiring and empowering faculty to implement data-driven, research-informed, and student-centred practices that enhance engagement, conceptual understanding, and authentic learning.

- **Ensure coherent vertical and horizontal curriculum alignment (Grades 6–12)**, safeguarding progression, rigor, and consistency across the MYP and DP programmes.

- **Lead the monitoring and evaluation of instructional quality**, using data, classroom observation, student voice, and professional dialogue to ensure high standards of provision and continuous improvement.

- **Actively contribute to and collaborate with the team of Instructional Leaders and the Pedagogical Leadership Team**, shaping whole-school teaching and learning strategy and ensuring collective efficacy.

- **Safeguard compliance with IB Programme Standards and Practices**, ensuring programme integrity, smooth student transitions across the continuum, and a deep commitment to inclusivity and access.

- **Align faculty goals and instructional strategies with ISHs strategic vision and long-term priorities**, translating whole-school direction into impactful classroom practice.

- **Model exemplary teaching and learning practices**, demonstrating deep pedagogical knowledge and credibility as a leader of learning.

- **Lead professional growth through coaching and mentoring**, building teacher capacity, reflective practice, and instructional leadership within teams.

- **Cultivate trust-based professional relationships**, fostering collaboration, psychological safety, and a positive, high-performing school culture.

- **Promote equity, inclusion, and diversity**, ensuring that teaching practices and curriculum design reflect and value the richness of the school community.

- **Engage in ongoing professional reflection and growth**, using feedback and evidence to refine leadership impact and sustain continuous improvement.


**Key Teaching Responsibilities**

- **Teach Language Acquisition within the MYP and DP pathways**, delivering a rigorous, concept-driven curriculum aligned with IB standards. Experience teaching English, EAL, Finnish, or Spanish would be of interest, and the ability to contribute across more than one language acquisition programme would be an advantage.

- **Design and implement engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences** that promote curiosity, conceptual understanding, and meaningful connections to real-world contexts.

- **Cultivate intercultural understanding, global engagement, and international-mindedness,** enabling students to explore and appreciate diverse perspectives, identities, and cultures through language learning.

- **Develop students confidence and competence as multilingual communicators,** fostering the ability to interpret, create, and exchange meaning effectively in a variety of authentic contexts.

- **Differentiate instruction effectively**, responding to diverse learning profiles, language needs, and abilities to ensure equitable access and sustained academic growth.

- **Assess student learning using IB criteria-based assessment practices**, providing timely, constructive feedback that supports reflection, goal-setting, and continuous improvement.

- **Integrate technology, interdisciplinary learning, and experiential approaches** to deepen engagement and strengthen transferable skills.

- **Collaborate actively with colleagues** to design coherent, cross-curricular learning experiences that support the holistic development of students across the IB continuum.

- **Maintain a culture of vigilance regarding student well-being**, proactively identifying changes in behaviour or engagement and reporting concerns in accordance with the schools safeguarding policies and procedures.


**Salary**

The minimum salary for the position is €3,800 - €4531.33 per month which applies to teachers with 5 years teaching experience, teaching the minimum full time hours. This includes (i) a monthly stipend of €950.10, plus (ii) salary of a full time teacher. Salary is paid according to the higher of the Private Schools collective agreement or the schools own salary scale.

**Qualifications & Experience**

- Bachelors or Masters degree in Languages, Education, or a related field.

- Teaching certification and significant (minimum 5 years) experience teaching Languages, preferably in an IB setting or international school.

- Experience teaching English, EAL, Finnish, or Spanish would be of interest, and the ability to contribute across more than one language acquisition programme would be an advantage.

- Strong understanding of IB philosophy, inquiry-based learning, and global citizenship education.

- Ability to foster debate, discussion, and independent inquiry in the classroom.

- Experience with project-based learning, primary source analysis, and historical inquiry.

- Excellent communication, adaptability, and classroom management skills.

- High levels of proficiency in speaking, reading and writing in English

jobs.title: Hallintosihteeri
jobs.description:
**Hallintosihteeri Pancho Villa Finland Oy:lle**

Haluaisitko olla osa Pancho Villa -franchising-ketjun loistokasta tarinaa? Avaamme haun täysin uuteen tehtävään ketjun näköalapaikalle!

Meillä Pancho Villassa pääset osaksi rentoa, mutkatonta ja eteenpäin menevää työyhteisöä. Olemme vahvasti kasvava kotimainen ravintolaketju, jossa välitämme työntekijöistämme ja tuemme toistemme onnistumista. "Pancho-perheessä" viihdytään pitkään, sillä arvostamme työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa, luotamme työntekijöihimme ja ylläpidämme avointa keskustelukulttuuria.

**Olisitko sinä etsimämme hallintosihteeri?**

Etsimme huolellista ja tarkkaa hallintosihteeriä vakituiseen tehtävään, jossa olet merkittävä osatekijä Pancho Villan menestyksessä. Työ sisältää muun muassa osto- ja myyntireskontran hoitoa, laskutusta, tiliöintiä sekä tiivistä yhteistyötä tilitoimiston, tavarantoimittajien ja ketjun yrittäjien kanssa. Lisäksi tehtävään kuuluu sopimuskannan ylläpitoa sekä kuittien ja kuluraporttien esikäsittelyä. Pääset myös järjestämään erilaisia kokoustilaisuuksia, ketjupäiviä sekä muita sisäisiä tapahtumia.

**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- **Joustavat työajat:** Voit rytmittää työpäiväsi vapaasti, kunhan olet tavoitettavissa ketjun yrittäjille ja yhteistyökumppaneille arkisin ydinajat klo 9.00–14.00.

- **Vapautta ja vastuuta:** Mahdollisuuden työskennellä etänä mistä päin Suomea tahansa. Toimistomme sijaitsee **Tampereella,** jonne toivomme sinun pääsevän tarvittaessa.

- **Reilun palkkauksen:** Kilpailukykyisen palkan, josta haluamme kuulla palkkatoiveesi. Palkka tehtävässä on noin 2 300–3 400 €/kk riippuen osaamisesta, kokemuksesta ja tehtäväkuvan laajuudesta.

- **Kattavat edut:** Liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun: ePassi, kattavan työterveyshuollon sekä tietenkin tuntuvat henkilökunta-alennukset ketjumme ravintoloihin ympäri Suomen.

- **Täyden tuen:** Nykyaikaiset työvälineet sekä mahtavan tiimin tuen, meillä et jää tehtäviesi kanssa yksin.


**Odotamme sinulta:**

- Kokemusta myynti- ja ostoreskontran hoitamisesta Procountorilla

- Kaupallista koulutusta, esim. merkonomi tai tradenomi

- Taitoa hahmottaa monimutkaisiakin kokonaisuuksia

- Vahvaa tietoteknistä osaamista ja uusien järjestelmien omaksumiskykyä

- Huolellisuutta, järjestelmällisyyttä ja täsmällisyyttä

jobs.title: Industrielektriker till HFSAB
jobs.description:
Om företaget

HFSAB is the world's leading supplier of continuous lead extruders with over 60 years of experience in design and manufacture of high-quality machines for cable sheathing. Our portfolio comprises equipment for lead extrusion from single machines to complete turnkey solutions as well as equipment for cable stripping, repair and recovery. Consistent development over decades, staff expertise, service as a core competence and close partnership with our customers have contributed to our success. Our machine components are designed in-house. High stock availability together with a network of established high-quality sub-suppliers for parts provide for consistently high quality and speedy availability. These core competences have been our fundamental claim in the past and will be in future. As an affiliated company of the NIEHOFF Group with several branches worldwide, and with headquarters in Motala, Sweden, HFSAB is an innovative company with the goal and ability in meeting the global demands of tomorrow already today.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som industrielektriker hos oss blir dina huvudsakliga uppgifter att arbeta med elinstallationer samt övervakning av installationer, där du säkerställer att arbetet utförs korrekt och enligt standard. En viktig del i rollen är även dokumentation och strukturering av information, för att skapa tydlighet och långsiktig kunskap i organisationen.

Vi uppskattar om du bidrar med idéer och engagemang kring hur vi kan förbättra vårt underlag och dokumentationsrutiner – här finns utrymme för att påverka och utveckla arbetssättet.

Tjänsten innefattar emellanåt resor både inom Sverige och internationellt, där du representerar företaget och möter kunder. Därför är det viktigt att du trivs i kontakt med människor och i en varierande arbetsmiljö.

Du blir en del av ett team på sju personer med bred kompetens inom både el och mekanik.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som är utbildad elektriker och gärna har erfarenhet av arbete som industrielektriker. Du har goda kunskaper inom installation och felsökning av el på maskiner och är van att lösa problem praktiskt. El-behörighet är meriterande, men om du är på väg mot att färdigställa den kan vi stötta dig i processen.

Som person beskrivs du som självdrivande, initiativtagande och strukturerad. Du ser värdet i att dokumentera och dela kunskap – för att skapa en stabil grund som fler kan bygga vidare på. Du uppskattar variation i arbetet, där både teknik, dokumentation och kundkontakt ingår. Tjänsten kräver att du kommunicerar obehindrat i svenska och engelska samt att du innehar B-körkort.

Ansökningsförfarande

I den här rekryteringen samarbetar HFSAB med Skill. Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Innan anställning slutförs kommer bakgrundskontroll genomföras.

Eftersom vi vill säkerställa ett rättvist och fördomsfritt urvalsarbete önskar vi inget personligt brev, däremot att du svarar på våra inledande urvalsfrågor. Om du går vidare kommer du därefter att få ett mejl med en länk till våra rekryteringstester som på ett objektivt sätt hjälper oss att matcha rätt person till tjänsten.

Vid frågor om tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Matilda Ingeson på matilda.ingeson@skill.se eller 0705-65 61 31. #LI-DNI

jobs.title: Project Leader Academy
jobs.description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Project Leader Academy



Drive the future of learning and competence development across Northern Europe



Join us as we accelerate the transformation. Together.







Do you thrive on turning ideas into reality? Are you passionate about learning, development, and creating solutions that make a real business impact? As Project Leader Academy for Northern Europe, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering innovative training solutions that support our customers, employees, and business growth.







This is an exciting opportunity to combine project leadership, stakeholder management, and training development in a dynamic international environment where your work will directly contribute to building competence and accelerating performance.







Join our team



The Regional Academy team is responsible for developing and delivering training solutions that support Epiroc's customers and employees across Northern Europe. We work closely with colleagues from Sales, Service, Product Divisions, Product Specialists, and trainers to ensure that the right competence is available to meet current and future business needs.







As Project Leader Academy , you will be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team dedicated to continuous learning and development. Together, we identify opportunities, develop innovative solutions, and create value through knowledge and competence.







Your mission



In this role, you will drive Academy development initiatives and training projects from identified need through implementation and operational handover. You will translate business priorities, customer needs, competence gaps, and new technologies into scalable and commercially viable training solutions.







Your responsibilities include:




    Developing and implementing new and improved training solutions based on customer and business needs.
    Leading complex customer training projects involving multiple stakeholders, products, sites, or countries.
    Coordinating cross-functional teams and ensuring clear project scope, ownership, timelines, and expected outcomes.
    Driving project execution, managing risks, and ensuring successful implementation and business value realization.
    Collaborating with trainers, product specialists, product divisions, sales, and service teams to create sustainable learning solutions.
    Identifying opportunities to standardize and scale successful training concepts across the region.



Safety is a fundamental priority in all activities and an integral part of every project and initiative.



  



Location and other



This position is located in Örebro, Sweden.



We can offer a hybrid workplace—a way of working that provides flexibility and promotes a healthier balance between professional and personal life.



Occasional travel is required.







Why Epiroc?



By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact.











Application and contact information



We encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than September 24 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date.







We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.







Please note that due to regulations, we cannot handle applications received through email.







We have already made our choices regarding advertising channels and consulting providers, and kindly request not to be contacted regarding such inquiries.

Profile description:

Your profile



You are a proactive and structured professional who enjoys driving initiatives forward and bringing people together around a common goal. With strong communication and stakeholder management skills, you can navigate complex environments and create engagement across functions and countries.







To succeed in this role, you likely have:




    Experience leading projects involving multiple stakeholders and cross-functional collaboration.
    A strong ability to plan, coordinate, and drive initiatives from concept to implementation.
    Experience within training, learning and development, competence management, or a related field.
    Excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships across the organization.
    A business-oriented mindset with the ability to identify value-creating and scalable solutions.
    Fluency in English and Swedish, both spoken and written.







Experience from the mining, construction, industrial, or technical sectors is considered an advantage.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in France.

This is a highly technical sales role focused on helping engineering teams adopt infrastructure and developer-focused technology.
You will own opportunities from initial engagement through close, working directly with technically sophisticated customers who expect credibility and speed.
The role combines consultative selling, technical problem-solving, proof-of-concept management, and disciplined pipeline ownership.
You will work closely with Solutions Engineers while becoming a trusted presence in customer communication channels and helping remove obstacles to purchase.
Success requires the confidence to explain complex concepts simply, challenge assumptions, and be transparent when a solution is not the right fit.
You will operate with significant autonomy in a fast-moving environment where experimentation, urgency, and customer outcomes matter.
This is an opportunity for either an experienced technical AE or a technically minded professional ready to take ownership of a sales quota.


Accountabilities
  • Own the sales process from qualified opportunity through successful close, with a strong focus on helping technical customers achieve their desired outcomes.
  • Build trusted relationships with engineers and technical stakeholders, including actively participating in customer communication channels such as Slack.
  • Manage and close inbound sales opportunities, moving prospects efficiently through the buying process.
  • Lead and coordinate proof-of-concept initiatives in partnership with Solutions Engineers, ensuring technical and commercial objectives are clearly defined.
  • Help customers troubleshoot questions and remove technical or commercial obstacles that could prevent a successful purchase.
  • Communicate honestly and transparently, including clearly explaining when a solution is not an appropriate fit.
  • Maintain a systematic approach to pipeline management, ensuring opportunities, next steps, and follow-ups are consistently tracked.
  • Navigate, improve, and contribute to internal sales and go-to-market systems and processes.
  • Experiment with new approaches to prospect engagement, deal execution, and GTM workflows, using results and customer feedback to continuously improve.
  • Move quickly and independently, identifying what needs to be done and taking action without requiring detailed direction.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience as an Account Executive, particularly in a technical B2B, SaaS, infrastructure, or developer-focused sales environment; alternatively, strong technical experience combined with readiness to take on a sales quota.
    • Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to comfortably understand API documentation, technical product concepts, and engineering workflows.
    • Experience selling to developers or engineering teams is highly desirable, with an understanding of how to build credibility with technically sophisticated buyers.
    • Strong organizational and pipeline-management skills, with a systematic approach to tracking opportunities and following through on commitments.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
    • High integrity and customer orientation, with a commitment to honest communication rather than overselling.
    • Strong sense of urgency and ability to operate at the pace of technically sophisticated, fast-moving customers.
    • Self-directed and resourceful, with the ability to take ownership and make progress without extensive supervision.
    • Curious and experimental mindset, with a willingness to test new approaches, learn from unsuccessful experiments, and adapt quickly.
    • Experience with databases, search technologies, or infrastructure software is a plus.
    • Familiarity with GTM automation tools such as Clay or n8n is advantageous.
    • Comfort working with Python, JavaScript, Linux, or major cloud platforms is a plus.
    • Willingness to prioritize correctness, customer evidence, initiative, and continuous improvement in day-to-day decision-making.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote working environment.
      • Opportunity to work from Canada, the United States, or Europe.
      • Significant autonomy and ownership over your work.
      • Direct exposure to highly technical customers and engineering teams.
      • Opportunity to work closely with Solutions Engineers and technical stakeholders.
      • Chance to develop expertise across databases, search, infrastructure, and developer-focused technology.
      • Fast-moving environment that encourages experimentation and learning from results.
      • Opportunity to influence and improve internal go-to-market systems and processes.
      • Role with direct commercial impact and responsibility for closing meaningful technical deals.

jobs.description:
Renholdsmedarbeider (Hotell)

Vi søker en serviceinnstilt og nøyaktig renholdsmedarbeider til vårt hotellteam. Du vil spille en viktig rolle i å sikre at våre gjester får et rent, hyggelig og komfortabelt opphold.

Stillinger er basert på annenhver helg og ekstra ved behov.

Ca. 50 % fast stilling.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Renhold og klargjøring av hotellrom

  • Skifte sengetøy og håndklær

  • Rengjøring av bad og fellesområder

  • Påfyll av gjesteartikler (såpe, papir m.m.)

  • Rapportere eventuelle avvik eller behov for vedlikehold

  • Følge hotellets standarder for renhold og hygiene

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Erfaring fra hotell eller renhold er en fordel

  • Evne til å arbeide effektivt i et høyt tempo

  • Grunnleggende norsk eller engelsk

  • Fleksibel med hensyn til arbeidstid (inkludert helg)

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Nøyaktig og detaljorientert

  • Pålitelig og ansvarsbevisst

  • Positiv og serviceinnstilt

  • God samarbeidsevne

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

  • Opplæring i hotellets rutiner

  • Varierte arbeidsdager

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Arbeidstid: Turnus, dag/kveld og helg

Oppstart: Etter avtale

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bryne Kro & Hotell er en familiebedrift, startet i 1986 av familien Otto. I dag er det andre generasjon som driver stedet. Så kan du spørre: Betyr det noe at vi er familiedrevet? For oss betyr det masse, selvsagt, vi fører videre noe vi tror på. Vi er sikre på at det betyr noe for deg også, eller rettere sagt: for opplevelsen din når du er her. Du kommer til å føle det hjemmekoselige, det uformelle og nære. Kjenne at du er en av oss.

jobs.title: Chef/Kock
jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled chef to join the team at ÄNG. You will become part of a close-knit and ambitious kitchen team, with a varied role and plenty of opportunities to learn, develop and contribute.

Experience from a Michelin-starred restaurant is a plus, but not a requirement. A good foundation in fine dining, attention to detail and a genuine interest in cooking are more important to us. We work hard and have high ambitions, but we also believe that a good kitchen should be a friendly and enjoyable place to work.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the EU/EEA.



ABOUT ÄNG

ÄNG serves a tasting menu based on Nordic ingredients. The restaurant is open for dinner Monday to Friday, with a separate tasting menu served for breakfast Tuesday to Saturday. We close after breakfast service on Saturday and reopen at 17:00 on Monday.

Our cooking is rooted in Halland, while drawing on techniques and influences from around the world. We work mainly with ingredients from the surrounding area and adapt the menu to what is available throughout the seasons.

With the sea around 20 minutes away, seafood and ingredients from the coastline are an important part of the menu. We also work with produce from nearby farms, forests, beaches and fields, including ingredients picked locally each morning.

ÄNG is located at Ästad Vingård, and the vineyard’s organic Scandinavian wines are produced around 100 metres from the restaurant.

Working with a limited geographical area naturally sets some boundaries. For the kitchen team, this means finding new ways to work with the ingredients and conditions available to us.

ÄNG is run by Ann-Catrine Gemzell (General Manager & Sommelier) and Filip Gemzell (Executive Chef).



WHY JOIN ÄNG?

    You will have a personal development plan, set up accordingly to your ambitions and goals.
    The team is always there to help you succeed, as long as you help the team to succeed.
    A great opportunity to connect with nature, vineyards and produce. We can provide assistance with finding accommodation.



APPLY

Apply by sending your CV and cover letter to executive chef Filip Gemzell, at filip@restaurangang.se.

Feel free to get in touch if you have any questions!

Øygarden kommune ønskjer eit arbeidsmiljø prega av mangfald, og at våre medarbeidarar i størst mogleg grad skal spegla mangfaldet i befolkninga. Vi oppmodar alle som er kvalifiserte til å søkja jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, eller minoritetsbakgrunn. Som IA-verksemd ønskjer kommunen å leggja til rette for arbeidsforholda dersom du har behov for det.

Etter utløpet til søknadsfristen, vert det sett opp ei offentleg søkjarliste med namn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bustads- eller arbeidskommune for kvar søkjar. Det kan gjerast unntak frå innsyn for opplysningar om ein søkjar dersom vedkomande sjølv ber om det. Opplysningar om ein søkjar, kan verta offentlege sjølv om søkjaren har bede om ikkje å vert ført opp på søkjarlista. Dersom oppmodinga ikkje vert teken til følgje, vert søkjaren varsla om dette. Ved vurderinga av om ei slik oppmoding skal takast til følgje, skal det leggjast vekt på om det knyter seg særleg offentleg interesse til stillinga.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Øygarden kommune er den nest største kommunen i Vestland fylke med om lag 40 700 innbyggjarar og om lag 2 800 tilsette. Straume er kommunesenter (ca. 15 minutt køyring frå Bergen) med kommunedelsenter på Rong, Ågotnes og i Skogsskiftet. Administrasjonsspråket i Øygarden er nynorsk. Øygarden kommune har sett seg som mål å vera ein framtidsretta og kunnskapsbasert samfunnsutviklar med fortrinn innanfor energi, teknologi og marine ressursar. Kommunen skal løfta fram viktige verdiar som felles kultur, språk og identitet. Vi har ambisjonar om å vera ein handlekraftig og effektiv organisasjon med god leiing, høg kompetanse og kvalitet.

jobs.title: Vil du lede pædagogikken tæt på børnene i et ambitiøst børnehus?
jobs.description:
Når et lille menneske lykkes, mærker du det helt ind i hjertet.

Og når medarbejdere udvikler sig, lykkes med svære opgaver eller finder nye veje i deres praksis, giver det dig den samme følelse.

Forestil dig en helt almindelig tirsdag i vuggestuen.

Et barn står længe og overvejer, om det tør kravle op på den høje skammel ved bordet. Du er tæt på, men ikke for tæt. Du giver plads, tid og opmuntring. Barnet prøver selv. Lykkes. Smilet breder sig.

Lidt senere er du i dialog med en medarbejder om, hvordan dagens rutiner kan skabe endnu bedre deltagelsesmuligheder for børnene. Sammen reflekterer I over praksis, justerer og bliver klogere.

Det er netop samspillet mellem ledelse og pædagogik, der gør denne stilling særlig.

I Farum Nordby Børnehus søger vi en afdelingsleder til vores vuggestue, som ønsker at være tæt på både børn, medarbejdere og den pædagogiske udvikling. Du vil have 20 timer om ugen til ledelsesopgaver og bruge resten af din arbejdstid i praksis sammen med børnene og kollegerne.

Vi tror på, at den stærkeste ledelse opstår, når man leder tæt på kerneopgaven.

Derfor skal du vælge os

Vi tror på, at god pædagogik starter med gode relationer. Ikke kun til børnene, men også til hinanden.

Hos os bliver du en del af et hus, hvor faglige refleksioner, sparring og ærlige dialoger er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi er optagede af, hvordan vi sammen kan skabe de bedste deltagelsesmuligheder for børnene, og vi ved, at det kræver både faglighed, nysgerrighed og mod.

Som afdelingsleder bliver du en central del af dette arbejde. Du skal understøtte medarbejdernes faglige udvikling, skabe retning og sammenhæng i hverdagen og samtidig være en aktiv del af det pædagogiske arbejde med børnene.

Vi ønsker ikke at håndtere eller servicere børn gennem dagen. Vi ønsker at invitere dem ind som aktive deltagere i deres eget hverdagsliv.

Derfor ser vi også dagens rutiner som mere end praktiske opgaver. Garderoben, måltidet, bleskiftet og middagsluren er betydningsfulde pædagogiske rum, hvor relationer styrkes, selvstændighed udvikles, og børn oplever mestring.

Som leder er du med til at fastholde dette fokus og omsætte vores værdier til praksis sammen med medarbejderne.

Samtidigt arbejder vi i en kultur præget af tillid, humor og fælles ansvar. Vi hjælper hinanden, deler vores erfaringer og tror på, at arbejdsglæde opstår, når mennesker føler sig set, hørt og værdsat.

Vi leder efter dig, som

Måske har du allerede ledererfaring. Måske er du en erfaren pædagog, der er klar til at tage næste skridt og har lyst til at udvikle dig som leder.

Det vigtigste er, at du:

  • Er uddannet pædagog.
  • Har lyst til at kombinere ledelse og pædagogisk praksis.
  • Kan skabe retning, overblik og følgeskab gennem tillidsfulde relationer.
  • Ser børn som kompetente deltagere med egne perspektiver.
  • Er optaget af at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder frem for løsninger på børnenes vegne.
  • Kan understøtte medarbejderes faglige refleksion og udvikling.
  • Har mod til at gå nysgerrigt og anerkendende ind i faglige dialoger.
  • Kan møde både børn, forældre og medarbejdere med nærvær, respekt og tydelighed.
  • Bidrager positivt til fællesskabet med humor, energi og ansvarlighed.

Hos os får du

  • En afvekslende stilling med 20 timers ledelse og resten af tiden i praksis med børnene.
  • Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af vuggestuens faglige og pædagogiske retning.
  • Et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi lykkes sammen.
  • Medarbejdere, der prioriterer sparring, refleksion og faglig udvikling.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor tillid vægtes højere end kontrol.
  • En kultur præget af omsorg, humor og respekt.
  • Tæt kontakt til kerneopgaven og børnenes hverdag.
  • Et børnesyn, hvor fællesskab, deltagelse og medbestemmelse er fundamentet for vores arbejde.
  • Mulighed for ledelsesmæssig sparring og udvikling.
  • Forberedelses- og ledelsestid indlagt i arbejdstiden.

Hvis du kan se dig selv her

Så håber vi, du har lyst til at blive en del af Farum Nordby Børnehus.

Vi leder ikke blot efter en afdelingsleder. Vi leder efter et menneske, der ønsker at gøre en forskel for både børn og medarbejdere, og som tror på, at den vigtigste ledelse ofte sker tæt på praksis og midt i hverdagens helt almindelige situationer.

Hvis du kan genkende glæden ved at se et barn lykkes, motiveres af at udvikle medarbejdere og har lyst til at stå i spidsen for et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Måske er det dig, der skal være med til at skabe de næste betydningsfulde hverdage i Farum Nordby Børnehus.

Praktisk

Der indhentes referencer fra tidligere ansættelsesforhold, hvis du kommer i betragtning til stillingen.

I Furesø Kommune sker løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og ud fra principperne i Ny Løn.



Et arbejde, der betaler sig - et særligt tillæg

I Furesø Kommune er attraktiv løn, interesse for hinandens faglighed og løbende personlig og faglig udvikling en vigtig del af vores virkelighed. Engagementet i den enkelte har stor betydning for børnenes trivsel, udvikling og læring. I Furesøs mange dagtilbud er forskellighed en styrke, og medarbejderne går gerne nye veje i arbejdet med at styrke udviklingen af den pædagogiske kvalitet med udgangspunkt i den styrkede pædagogiske læreplan.

Den indsats belønner vi med Furesøtillægget, der sikrer et kvalifikationstillæg på 7.000 kr. i nutidskroner årligt til alle fastansatte pædagoger.

Pædagogerne fortæller
I 4 videoer kan du blive klogere på, vi arbejder med at give Furesøs børn de bedst mulige vilkår og muligheder i livet. Se dem på furesoe.dk/blivpædagog

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow at the language acquisition and language processing lab
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You can find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

     

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

The purpose of a postdoctoral position is to build up a researcher profile that qualifies for a position as associate professor. The position may also offer additional skills that are relevant to the postdoctoral fellow's future career. Apply for this position to become part of our research environment and take the next step in your career with us.

The Language Acquisition and Language Processing Lab (NTNU) are looking to hire a postdoctoral fellow (100%) for a temporary position. The timeframe for the position is three years and we are planning for the position to start late 2026.

The lab is located in the Department of Language and Literature (ISL) at the Faculty of Humanities (HF), NTNU. The LALP Lab is the oldest and best equipped experimental lab in Norway with a 20 year history. The equipment includes Tobii eye-tracking systems and EyeLink 1000; EEG and fNIRS; FURHAT Robot and allows for studying language behavior (time-course and quantity of gaze/eye-movements), neuro-physiology of language processing in the brain and neuro-imaging.

One of the main responsibilities of the postdoc will be to conduct research in the newly awarded ERC Synergy grant SHAPE. This will involve (but is not limited to) designing behavioral and other studies of visuo-perceptual and language skills in toddlers at risk for autism, recruiting and testing participants, as well as data processing and analysis. The main goals of SHAPE are to map out the relationship between the visual perception of shape and its encoding across languages in the world and to identify the factors which constrain the observed cross-linguistic variation. SHAPE is also concerned with developmental trajectories in these domains and relies on tight collaboration with leading researchers in the field in the USA, the UK, Germany and France.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. 


Duties of the position
  • Designing and conducting studies of visuo-spatial and language skills in toddlers at elevated likelihood for autism in comparison with neuro-typically developing children
  • Recruiting and testing participants
  • Analysing datasets and preparing manuscripts for submission
  • Supporting the NTNU SHAPE PIs in implementing the NTNU team SHAPE research agenda in collaboration with the external ERC Synergy teams and participating in consortium-wide large datasets analyses
  • Active participation in LALP Lab activities

Required selection criteria
  • You must have completed a doctoral degree in cognitive science, psychology or computer design/programming
  • Training and experience with at least one technical research method for gathering or analysing data (e.g., eye tracking, EEG/ERP, acoustic analysis in Praat)
  • Background in, and experience with, methods and models (e.g., deep learning methods, multimodal AI) for the automatic identification of behavioral cues during ecological interactions with people and the environment and analyses of video and speech/language data
  • Excellent statistical skills
  • Experience in research on autism, and specifically infants and toddlers
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

If you do not already have educational competence that meets the requirements for a position as associate professor in Norway, NTNU will strive to arrange for you to acquire such competence during the employment period. In such cases, we will try to assign to you as relevant teaching as possible as part of the career-promoting work.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position. 


Preferred selection criteria
  • Previous relevant work experience will weigh positively (e.g., previous postdoc positions, relevant research experience in the domain of the position etc.)
  • Good written and oral Norwegian language skills will weigh positively

Personal characteristics
  • Interpersonal skills
  • Communication skills
  • Organizational skills
  • Collaborative and team-work skills

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer 
  • An exciting job with an important social mission
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment 
  • Career guidance throughout the postdoctoral program and together with you we will prepare a career plan, which contains the skills and knowledge you will acquire 
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues 
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favourable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a Postdoctoral Fellow at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education.

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.


Salary and conditions

As a Postdoctoral Fellow (code 1352) you are normally paid from gross NOK 633 400,- per annum before tax, depending on qualifications and seniority. From the salary, 2% is deducted as a contribution to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The period of employment is 3 years, depending on whether there is a need to include courses within educational competence.  

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important to keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and to adapt to them. 

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed. 


About the application 

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. 

The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request. 

The application must include: 

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's-, Master's- and PhD degrees. If you have not yet completed your PhD, you must provide confirmation on your estimated date for the doctoral dissertation, or confirmation that your PhD thesis has been submitted. Documentation of a completed doctoral degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • An updated CV in Jobbnorge.no
  • A copy of one publication you deem best represents your scholarly achievements so far
  • A 5-page document with reflections on studying and/or analyzing data from visuo-perceptual cognition and early vocabulary skills in children at risk for autism
  • Name and contact information of three referees

If all or parts of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education. Description of the documentation required can be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint works will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint works, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

If you have had leave or another break in your career, it is important that this is stated in your application so that the selection committee can take this into account and that the amount of your research may be reduced as a result.

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal qualities. Motivation, ambitions and potential for research will also be emphasized in the assessment of the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and is committed to follow evaluation criteria for research quality according to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment DORA and the obligations in CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information 

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public list of applicants, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Mila Dimitrova Vulchanova, email: mila.vulchanova@ntnu.no. If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Martin Jakobsen, email: martin.jakobsen@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 11.09.2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 
 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000.The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 

 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Language and Literature

We conduct research and teaching in comparative literature, English, French, Spanish, German, Scandinavian studies, linguistics, phonetics, applied linguistics, sign language and interpreting, and cultural history. We are also responsible for the five-year master’s programmes in teacher education (lektorutdanning) in language subjects. The Department has an active research environment with responsibility for several large research projects. The Department of Language and Literature is one of six departments in the Faculty of Humanities.

jobs.title: Site Manager - Swedish student websites
jobs.description:
About the Role

Are you passionate about SEO, UX, data, and digital growth? Do you enjoy turning insights into improvements that create better user experiences and measurable business results?

We're looking for a Site Manager to take ownership of our Swedish student websites, including studentum.se, AllaStudier.se, gymnasium.se, anpassadgymnasieskola.se, and dingrundskola.se. In this role, you'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive traffic, improve conversions, and continuously develop some of Sweden's leading education platforms.

As Site Manager, you'll be responsible for the overall development and performance of our websites. You'll work closely with Product, Tech, Marketing, Content, and Sales to improve the user experience, strengthen our SEO performance, and deliver digital projects that create real impact.

From analyzing user behaviour and planning site improvements to collaborating on new product features, you'll play a key role in shaping the future of our student platforms.

About the Team

You'll join a collaborative team of Marketing Specialists and Account Managers dedicated to creating the best possible experience for both our education partners and prospective students. Together, we ensure our websites provide valuable content, intuitive functionality, and user-friendly tools that help schools connect with the right audience.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing & Service Delivery, you'll work closely with Site Managers across our international markets, sharing insights, best practices, and ideas to continuously improve our platforms. You'll also collaborate closely with our Product, Tech, and SEO teams, where our SEO & growth specialists provide the strategic direction while you help bring those initiatives to life through continuous website optimization, content improvements, and user-focused development.

Responsibilities

    

Own and develop the structure and user experience of our Swedish student websites.

    

Analyze website performance, traffic, and conversion data to identify growth opportunities.

    

Drive SEO initiatives to increase organic visibility and website traffic.

    

Monitor competitors, digital trends, and developments in the Swedish education system to keep our platforms relevant, accurate, and competitive.

    

Define user needs through research, surveys, and customer insights.

    

Collaborate with Product and Tech teams to prioritize new features, report bugs, and implement improvements.

    

Work closely with Content Managers to optimize and develop high-quality contenting.

    

Lead cross-functional projects that improve our websites and user experience.

Requirements

We're looking for someone who:

    

Has experience managing websites, digital products, or SEO-driven platforms.

    

Has solid knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console.

    

Has a genuine interest in AI and large language models (LLMs), and enjoys exploring how AI can improve content, SEO, and digital experiences.

    

Enjoys working with data and using insights to improve performance.

    

Is comfortable collaborating across multiple teams and stakeholders.

    

Has excellent organizational and project management skills.

    

Is proactive, curious, and always looking for ways to improve the user experience.

    

Communicates fluently in Swedish and English.

Beneficial, but not required

    

Experience with Ahrefs, Canva, Infogram, Excel and other digital tools.

    

Experience with CRO, A/B testing, and UX optimization.

    

Knowledge of HTML/CSS or working closely with development teams.

    

Experience within publishing, marketplaces, or digital media.

    

Experience working with educational institutions, government organizations, or education marketing.

Why us?

Join an international EdTech company where you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact. You'll work in a collaborative environment, combining data, technology, and content to help millions of people make better education decisions.

    

Opportunity to make a real impact in a growing company

    

Collaborative and international work environment

    

High level of ownership and autonomy

    

Meaningful projects and learning opportunities

Why you'll love working with us

🌍 An international team with colleagues across the world.

🚀 A fast-paced EdTech company with a flat organization and quick decision-making.

📈 Great opportunities for professional growth and career development.

🏢 Modern offices at Karlaplan in Stockholm, flexible working hours, and hybrid work.

☕ Monday breakfasts, fitness sessions, fika, and Friday after-work gatherings.

About Keystone Education Group

At Keystone, you will be working with passionate, professional and high-performance individuals. Together, we have grown successfully into more than 700 talented employees with websites that are recognized as the world's leading search engines for education. Ambition, drive and great ideas help us reach our goals – join us in the next step of your career!

Application Instructions

Please send us your application by hitting the button "Apply here!".

We will begin reviewing applications in early August and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis thereafter.

Keystone is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are deeply committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Sustainability & ESG Reporting, Solna
jobs.description:
PostNord is making a significant investment in strengthening its sustainability and ESG reporting capabilities towards customers as part of our data‑driven transformation. To support this journey, we are building a new ESG data foundation – and we are looking for an ESG Data Engineer to help define and build it. This is a key role in a new setup, where you will contribute to establishing trusted, scalable and auditable ESG data pipelines that sustainability reporting across the Group will rely on. You will help turn ESG reporting requirements into reliable data solutions from the ground up. The role sits within the Analytics Center of Excellence, responsible for shaping the future data and analytics landscape at PostNord. You will work with our Azure‑based data platform and collaborate closely with sustainability specialists. This position is ideal for someone who wants to take real responsibility, build something fundamental and apply strong technical skills in a purpose‑driven domain.

Your role

As a Data Engineer working with Sustainability & ESG, you will design and maintain data models and pipelines that support:

    Regulatory and statutory sustainability reporting (e.g. CSRD)

    Internal sustainability KPIs and performance management

    Management and operational insights related to climate impact, energy, transport, suppliers, and social responsibility

You will work closely with sustainability experts, business stakeholders, Power BI developers, and the central data platform team to ensure data quality, traceability, and scalability.

Job duties

    Enable a self-service data architecture that provides trusted sustainability and ESG data across the organization

    Design, develop, and deploy fact- and dimension-based data models to support sustainability reporting and analytics

    Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines integrating data from multiple operational, finance, and external sources

    Collaborate with sustainability, finance, and compliance stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into robust data solutions

    Ensure data quality, lineage, and transparency, supporting auditability and regulatory needs

    Collaborate with the Data Platform team to align on architecture standards and best practices

    Work with modern Azure-based data platforms, contributing to scalable and secure solutions

    Strong analytical skills and the ability to apply complex business and sustainability logic to raw data

    Data modeling and data warehousing

    Database design and ETL/ELT development

    Performance tuning and scalable data solutions

    Experience or strong interest in sustainability, ESG, or regulatory reporting domains

    Good understanding of front-end analytics and reporting tools (e.g. Power BI)

    Experience in requirement analysis, prototyping, and stakeholder collaboration

    A collaborative mindset and ability to work closely with business, sustainability specialists, and technical teams
    Preferably hands-on experience with: Databricks, Azure DevOps, Git, (Py)Spark, Python, CI/CD pipelines, Azure Data Platform, Medallion architecture.

Ways of working

You will work in an agile environment, applying a pragmatic SAFe-inspired approach adapted to team and product needs. As a Data Engineer at PostNord, you will remain hands-on, while also collaborating closely with Power BI developers, sustainability specialists, product owners, and domain teams to ensure solutions meet business and regulatory expectations.

Your profile

You have several years of experience as a Data Engineer or BI/Data Engineer in a data-intensive environment. You understand how to design enterprise-grade, reliable, and auditable data models, and you enjoy working close to the business.

You are curious, eager to learn, and motivated by using data and technology to support sustainability, transparency, and responsible business practices.

We offer you

    A flexible hybrid workplace in a prestige-free and collaborative culture

    Opportunities for professional and personal development

    A Nordic working environment with strong values

In addition, we offer:

    Good insurance and occupational pension conditions

    Wellness allowance & access to office gym and swimming pool

    Employee benefits through PostNord’s employee foundation

    Employment according to a collective agreement

We make everyday life easier – and more sustainable

PostNord is the leading supplier of communication and logistics solutions to, from, and within the Nordic region. We aim to make everyday life easier and more sustainable for everyone who lives and works in the Nordics.

We value accountability, courage, and commitment, and we believe diversity and teamwork lead to better outcomes.

Apply

We look forward to receiving your application! For questions about the role, please contact: Pernille Skovborg – Manager of Analytics Center of Excellence at pernille.skovborg@postnord.com.

PostNord offers communications and logistics solutions to, from and within the Nordic region. With our expertise and a unique distribution network, we are developing the basis for tomorrow’s communication, e-commerce, distribution and logistics.

jobs.title: Zelfstandig werkende koks I
jobs.description:
Tegenover het bruisende hart van Maastricht Centraal Station ligt een culinaire hotspot die de aandacht trekt van zowel reizigers als locals: Dada Wan Maastricht.

Deze eigentijdse eetgelegenheid combineert streetfood-invloeden met een modern, stijlvol interieur en een ontspannen sfeer. Of je nu onderweg bent en snel iets wilt eten, of op zoek bent naar een gezellige plek om te genieten van Aziatisch geïnspireerde gerechten, Dada Wan Maastricht biedt een verrassende en toegankelijke ervaring aan de rand van het centrum. Dankzij de strategische ligging tegenover het station is het de ideale tussenstop voor wie Maastricht binnenkomt of verlaat.

Jouw takenpakket

  • Je voert voorbereidende werkzaamheden uit, waaronder het wassen van groenten, het snijden en fileren van zalm, en het snijden van lamskoteletten en rundvlees voor de bereiding van stoneplate-gerechten. Dit doe je samen met een keukenteam van circa acht collega’s, onder leiding van de chef-kok.
  • Je bereidt en maakt diverse gerechten, waarbij je tussentijdse kwaliteits- en hygiënecontroles uitvoert volgens de geldende richtlijnen.
  • Je maakt gerechten gereed voor uitgifte en voert hierbij een eindcontrole uit, waarna de bedieningsmedewerkers (of robots) de gerechten kunnen bezorgen.
  • Je plant de dagelijkse werkzaamheden en plaatst bestellingen voor voedingsmiddelen en andere voorraadaanvullingen bij vaste leveranciers. Tevens controleer je de geleverde producten op kwaliteit en kwantiteit.
  • Je houdt toezicht op de werkzaamheden van hulpkrachten, geeft instructies en stuurt waar nodig bij.
  • Voor sluitingstijd zorg je voor een schone werkplek, reinig je keukenapparatuur en -machines, en assisteer je eventueel bij het schoonmaken van de gehele keuken en het opslaan van geleverde goederen.
  • Je draagt actief bij aan het verbeteren van de kwaliteit, denkt mee over optimalisaties en helpt bij het samenstellen en aanpassen van menukaarten, recepturen en bereidingsinstructies.
  • Je bent een echte teamspeler, stelt je flexibel op en beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden.
  • Je hebt een afgeronde MBO-3 opleiding (of vergelijkbaar), met aantoonbare kennis met basis kooktechnieken.

jobs.description:
SVENSKA

Är du vår nästa kock?

Vi är en restaurangverksamhet med fokus på modern asiatisk mat. Nu söker vi en engagerad kock med intresse för asiatisk matlagning som vill bli en del av vårt team i Malmö.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som tycker om att arbeta med asiatisk mat och trivs i ett kök med högt tempo. Du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och arbetar effektivt både självständigt och tillsammans med andra.

Arbetsuppgifterna består bland annat av:

    Tillagning och förberedelse av asiatiska rätter
    

    Förberedelse av råvaror och mise en place
    

    Matlagning efter våra recept och rutiner
    

    Säkerställa kvalitet, smak och presentation
    

    Hålla köket rent och organiserat
    

    Samarbeta med övriga kollegor för att ge våra gäster en bra upplevelse

Tidigare erfarenhet av asiatisk matlagning är meriterande, men det viktigaste för oss är att du är engagerad, arbetsvillig och vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Tillsvidareanställning
    

    Heltid
    

    Fast månadslön
    

    Arbete både vardagar och helger
    

    Ett trevligt och engagerat team
    

    Möjlighet att utvecklas inom verksamheten

ENGLISH

Are you our next chef?

We are a restaurant business focusing on modern Asian cuisine. We are now looking for a motivated chef with an interest in Asian cooking to join our team in Malmö.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with Asian food and feels comfortable in a fast-paced kitchen environment. You are responsible, organised and able to work efficiently both independently and as part of a team.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Preparing and cooking Asian dishes
    

    Preparing ingredients and mise en place
    

    Cooking according to our recipes and routines
    

    Maintaining high standards of quality, taste and presentation
    

    Keeping the kitchen clean and organised
    

    Working together with the team to provide our guests with a great experience

Previous experience with Asian cuisine is an advantage, but most importantly, we are looking for someone who is motivated, hardworking and willing to learn and develop with us.

What we offer

    Permanent employment
    

    Full-time position
    

    Fixed monthly salary
    

    Work on both weekdays and weekends
    

    A friendly and supportive team
    

    Opportunities to develop within the business

TIẾNG VIỆT

Bạn có phải là đầu bếp tiếp theo của chúng tôi?

Chúng tôi là một hệ thống nhà hàng đang phát triển với định hướng ẩm thực châu Á hiện đại. Hiện tại chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm một đầu bếp yêu thích ẩm thực châu Á để gia nhập đội ngũ của chúng tôi tại Malmö.

Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm ai?

Chúng tôi tìm kiếm một người yêu thích công việc bếp và có hứng thú với ẩm thực châu Á. Bạn có tinh thần trách nhiệm, làm việc gọn gàng, nhanh nhẹn và có khả năng làm việc cả độc lập lẫn cùng đồng đội trong môi trường nhà hàng có nhịp độ nhanh.

Công việc bao gồm:

    Chuẩn bị và chế biến các món ăn châu Á
    

    Sơ chế và chuẩn bị nguyên liệu
    

    Nấu ăn theo công thức và quy trình của nhà hàng
    

    Đảm bảo chất lượng, hương vị và cách trình bày món ăn
    

    Giữ khu vực bếp sạch sẽ và ngăn nắp
    

    Phối hợp với đồng nghiệp để mang đến trải nghiệm tốt cho khách hàng

Có kinh nghiệm về ẩm thực châu Á là một lợi thế. Tuy nhiên, điều quan trọng nhất là bạn chăm chỉ, có trách nhiệm, ham học hỏi và muốn phát triển lâu dài cùng chúng tôi.

Chúng tôi cung cấp

    Việc làm lâu dài
    

    Toàn thời gian
    

    Lương cố định hàng tháng
    

    Làm việc cả ngày thường và cuối tuần
    

    Môi trường làm việc thân thiện
    

    Cơ hội học hỏi và phát triển trong công việc

jobs.description:
Notre client est un groupe hôtelier à taille humaine, multi-enseignes, exploitant plusieurs établissements sous franchises Accor et Louvre Hotels Group en France.
Nous recherchons pour un de leur établissement situé en région lyonnaise, leur futur :

Directeur d'hôtel H/F
CDI - Statut Cadre
Basé à Lyon
Plus de 150 chambres - Hôtellerie économique
Encadrement d'une 20aine de personnes

Vos motivations :
Vous souhaitez relever un véritable challenge de direction au sein d'un actif hôtelier à fort potentiel. Vous appréciez les environnements où tout reste à construire, où votre impact est visible et où les résultats dépendent directement de votre capacité à mobiliser les équipes et à mettre en œuvre des actions concrètes.
Vous aimez les postes terrain, avec une forte dimension opérationnelle, commerciale et managériale. Vous recherchez une structure à taille humaine vous laissant une réelle autonomie dans vos décisions tout en bénéficiant du soutien d'un groupe solide.

Vos missions :
Rattaché à la Direction des Exploitations, votre mission principale consiste à redonner une dynamique de performance à cet actif stratégique du groupe en activant l'ensemble des leviers opérationnels, commerciaux et humains.
- Développement commercial : définir et piloter le plan d'action commercial, développer les partenariats locaux, renforcer la visibilité de l'établissement, optimiser le mix clientèle et contribuer à l'amélioration durable du chiffre d'affaires.
- Revenue management et performance : En relation avec le revenue manager du groupe, suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (taux d'occupation, prix moyen, RevPAR, GOP), analyser les résultats, identifier les axes d'amélioration et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires.
- Management : recruter, encadrer, accompagner et fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs. Développer une culture de la performance, de l'engagement et de la satisfaction client.
- Exploitation : garantir le bon fonctionnement quotidien, veiller au respect des standards de marque, assurer la qualité de service et maintenir un haut niveau de satisfaction client.
- Gestion sociale : accompagner les évolutions organisationnelles du site et assurer un dialogue social constructif dans un contexte d'internalisation récente des équipes de ménage.
- Pilotage économique : élaborer et suivre les budgets, optimiser les charges d'exploitation et garantir la rentabilité des établissements.

Votre profil :
Issu d'une formation en hôtellerie, tourisme ou gestion, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative en direction d'hôtel ou en direction adjointe au sein d'établissements à forte capacité.
- Vous êtes reconnu pour votre forte orientation résultats et votre capacité à développer l'activité commerciale d'un établissement. Véritable manager de terrain, vous savez mobiliser les équipes, accompagner le changement et créer une dynamique positive dans des contextes exigeants.
- Doté d'une excellente culture opérationnelle, vous maîtrisez les enjeux de rentabilité, de revenue management et de satisfaction client. Vous faites preuve d'autonomie, de leadership et d'une forte capacité d'analyse.

jobs.title: Geotechnical Geologist to Gruvteknik
jobs.description:
Do you want to use your geological and geotechnical expertise to solve meaningful challenges in one of the world's most advanced underground mining environments? At LKAB, you will contribute to sustainable mining together with experienced colleagues in a supportive, international team where collaboration, learning and long-term development are central.

The sustainable transformation begins with us

We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transform. So that we can live the lives we want, both today and tomorrow. In the same way that we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally.

Would you like to be part of laying the foundation for the way we live – and for the world around us?

Your role

As a Geotechnical Geologist, you will help build and develop the geotechnical understanding that supports safe, sustainable and future-oriented underground mining. You will work with data collection, geological and geotechnical modelling, technical studies and project development, always in close cooperation with colleagues from different specialist areas. The role gives you the opportunity to contribute with your expertise while continuing to learn from others across geology, rock mechanics, seismology, numerical modelling and project management. 

In the role, you will for example: 

    Coordinate geotechnical data acquisition, modelling and model application
    Plan and budget drilling programs in collaboration with relevant stakeholders
    Create, maintain and improve geotechnical models
    Contribute to technical studies and reporting
    Participate in infrastructure and mining development projects
    Collaborate with consultants and internal stakeholders on critical mining studies

What you bring

We are looking for someone who enjoys analysing complex information and translating it into useful insights. You work in a structured way, take initiative when needed and value working together with others. You communicate clearly, ask questions when something needs to be understood more deeply and are motivated by contributing to solutions that make a difference for both operations and people. 

To be eligible for the role, you need to have: 

    A Master of Science degree in Mining Engineering, Engineering Geology, Geology or another related field.
    Experience from exploration geology or engineering geology.
    Experience from underground mining environments.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken; proficiency in Swedish is highly desirable.
    A valid driving license equivalent to Swedish category B.

It is also an advantage if you have:

    Experience with geotechnical logging and modelling, preferably using Leapfrog.
    Experience with geotechnical databases, such as AcQuire, Imago or Imdex.
    Knowledge of rock mass characterization systems.
    Experience with technical report writing and working with large geotechnical datasets.

We encourage applications from candidates whose experience may not align with every listed requirement but who are enthusiastic about the opportunity, passionate about the industry and confident in their ability to succeed in the role.

What we offer

In addition to the general benefits we offer — which you can find a bit further down — we can also offer the following to those who do not currently live in Sweden:

    Relocation support for you and your family.
    Excellent conditions for settling in. We guide you through the official procedures necessary to settle in the country if you come from outside Sweden. We also provide temporary accommodation for a reasonable period and help you find a permanent place to live according to your personal needs.
    LKAB helps you learn Swedish, a tool for a better understanding of Swedish culture.
    The Swedish vacation law entitles all employees to five weeks of vacation per year, and four consecutive weeks during June, July, or August. Your contract may include extra vacation days.

Additional information

We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we usually do not request cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your skills and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible.

jobs.title: Quantitative Risk Analyst, Credit Risk Data Management
jobs.employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
jobs.description:
Job ID: 5814

We are looking for Quantitative Risk Analyst [Assistant/Regular/Senior] from all background and level to join our Risk Models Data and Strategy teams that is recognized for its professionalism, competence and capabilities.

Do you enjoy working with data analysis? Do you like solving problems and finding new and innovative solutions? Do you understand the principles of banking and are you able to apply this knowledge in your daily work?

If you have previous experience with Credit Risk models, then great! If you have a flair for data and a genuine interest in analysis, you are also welcome!

About our team

Meet the Credit Risk Data Management, a part of the Risk Models Data & Strategy organization in Risk Models. We have an ambitious development plan for development of IRB models and together with our colleagues in Nordea we’ll be part of creating the future of banking.

The Risk Models Data & Strategy department, is a department consisting of 6 team, each specialized in their own part of ensuring high quality data is supporting the bank capital foundation. We add value to Nordea and our customers by improving Nordea data quality, helping visualizing and create the understanding of our data so modelling teams can build great internal models used for Own Funds calculation and the for risk management.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What you’ll be doing

As a Quantitative Risk Analyst, the specific role may vary based on qualifications, but you could i.e. play a valuable role in Data analytics, optimizing data flows, product management or as a data governance specialist. Your role could also include coordinating data related activities and ensuring proper communication within the teams and across other Risk Models areas.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Root-cause analysis for data quality issues, where we meticulously investigate and identify the underlying reasons for any discrepancies in our data. This is closely followed by data reconciliation, ensuring that our data sets are consistent and accurate across different sources.
    We focus on optimizing data flows and algorithms to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our data processes.
    Own and manage all data used in credit risk models across the end-to-end lifecycle, applying data product mindset to capture, enhance and realize value throughout credit risk models.
    Identify and govern critical data elements though strong knowledge of credit risk models, regulatory expectation and capital.
    Secure our Data Governance framework and processes with focus on effective Data Quality Controls, also ensuring documentation of Data Lineage toward all data providers and consumers for credit risk data.
    Preparing reports and other documentation for senior management and external reporting is also an integral part of our role, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.

You’ll join an international team with variety of backgrounds and skills. We believe that strong drive and passion for change are fundamental for delivering on our commitments. Bring your background and skills to our team, and you will have plenty of opportunities to collaborate, grow and develop.

Who you are

This is the right role for you if you:

    Have an adaptability to thrive in fast-paced and dynamic environment.
    Are structured and able to coordinate several deliveries simultaneously.
    Are self-driven and able to work independently but also enjoy collaboration with others.

jobs.title: Communication and Coordination Office
jobs.description:
Company description:

"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."

Job description:





Who we are looking for



We’re looking for a colleague who can take a leading role in employee communication for Reman+, helping translate strategy, change, and key initiatives into clear messages, effective channels, and meaningful dialogue across the organization. The role combines communication ownership with administrative support, ensuring that leaders and teams stay aligned, prepared, and able to move priorities forward in a structured way.







What you will do



Your days will be varied and dynamic, with employee communication at the heart of the role. You’ll develop, distribute, and manage communication content and channels that build understanding of our mission, strategy, policies, performance, and key company-wide or function-specific initiatives. You’ll support leaders with clear messaging, communicative leadership, and change communication, while also creating opportunities for employee feedback and dialogue.







In addition, you’ll provide structured administrative support such as meeting preparation, presentation and document support and practical planning for leadership activities, events, workshops and site reviews. More examples of what you can expect to fill your days with:








    Work actively with both the assistant network and communications networks to strengthen alignment, share information, and enable effective collaboration across the organization.
    Provide administrative assistance and support to the Head of Reman+ (manage calendar, travel arrangements, coordinate meetings across time zones, etc…)
    Assist with administrative tasks that help keep the team focused and effective
    Plan, coordinate and support the management team in preparing site reviews, regional reviews, leadership meetings and any communication events
    Prepare and refine presentations, reports, and other documents.
    Create and manage employee communication channels such as email distribution lists, online communities, intranet content, newsletters, and social media tools.
    Develop and distribute company communications related to strategy, organizational updates and other key initiatives.
    Coach and train leaders in communicative leadership and change management to strengthen engagement and understanding of corporate direction.











Who you are



You are curious, proactive, and confident in taking ownership. You bring structure to complexity, build trust through clear communication, and enjoy connecting people, ideas, and information to create engagement and momentum.







You collaborate easily across levels and cultures, adapt your style to different audiences, and stay steady when priorities shift. With a positive, solution-oriented mindset, you are eager to learn, quick to adopt new tools, and motivated by finding smarter ways of working together.







What you bring



To succeed in this role, you’ll need experience in employee communication, typically gained through education and around 5 years or more of relevant experience. Experience in communicative leadership, change communication, internal communication channels, and stakeholder management is important. Strong organizational and time-management skills are also essential, as the role includes elements of senior administrative support. You should be comfortable working with Microsoft Office and other productivity and communication tools.



Fluency in English and Swedish is required, and additional languages are a bonus.
