En del af arbejdet udføres på tværs af projekter, hvor du vil få ansvaret for leverancerne heri, som bl.a. indbefatter dialog med industrien.  

Du får til opgave at planlægge og afvikle forskellige klyngeaktiviteter, lige fra mindre netværksmøder til større konferencer. Klyngeaktiviteterne skal hjælpe CenSecs medlemmer med at få ny viden, skabe samarbejde på tværs og øge medlemmernes kommercielle udvikling. Aktiviteterne har både nationalt og internationalt fokus. 

Udover arbejdet med klyngeaktiviteterne får du til opgave at rekruttere nye medlemmer, være kontaktperson for medlemsvirksomheder og deltage i interne udviklingsopgaver- og processer.  

Arbejdet med udvikling af klyngen omfatter også en del administration, opgaver relateret til formidling og kommunikation, samt samarbejde med andre aktører i det forsvarsindustrielle økosystem på både nationalt og europæisk niveau.  

 

Din profil 

Der kan være mange indgangsvinkler til denne stilling, og vi stiller derfor ikke krav til en særlig baggrund. Vigtigst er det at du er en “do’er”, som har vilje og evne til at omsætte input og viden til konkret værdi for vores medlemmer og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi forventer en høj grad af selvstændighed og professionalisme, og at du kan varetage det ansvar og mandat, der medfølger at være ansat i den nationale klyngeorganisation for forsvarsindustrien. 

Derudover er du ekstrovert, kommunikativt stærk, omstillingsparat, fleksibel og taler og skriver engelsk på højt niveau. 

 

Vi tilbyder 

En betydningsfuld rolle i en internationalt anerkendt klyngeorganisation, som skaber innovation, vækst og arbejdspladser. Du får opgaver og muligheder, der medfører faglig og personlig udvikling i et internationalt miljø med ansvar efter evner og ambitioner.  

Dine kollegaer er ambitiøse, humoristiske og uformelle, og trods forskellige ansvarsområder, arbejder vi sammen som et team og hjælper hinanden.  

Vi tilbyder en fleksibel arbejdsuge med to ugentlige fremmødedage på vores kontor i Viborg og hjemmearbejde de resterende ugedage.  

 

Arbejdstid og løn m.m. 

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer ugentligt på funktionærvilkår. 

I forbindelse med projekt- og klyngeaktiviteter i ind- og udland vil der være nogen rejseaktivitet, som altid aftales på forhånd og i god tid. 

Løn efter kvalifikationer og evner til at skabe værdi for CenSec. 

 

Læs mere om CenSec her: www.censec.dk  

 

Om CenSec 

CenSec er Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed.  

Som national klynge er vores mandat at samle og styrke hele økosystemet, heriblandt virksomheder, videninstitutioner og myndigheder. 

Vi har en dyb forståelse af økosystemet og en dybdegående viden om vores medlemmer. Vores ambition er at være et omdrejningspunkt hvor alle aktører ser os som den primære drivkraft til at fremme samarbejde på tværs og øge innovation i industrien.  
  
Vi er en tillidsbaseret og stærk medlemsorganisation. Siden 2004 har vi arbejdet for at styrke netværk, samarbejds- og forretningsmuligheder på tværs af sektorer og grænser, gennem facilitering af nationale og internationale netværksaktiviteter.  
  
CenSec – skaber innovation, vækst og robusthed for Danmark.  

  

Ansøgning 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kontakt venligst Anders Laustsen, på tlf. 52 13 15 42 eller skriv til anders@censec.dk  

Vi ser frem til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning og CV til samme mailadresse snarest muligt og senest den 27. september 2026. 

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes gennemført løbende med henblik på ansættelse hurtigst muligt. Vi forbeholder os ret til at ansætte før deadline, hvis vi finder den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: Handicaphjælper på deltid i Ballerup
jobs.description:
Vi søger én eller flere hjælper(e) til vores 19-årige søn, der har en udviklingsforstyrrelse. Han har begrænset sprog og kan til tider være udadreagerende, men han er en glad ung mand, når han trives. Han er aktiv, elsker at være udendørs, er følsom og åben over for alle slags mennesker.

Din kerneopgave er at skabe ro, tryghed og struktur omkring ham og støtte igennem dagens rutiner.

Arbejdsopgaver

·         Støtte til måltider og drikke, hjælp til personlig pleje efter behov

·         Guidning i simple øvelser og hverdagsaktiviteter med fokus på pauser, forudsigelighed og overskuelighed

·         Tage med på ture i haven eller køreture i naturen (Vi har bil til dette)

·         Low arousal-tilgang: dæmpe uro, forebygge og afværge konflikter, hjælpe ham tilbage i ro

·         Skabe struktur i dagen og følge aftalte strategier

·         Korte, enkle notater/overlevering til familien efter vagter

Du bliver en del af et fagligt og professionelt team bestående af andre aflastere samt en supervisor. Pasningen foregår i Ballerup.

 

Vagtbehov og fleksibilitet

• Vagter på 3–4 timer og op til 8–10 timer inden for tidsrummet kl. 12–22
• Størst behov på hverdage kl. 12–17
• Fleksibel planlægning – du kan selv byde ind på tidspunkter

Hvem er du?

·         Rolig, tålmodig og stabil – du bevarer overblikket, også når han bliver urolig

·         Struktureret og forudsigelig – du kan skabe genkendelige rutiner

·         Tydelig og enkel kommunikation – kort, konkret og venlig

·         Respektfuld og tillidsvækkende

·         Robust og ansvarlig – kan håndtere stressreaktioner og holde fokus på sikkerhed

·         God til samarbejde

·         Mandlige ansøgere foretrækkes

jobs.title: HVAC Design Engineer - Offshore Substations; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
jobs.description:
Are you a Mechanical Engineer with HVAC design experience and a passion for creating robust technical solutions? Do you want to design HVAC systems for offshore substations supporting some of the world's largest renewable energy projects? Then this could be your next opportunity.

Your Position

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Mechanical Engineer with experience in HVAC system design to strengthen our HVAC team.

In your new position as HVAC Engineer in the Renewables division, you will join our experienced Mechanical & HVAC team. You will design and engineer HVAC systems for offshore substations and work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, clients, suppliers, procurement, fabrication yards and commissioning teams.

You will contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from concept and tender work through detailed design, procurement, construction support and commissioning. Your work will help create robust, safe and efficient HVAC solutions for complex offshore installations.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either Esbjerg, Nordhavn or Gdynia. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In this role, you will primarily work on EPCI (Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Installation) contracts for offshore substation projects.

Typical responsibilities include developing HVAC design solutions and technical documentation for offshore substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Design, Engineering & System Integration: Designing ventilation, cooling, heating and pressurization systems, including calculations and equipment sizing.
  • Developing HVAC philosophies, specifications, diagrams, technical requisitions and other project documentation.
  • Compliance, HSE & Quality Assurance: Ensure full compliance with applicable standards, codes, and regulatory requirements, while supporting and adhering to health, safety, and environmental standards in all activities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Specifying HVAC equipment and supporting procurement, bid evaluation, vendor follow-up and document review.
  • Coordinating technical interfaces with electrical, structural, piping, fire protection and control system disciplines, and participating in client meetings and design reviews.
  • Supporting fabrication, testing and commissioning activities, including FATs, SATs and site support when required, while adhering to health, safety and environmental standards.

Your profile & qualifications

We are looking for a structured and solution-oriented Mechanical Engineer who is passionate about HVAC design and wants to make a personal contribution to offshore renewable energy projects. You collaborate effectively across disciplines, communicate clearly and take ownership of your engineering deliverables.
We are looking for an outgoing and positive professional who is passionate about renewable energy and wants to leave their personal mark on it. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work and are eager to help innovate the future of sustainable solutions

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience with HVAC engineering and design, preferably from industrial, marine, energy or offshore projects.
  • Knowledge of ventilation, cooling, refrigeration, heating and pressurization systems, including DX and water-based cooling solutions.
  • Experience with technical documentation, equipment specifications and coordination in multidisciplinary EPC projects; offshore substation, offshore wind, marine or industrial plant experience is considered a strong advantage.
  • Professional English communication skills and a strong commitment to teamwork, quality and safety.
  • A strong focus on quality and safety, demonstrated through attention to detail and adherence to HSE requirements.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
For questions, contact Rafid Kajo, Manager, Mechanical & HVAC, at +45 7916 6867 or +45 3016 6613

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Johtava sosiaalityöntekijä, Soihtu, Salo
jobs.description:
Tehtäväsi

Johtavana sosiaalityöntekijänä toimit Asiakasohjaus Soihdun itäisen alueen tiimin lähiesihenkilönä. Vastaat Salon, Salon poliisiasemalla toimivan Ankkuri-toiminnan sekä Paimion toimipisteiden henkilöstön esihenkilötyöstä ja toiminnan kehittämisestä.

Asiakasohjaus Soihtu vastaanottaa ja käsittelee kaikki alle 65-vuotiaiden sosiaalihuoltolain ja lastensuojelulain mukaiset ilmoitukset ja yhteydenotot uusien asiakkaiden kohdalla sekä toteuttaa palvelutarpeen arviointia. Lisäksi Soihtu arvioi ja toteuttaa kiireellisiä lastensuojelun tukitoimia.

Tehtävässäsi toimit moniammatillisen yhteistyön asiantuntijana ja rakennat toimivia yhteistyökäytäntöjä eri viranomaisten, kuntien ja järjestötoimijoiden kanssa. Vastaat osaltasi työn sisällön ja yhteistyöverkostojen kehittämisestä sekä huolehdit sujuvasta yhteistyöstä eri toimijoiden välillä. Tehtävä voi sisältää tarvittaessa myös asiakastyötä.

Toiminta-alueeseen kuuluvat Salo, Somero, Paimio ja Sauvo. Vakituiset toimipisteet sijaitsevat Salossa ja Paimiossa, minkä lisäksi teemme jalkautuvaa työtä alueen muihin kuntiin.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Pääset osaksi sitoutunutta, kokenutta ja moniammatillista työyhteisöä, jossa työtä tehdään yhdessä asiakkaiden parhaaksi.

Salon Soihtu-tiimissä työskentelee johtavan sosiaalityöntekijän lisäksi kahdeksan sosiaalityöntekijää, kuusi sosiaaliohjaajaa sekä sairaanhoitaja. Tiimin tukena toimii myös vakituinen perheterapeutti vahvistamassa systeemistä työotetta.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vaikuttavan tehtävän, jossa pääset hyödyntämään johtamisosaamistasi, kehittämään palveluita sekä tukemaan henkilöstön työhyvinvointia ja ammatillista onnistumista. Etsimme tiimille esihenkilöä, joka johtaa työtä positiivisella sykkeellä ja innostaa myös muita onnistumaan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Toivomme sinulta vahvaa kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä sekä laaja-alaista sosiaali- ja lastensuojelupalveluiden osaamista. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää hyviä esihenkilö- ja johtamistaitoja, vahvaa sosiaalihuollon lainsäädännön tuntemusta sekä kykyä itsenäiseen päätöksentekoon.

Arvostamme erityisesti kykyä tukea vaativaa asiakastyötä, edistää työhyvinvointia sekä ylläpitää myönteistä ja kannustavaa työilmapiiriä. Lisäksi odotamme sinulta erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja moniammatillisessa toimintaympäristössä sekä valmiutta toimia muuttuvassa ja nopeatempoisessa työssä.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (817/2015) 7 §:n mukainen kelpoisuus tehtävään. Lisäksi tehtävässä edellytetään erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa ja tyydyttävää ruotsin kielen taitoa.

jobs.title: Internal Controls System Specialist Nordics
jobs.description:
Want to make a real impact on how risks are managed and how financial performance is reported? As an ICS Specialist, you will work across the organization to identify risks, strengthen internal controls, and drive improvements that safeguard our assets and ensure high-quality financial reporting. This position is primarily based in Finland. However, for the right candidate, other group locations may be considered. The salary for this position ranges between 3900 – 4600 EUR/month. The final salary will be determined based on the selected candidates skills and experience.

In this role, you will be responsible for establishing and developing an effective Internal Control System (ICS) in an international environment. You will work closely with the Group Internal Control function, finance teams and internal and external auditors, ensuring that processes, controls, and compliance requirements are implemented correctly across the group.

**What youll do:**

- Developing Internal Control System (ICS) for all Nordic companies according to the group guidelines

- Ensuring Segregation of Duties (SoD), including review and monitoring of critical authorizations in ERP systems

- Conducting internal controls and audits (reviews, sampling, process analyses, documentation audits)

- Identifying financial risks and deriving and tracking appropriate measures

- Training and consulting finance teams on ICS standards, compliance requirements and process quality

- Preparing reports, audit follow-ups, and management updates

- Liaising with internal and external auditors


**What were looking for:**

- Masters degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field.

- 3-5 years experience in Internal Controls, Audit, Finance or Risk Management.

- Experience in an industrial sector or manufacturing is preferred

- Proficiency in ERP systems and MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint); Tagetik and Qlik Sense are a plus.

- Fluency in English.


**Y**ou are a proactive and detail-oriented professional who enjoys balancing risk with business growth. Collaboration comes naturally to you - you build strong relationships across teams and are comfortable influencing stakeholders. If youre passionate about continuous improvement and have a knack for spotting trends and opportunities, youll fit right in.

**What we can offer you:**

- Diverse tasks and varied workdays

jobs.title: Lärare inom småbarnspedagogik till Folkhälsans daghem i Hyvinge
jobs.description:
På Folkhälsan jobbar vi tillsammans för en god vardag för små och stora. Vi är en hälsofrämjande organisation och en familjevänlig arbetsplats, som arbetsgivare är vi flexibla och pålitliga. Vi jobbar aktivt för jämlikhet, värdesätter mångfald på vår arbetsplats och uppmuntrar personer med olika bakgrund och som tillhör olika minoriteter att söka jobb hos oss. Kom och jobba med oss!

Folkhälsan Välfärd Ab rekryterar en lärare inom småbarnspedagogik

till daghemmet i Hyvinge för en tillsvidareanställning. Arbetet är på heltid och inleds enligt överenskommelse under hösten 2026.

Hyvinge daghem är beläget centralt i Hyvinge med parker och natur på gångavstånd. Vi finns i samma byggnad som Svenska skolan i Hyvinge och har ett aktivt samarbete samt möjlighet att använda både gymnastiksal och slöjdsal i vår verksamhet. Tillsammans med Svenska skolan i Hyvinge bildar vi en helhet där barnens lärstig fortsätter naturligt från småbarnspedagogiken till grundläggande utbildningen. Välkommen att jobba för en svenskspråkig helhet på en språkö!

Vi erbjuder småbarnspedagogik och förskoleundervisning samt språkbadsinriktad verksamhet. Du tar dig smidigt till daghemmet med tåg eller buss.

Som lärare inom småbarnspedagogik ansvarar du för och planerar den pedagogiska verksamheten. Arbetet sker i en miljö med kunniga pedagoger samt andra sakkunniga. Du är teamledare för ditt arbetsteam. På daghemmet arbetar vi i enlighet med Grunderna för planen för småbarnspedagogik samt Folkhälsans handbok. Vi erbjuder dig en arbetsplats där du har möjlighet att påverka och utveckla ditt arbete. Förmågor så som kreativitet, samarbetsvilja, flexibilitet, kommunikation och hälsofrämjande arbetssätt värderas hos oss.

Behörighetsvillkor är behörighet enligt lagen om småbarnspedagogik (540/2018) eller enligt rådande övergångsbestämmelse (75 §): pedagogie kandidat (lärare inom småbarnspedagogik), lämplig yrkeshögskoleexamen eller tidigare motsvarande examen på institutnivå, t.ex. barnträdgårdslärare eller socialpedagog.

Vi erbjuder dig en inkluderande arbetsgemenskap där alla stöder varandra. Du får tillgång till olika personalförmåner (bl.a. företagshälsovård via Mehiläinen och ePassi-förmån) för att du skall må bra i ditt arbete, samt utbildningsdagar och sektorsspecifika utbildningar i Eduhouse för att få goda förutsättningar för att utvecklas professionellt. Lön enligt kollektivavtalet för den privata småbarnspedagogiken med möjlighet till personliga tillägg.
Den som väljs till arbetet bör uppvisa utdrag ur straffregistret enligt 6 § 2 mom. i straffregisterlagen samt tuberkulosutredning enligt 55 § i lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar. Folkhälsan är en rökfri arbetsplats.

Läs mer om oss här: [Hyvinge daghem - Folkhälsan](https://www.folkhalsan.fi/service/daghem/hyvinge-daghem) och följ oss gärna på Instagram för att se mer av vår verksamhet: [@hyvingedagis](https://www.instagram.com/hyvingedagis/)

För närmare information om jobbet kan du kontakta enhetschef Anna Holmgren per e-post, anna.holmgren@folkhalsan.fi , eller per telefon, +358 44 788 3670.

Använd gärna det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret när du skickar in din ansökan. Vi intervjuar under ansökningstiden och platsen fylls genast då lämplig person hittas.

Vi ser fram emot att få höra mer om dig!

jobs.title: Math Modeler
jobs.description:
The team of Wärtsilä marine engineering simulators is looking forMath Modeller. You can become part of a team which works on a market leader product (45% market share) that imitates marine engineering functionality for vessels. The preferred location for this position is Helsinki, Finland but also Turku, Finland is negotiable. We offer a possibility to hybrid work.

Main responsibilities:
* Develop from the scratch for dynamic math models of vessel equipment and systems.
* Create front-end side of simulators.
* Compile technical documentation for these models.
* Maintain existing models.
* Take a part in agile activities.


To be successful in this position, we expect you to:
* Bs or MS in physics, applied math, engineering or similar field.
* Practical experience in imitation modelling of physical systems.
* Basic knowledge of numerical methods for solving PDE and DAE.
* Basic knowledge of OOP approach or any OOP language.
* Be able to formulate a problem correctly and plan ways to solve it.
* English intermediate or higher.
* Be agile.


We will be amazed if you have (but not mandatory):
* Be familiar with Open Modelica or any Modelica-based language.
* Be able to quickly master new tools.
* Have a background in marine engineering.


Practical experience in imitation modelling required in one of the areas:
* Hydraulics (gravity flow, pumping through pipeline, pump characteristics, pipeline elements resistance, Bernoulli equation, two-phase media flow (liquid + gas)).
* Heat Transfer (heat capacity of materials – solid, liquids, gases; heat exchange between various media; temperature transfer & temperature resistance of materials).
* Thermodynamics (ideal gas laws; real gas specifics; main thermodynamics parameters and characteristics, its interdependencies; thermodynamics laws; phase transitions).
* Mechanics (kinematics and dynamics of rigid body, rotational dynamics equations; mechanical energy parameters and equations, mechanical energy transitions, inertia characteristics; simple mechanisms).
* Automation and regulation (main principals and parameters; governors (controllers) – main types and work principals; controlled system parameters and dynamic).


Why you and us?
We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership and taking responsibility of our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have courage to see opportunities and take initiative.
We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe in that by being your own true self you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?
We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.

Contact and next steps

We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.
Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!

jobs.title: Student Research Assistant (Amanuens)
jobs.description:
We have the power of over 50,000 students and co-workers. Students who provide hope for the future. Co-workers who contribute to Linköping University meeting challenges of today. Our fundamental values rest on credibility, trust and security. By having the courage to think freely and innovate, our actions together, large and small, contribute to a better world. We look forward to receiving your application!

Are you interested in working with communication, outreach and events related to development research? We are looking to hire a student assistant (amanuens) to work with the secretariat of the Swedish Development Research Network (SweDev).

The position

SweDev was founded in 2019 and is a network that connects development researchers across Sweden in order to strengthen collaboration within the research community and to increase interaction between development researchers and practitioners.

Duties for a student assistant can include teaching, administration or participation in research or artistic research. The duties for this position will focus on assisting the SweDev secretariat by maintaining the website, communicating within and outside the network, co-organising and disseminating information about events, monitoring relevant activities and new research findings, and participating in the regular meetings of SweDev's executive committee and steering group.

The person we need

For employment as an amanuens, you must be admitted to higher education at undergraduate or advanced (master's) level.

The person we need is a strong communicator who works independently, is well organised, collaborates well and has an interest in working with digital communication.

The following education, experience and expertise are required:

    experience in development studies, environmental science or political science (Bachelor's degree or ongoing master's studies)
    knowledge of Swedish development cooperation and development-related research
    proficiency in English, spoken and written.

In addition, the following education, experience and expertise will strengthen an application:

    experience of managing social media and/or a website for an organization, or similar experience
    earlier experience of working in the development sector, in Sweden or abroad
    interest in development research and SweDev's work.

The workplace

From the autumn of 2026, SweDev's secretariat will be hosted at https://liu.se/en/organisation/liu/tema – Environmental Change and the Centre for Climate Science and Policy Research (CSPR) at Linköping University.

More information about the activities at the department and unit can be found at https://liu.se/organisation/liu/tema/temam

The employment

The employment is a fixed-term position with a scope of 20 per cent of full-time for up to one year, with possible extension. Starting date as agreed.

An employment as an amanuens is regulated in Chapter 5 of the Higher Education Ordinance.

Salary and employment benefits

Salary according to LiU's central agreement on teaching assistans salaries.

More information about employee benefits is available https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/employee-benefits.

Union representatives

Information about union representatives, see https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/hjalp%20for%20sokande.

Application procedure

Apply for the position by clicking the "Apply" button below. Your application must reach Linköping University no later than September 25, 2026.

Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered.

We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - diversity enriches our work and helps us grow. Preserving everybody's equal value, rights and opportunities is a natural part of who we are. Read more about our work with: https://liu.se/en/article/lika-villkor/.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Linköping university has framework agreements and wishes to decline direct contacts from staffing- and recruitment companies as well as vendors of job advertisements.

jobs.description:
Etsimme tiimiimme kunnossapitoasentajaa vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen

Tarjoamme monipuolisen tehtävän teollisen kunnossapidon parissa vastuullisessa, vakavaraisessa ja kehittyvässä yrityksessä.

Lähes 60 vuoden kokemuksella ja noin 120 ammattilaisen voimin valmistamme korkealaatuisia, puhtaita ja turvallisia tuotteita eri teollisuudenaloille. Kunnossapitoasentajana työtehtäväsi koostuvat erilaisista huolto-, kunnossapito- ja prosessin ylläpitotehtävistä. - Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa; englannin kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi

- Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen Honkajoki Oy:n kirjoilla

- Monipuolisen ja mielenkiintoisen työn alansa johtavassa yrityksessä

- Ammattitaitoisen, mukavan ja moniammatillisen työyhteisön

Tarjoamme


- ePassi

Honkajoki Oy

Honkajoki Oy on Suomen johtava eläinperäisten sivutuotteiden käsittelijä ja jalostaja. Suomessa muodostuu vuosittain arviolta noin 260 000 tonnia eläinperäisiä sivutuotteita. jobs.title: Secretary General of UArctic
jobs.description:
UArctic (University of the Arctic) is an international network of universities, colleges, research institutes, and other organizations committed to education, research, and collaboration in and about the Arctic. UArctic brings together members from across the circumpolar North and beyond to strengthen knowledge exchange, capacity building, and sustainable development.

The UArctic International Secretariat is hosted by the University of Lapland in Rovaniemi, Finland. We are now seeking a visionary and experienced leader to serve as Secretary General of UArctic and Head of the UArctic International Secretariat.

The Secretary General serves as the chief administrative officer and legal representative of UArctic and plays a key role in ensuring effective governance, strategic coordination, and organizational sustainability across the global UArctic network.

The position is located at the UArctic International Secretariat in Rovaniemi. The Secretary General reports to the President of UArctic, the UArctic Board of Governors, and the University of Lapland. UArctic is legally registered as an association in Finland (UArctic ry). Approximately 20% of the position is allocated to duties defined by the leadership of the University of Lapland.

What you will do

- Lead and oversee the day-to-day operations of the UArctic International Secretariat.

- Ensure the implementation of UArctic's Constitution, Bylaws, and strategic decisions made by the Board of Governors and the Assembly.

- Provide executive support to the President and Board in the preparation, coordination, and documentation of meetings, decisions, and initiatives.

- Lead UArctic together with the President, Executive Vice-President, and the Senior Executive Management Group.

- Facilitate communication and collaboration among UArctic governance bodies, including UArctic staff, member institutions, and external partners.

- Oversee member recruitment and member engagement processes.

- Support the implementation of UArctic's strategic objectives, particularly in governance, partnerships, and long-term sustainability.

- Represent UArctic in international forums and stakeholder relations.

- Serve as the principal legal officer of UArctic ry and ensure compliance with Finnish legislation, applicable international regulations, and UArctic governing documents.

- Act as authorized signatory of UArctic ry in official legal and contractual matters.

- Ensure responsible financial stewardship, including budget preparation, financial reporting, and oversight of internal controls.

What We Offer

We offer a unique opportunity to lead one of the most significant international higher education and knowledge networks focused on the Arctic region. You will work at the heart of international Arctic cooperation and contribute to strengthening research, education, and sustainable development across the circumpolar North and beyond.

What we expect from you

The successful candidate will have:

- An advanced degree in a relevant field.

- Proven leadership experience in an international, university-based, governmental, intergovernmental, or comparable organization.

- Strong knowledge of governance structures, legal frameworks, and financial administration.

- Excellent intercultural communication, negotiation, and diplomatic skills.

- Fluency in English.

- Proficiency in Finnish and in additional languages is considered an asset.

We also value:

- Familiarity with Arctic issues and northern cooperation networks.

- Demonstrated experience and success in supervisory and people leadership roles.

- Excellent collaboration, networking, and teamworking skills.

- The ability to lead complex international partnerships and stakeholder processes.

- Experience working in multicultural environments and across different sectors.

Further information on the position

For further information about the position, please contact Director of Internationalisation Services Mari Putaansuu (mari.putaansuu@ulapland.fi, +358 44 478 0249). Enquiries are welcome on 17 September 2026 between 9:00 and 10:00 (EEST) and on 22 September 2026 between 14:00 and 15:00 (EEST).

Address: Yliopistonkatu 8, 96300 ROVANIEMI
Duration of employment: permanent from March 2027 or as agreed
Work hours: full-time employment
Trial period: 6 months
Salary: The starting monthly salary level is approximately 7499-7693e. The salary is determined on the basis of level 14 for other expert and support staff, from the salary system of the general collective agreement for universities (Sivista). In addition, a salary component based on personal performance is paid, up to a maximum of 50%.

Appointment

The Secretary General is appointed by the leadership of the University of Lapland in collaboration with the UArctic Board of Governors, in accordance with the UArctic Constitution and Bylaws.

University of Lapland

The University of Lapland is an international science and art university located in the City of Rovaniemi on the Arctic Circle. Our university creates new knowledge, skills and competence from the arctic perspective – for the North and for the world. Our fields of education and research include educational science, law, art and design, social sciences, and northern and arctic perspectives. Our strategic choices focus on global arctic responsibility, sustainable tourism, future services and governing distances.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Why Doktor.se

Doktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. We combine physical clinics with a digital platform serving millions of consultations per year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. Our 25-person engineering team has startup autonomy inside a profitable, international organization with 1,000+ employees and over 1B SEK in revenue.

We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows, and that footprint is growing fast.

What you'll do

Our infrastructure works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We need someone who can help us get to where we want to be — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where everything is already figured out, this isn't it. If you want to build something better, here's what you'd own:

    

Build a deployment platform where teams ship their own services without asking you for permission.

    

Design infrastructure that is secure by default, so teams don't have to think about encryption, network isolation, or data residency. It just works.

    

Create deployment pipelines where security scanning, policy checks, and compliance happen automatically, invisible when everything is fine, loud when something needs attention.

    

Support and scale infrastructure for AI workloads, we run models in production across our platform, and that footprint is growing.

    

Set up observability that gives teams real insight into their own services, useful dashboards, alerts that mean something, not noise that everyone ignores.

    

Work closely with developers to understand what slows them down, and then fix it. Not by doing it for them, but by making it easy for them to do it themselves.

    

Maintain and evolve our cloud account structure, networking, and identity management across multiple regions and products.

Some weeks you'll write infrastructure code. Some weeks you'll pair with a developer to debug a slow service. Some weeks you'll design how a new product gets its own isolated infrastructure. The common thread: you make the teams around you better.

Make developers faster, not more dependent on you.

What we're looking for

    

You've built and operated Kubernetes in production. Not just deployed a Helm chart once, you've debugged networking issues, designed RBAC policies, and thought about how multiple teams share a cluster without stepping on each other.

    

You know AWS well. Accounts, networking, IAM, KMS. You have opinions about what should live in Kubernetes and what genuinely needs to be an AWS managed service, and you lean toward keeping things in Kubernetes where possible.

    

You've worked with GitOps and infrastructure as code. Flux, ArgoCD, Terrafor, specific tools matter less than the principle: infrastructure changes go through pull requests, are reviewed, and are auditable.

    

You understand developers because you are one. You can read their code, understand their pipelines, and have meaningful conversations about architecture.

    

You think about security as something you design into systems, not something you review at the end.

    

You have opinions, and you can change them when someone makes a better argument.

    

University degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.

Tech stack

Cloud - AWS (multi-account, multi-region)

Orchestration - Kubernetes / EKS

IaC - Terraform

CI/CD - GitHub Actions

Languages - Python, TypeScript

AI - OpenAI, Anthropic (in production and tooling)

Observability - Datadog / Grafana (you'll shape this)

What we offer

    

Real influence. You'll shape how our platform works, not just operate what someone else designed.

    

Healthcare context. Patient data, regulatory compliance, and real consequences for getting it wrong. What you build actually matters.

    

Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers, your work is visible, not lost in a machine.

    

Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.

    

AI in production. We're running LLMs in patient and clinician workflows today, the infrastructure needs to grow with that.

    

Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.

Practical details

    

Start: As soon as we find the right person. We'll accommodate your notice period.

    

Employment: Permanent, full-time. Six month probation period.

    

Location: On-site, Monday–Thursday at Sveavägen 63, Stockholm. Fridays are flexible.

    

Language: English is our working language in tech. Swedish is a bonus.

    

Work permit: You must already have the right to work in Sweden.

    

Contact: Karin Bergström, Head of Product and technology

We handle recruitment internally — no agencies, no consultants, no external recruiters.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
We ship more than we tell. New features and improvements go live faster than we manage to tell the world about them. That's the job.

Talentech is one brand today, built from several companies that came together over the past few years. You'll be our first dedicated Product Marketing Manager. There's no playbook to inherit. You'll create it.

Your main responsibility is to translate what we build into communication that drives both new business and deeper product adoption, from go-to-market campaigns that generate pipeline to in-app messages that help customers get real value.

 

What you'll do

  • Own and champion product marketing at Talentech: the strategy, the messaging, launch calendars across all products and markets, and the internal engagement to make it everyone's business
  • Run go-to-market for launches end to end: positioning, messaging, and the material sales needs to sell it
  • Turn launches, updates, and customer stories into content and campaigns that generate pipeline
  • Plan and write in-app communication with input from the product team, so customers actually find and use what we build
  • Set up ways of working that hold across products and markets without turning into bureaucracy

 

What a good first year looks like
There's a product marketing plan your colleagues understand. Launches follow a process that Product, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success actually use. Launches generate leads, and you can show it.

 

What we're looking for

  • You have a commercial mindset and 3+ years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience
  • You are pragmatic and create practical processes, connect product marketing to pipeline, and know when to scale a launch or keep it simple
  • You have hands-on experience with in-app messaging and product adoption campaigns, and can explain complex products clearly.
  • You can take a complex product and explain it simply, without losing what makes it good
  • You have strong English writing and speak at least one Scandinavian language fluently
  • You use AI every day and build your own automations for repetitive work.
     

Nice if you have

  • Experience with in-app messaging tools like Userflow or similar
  • Launched AI products before

 

Why Talentech?

Talentech is the leading HR tech provider in the Nordics, growing rapidly. With over 4,000 customers all over the world, we are serious about innovation and staying ahead, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. You'll join a friendly, collaborative team with high ambitions. We have a hybrid work model, with 2–3 days in the office and the rest you choose.

 

Sounds like your kind of place?

Apply today however you prefer (with or without CV, or with LinkedIn). We would like to fill the role as soon as possible, so don't wait until the last day to apply!

 

The details

Scope: Full-time

Location: We welcome applications from Denmark (Copenhagen), Norway (Oslo, Bodø), Sweden (Stockholm, Gothenburg, Lund, Trollhättan), Finland (Oulu, Helsinki).

Reporting to: Director of Innovation, in the product organization

 

Questions? Reach out to linus.andersson@talentech.com

jobs.description:
KotiAvustajat ovat palvelleet asiakkaita 15 vuoden ajan Seinäjoella ja vuosien varrella laajentaneet toimintaansa Alavudelle, Ilmajoelle, Kuortaneelle, Kaustiselle, Veteliin, Hausjärvelle, Hyvinkäälle, Körkölään, Mäntsälään, Riihimäelle, Lempäälään, Nokialle, Pirkkalaan, Sastamalaan, Tampereelle, Ylöjärvelle, Helsinkiin, Espooseen, Kauniaisiin ja Vantaalle

Haemme itsenäisiä KotiAvustaja - yrittäjiä ympäri Suomen, jotka toimivat yhteistyössä KotiAvustajien kanssa uniikin toimintamallin mukaisesti omalla asuinpaikkakunnallaan.

KotiAvustajana voit vaikuttaa omalla työlläsi siihen, että asuinpaikkakuntasi ikäihmiset saavat hyvää hoivaa ja huolenpitoa sekä konkreettista apua kotona asumiseen. KotiAvustajana autat ja huolehdit asiakkaan hyvinvoinnista antaen ohjausta terveydentilan ja toimintakyvyn ylläpitämiseksi. Kotikäynnit keskittyvät arkipäiviin ja sinulla on aikaa kohdata asiakas.

Kaikki KotiAvustajat toimivat uniikin KotiAvustajat® brändin mukaisesti, joka luo paremmat toimintaedellytykset yrityksellesi sekä mahdollisuuden kehittyä paremmaksi osaajaksi. Asiakkuudet ovat pääsääntöisesti pitkäkestoisia ja se tuo turvaa yrittäjyyteen. Sinulla on hyvät mahdollisuudet erittäin hyviin ansioihin, joka luonnollisesti riippuu sinusta ja aktiivisuudestasi.

Asiakastyötä tulet tekemään omalla persoonallasi ja täydellä sydämellä. Avoimuus, kyky kuunnella ja halu auttaa ovat tärkeimpiä ominaisuuksiasi. Lähtökohta toiminnallesi on hyvä asiakaspalvelu, jossa työtä teet aina asiakkaalle.

Sinulla on terveysalan koulutus (esim. sairaanhoitaja, terveydenhoitaja, toimintaterapeutti, farmaseutti, fysioterapeutti jne.), hygieniapassi, auto omaan käyttöön sekä hallitset erinomaisesti suomen kielen.

Saat yrittäjyyteen vankan tuen ja asiantuntevia neuvoja sekä ohjeita alkumetreiltä lähtien, "Liikkuvaan junaan" ja osaajien joukkoon on nyt helppo hypätä mukaan!

jobs.title: Resort Manager
jobs.description:
Sonka Resort, Finnish Lapland | Full-time, year-round | Start date: 1 October 2026

Sonka Resort is looking for an experienced and hands-on Resort Supervisor to coordinate daily operations, support the team and ensure a consistently high-quality guest experience. Part of Arctic GM Experiences, Sonka Resort combines accommodation, guest services and Arctic experiences in Finnish Lapland.

The Role

As Resort Supervisor, you will oversee the resorts daily activities across reception, housekeeping and maintenance. You will set daily priorities, delegate tasks, follow up on their completion and work alongside the team whenever needed.

You will handle routine operational matters independently, report to company management and coordinate with management on decisions involving budgets, purchases or other major matters.

Key responsibilities

\- Welcome and assist guests throughout their stay

\- Coordinate daily priorities and delegate tasks to the resort team

\- Follow up to ensure tasks and management assignments are completed

\- Support the team during busy periods and resolve day-to-day operational issues

\- Maintain high standards of guest service, cleanliness and resort presentation

\- Carry out regular property inspections and follow up on maintenance needs

\- Keep booking information, availability and guest-facing information accurate

\- Provide management with clear operational updates

\- Identify problems early, suggest practical solutions and improve daily routines

About You

We are looking for someone with hospitality experience, preferably within a hotel, resort or similar operation. You can take responsibility without needing constant direction, while understanding when management approval is required.

You are:

\- Proactive, resourceful and able to think outside the box

\- Confident in coordinating and supporting a team

\- Structured, reliable and hands-on

\- Guest-focused with strong attention to quality

\- Calm and solution-oriented when priorities change

\- Fluent in English

\- A holder of a valid Category B driving licence recognised in Finland

\-Already authorised to work in Finland without employer sponsorship

Experience in international hospitality, winter destinations or high-volume operations is considered an advantage.

Why Sonka Resort?

This is a responsible, year-round supervisory position where you can make a genuine difference to the daily operation and guest experience. You will work closely with company management while coordinating the team and ensuring that the resort runs smoothly.

Apply Please send your CV and a short introduction to isa@sonka.fi. Applications are reviewed continuously.

jobs.title: Renholder/driftansvarlig søkes i Bergen
jobs.description:
Vi søker en pålitelig og effektiv renholder til utleieboliger i Bergen. Du må være kvalitetsbevisst, selvstendig og fleksibel. For riktig person er det gode muligheter for mer ansvar og utvikling til driftsansvarlig/daglig leder.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter en pålitelig, punktlig og ansvarsbevisst person som har øye for detaljer og er opptatt av høy kvalitet på arbeidet. Du må kunne jobbe selvstendig, være fleksibel og løsningsorientert, og ta initiativ når det trengs.

Det er en fordel om du har erfaring fra renhold, hotell, Airbnb eller eiendomsdrift, men det viktigste for oss er at du er arbeidsvillig, strukturert og til å stole på. Du må kunne kommunisere på norsk eller engelsk. Førerkort er en fordel.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Renhold og klargjøring av leiligheter mellom gjester

Skifte og håndtering av sengetøy og håndklær

Kontroll av leilighetene før nye gjester ankommer

Påfylling av nødvendige forbruksvarer

Rapportering av skader og vedlikeholdsbehov

Enkle praktiske oppgaver knyttet til eiendommene

For riktig kandidat kan arbeidsoppgavene utvides til:

Planlegging og koordinering av renhold

Oppfølging av andre ansatte

Kontakt og kommunikasjon med gjester

Koordinering av vedlikehold og håndverkere

Ansvar for den daglige driften av utleievirksomheten

Vi ser etter deg som

Er svært pålitelig og punktlig

Har øye for detaljer og høy standard på renhold

Kan arbeide selvstendig

Er fleksibel med hensyn til arbeidstid

Er løsningsorientert og tar initiativ

Kan kommunisere på norsk eller engelsk

Gjerne har erfaring fra renhold, hotell, Airbnb, eiendomsdrift eller tilsvarende

Førerkort er en fordel.

Vi tilbyr

Konkurransedyktig lønn

Fast og seriøst arbeidsforhold

Fleksibilitet

Varierte arbeidsdager

Stor grad av selvstendighet

Mulighet for økt ansvar og utvikling

For riktig person: mulighet til å bli driftsansvarlig / daglig leder

Arbeidssted er hovedsakelig Bergen.

Vi er først og fremst opptatt av å finne en person vi kan stole på, som ønsker å være med over tid og bidra til å utvikle virksomheten.

Interessert?

Send oss en kort presentasjon av deg selv, tidligere arbeidserfaring, når du kan starte og gjerne referanser.

Vi tilbyr

  • Et fast og seriøst arbeidsforhold

  • Fleksibilitet og varierte arbeidsdager

  • Stor grad av selvstendighet og ansvar

  • Mulighet for å utvikle seg i rollen

  • Mulighet for økt ansvar innen drift og koordinering

  • For riktig person: mulighet for å utvikle stillingen til driftsansvarlig/daglig leder

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi er et firma som driver med utleie av Airbnb-leiligheter i Bergen. Vi fokuserer på å tilby attraktive og komfortable overnattingssteder med gode gjesteopplevelser.

jobs.title: Senior Lead, Government Innovation and Economic Growth
jobs.description:
The Role's Purpose

Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact.
 
The Senior Lead, Government Innovation & Economic Growth will play a critical role in shaping and delivering Plexal's growth across government. This is a nationally focused role responsible for identifying, shaping and securing high-value opportunities across central government, public sector organisations and strategic partners.
 
Based in the North West, the role will help position Plexal at the forefront of the UK's evolving government and innovation landscape. As government influence, investment and decision-making become increasingly distributed beyond Whitehall, the role will help Plexal identify and capitalise on emerging opportunities across government, economic growth, public sector reform, innovation adoption and place-based investment.
 
The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with deep government insight, helping Plexal understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth.
 
This is a hands-on commercial leadership role combining business development, strategic relationship management, proposition development and opportunity leadership, while also acting as a senior advisor to the wider GTM and leadership teams.


What You'll Do

  • Government Growth & Opportunity Leadership
    • Identify, prioritise and lead the pursuit of high-value opportunities across UK government. 
    • Build and maintain senior relationships across government departments, agencies, arm's-length bodies and wider public sector organisations. 
    • Shape early-stage opportunities by aligning customer priorities, policy developments and commercial propositions. 
    • Lead complex multi-stakeholder pursuits from early engagement through to contract award. 
    • Navigate government procurement and commercial environments, ensuring Plexal is well positioned to maximise success. 
    • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of government priorities, funding mechanisms and investment strategies to identify future opportunities ahead of formal procurement.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategic Positioning
    • Develop deep insight into emerging government priorities including economic growth, innovation adoption, AI, cyber resilience, public sector reform, science and technology, and place-based investment. 
    • Translate policy, market and customer insight into actionable growth opportunities for Plexal. 
    • Help shape Plexal's understanding of where government priorities, investment and demand are evolving. 
    • Identify emerging markets, funding streams and policy-driven opportunities that align with Plexal's strategic objectives. 
    • Position Plexal as a trusted partner capable of helping government translate ambition into adoption and measurable impact.
  • Cross-Government Go-To-Market Leadership
    • Shape and co-own Plexal's cross-government go-to-market strategy. 
    • Identify priority growth areas, departments and opportunity themes aligned to Plexal's strengths. 
    • Support the development and refinement of propositions that respond to changing government needs. 
    • Build repeatable approaches to opportunity identification, qualification and pursuit. 
    • Strengthen commercial discipline and opportunity management across the organisation. 
    • Support the creation of scalable propositions that can be applied across multiple government customers and sectors.
  • Strategic Relationship Management & Ecosystem Development
    • Act as a senior external representative for Plexal across government, industry and innovation ecosystem engagements. 
    • Build trusted relationships with senior government leaders, policy makers, commercial stakeholders and delivery partners. 
    • Establish Plexal as a credible voice within conversations around innovation, technology adoption, economic growth and government transformation. 
    • Build relationships across emerging government and innovation ecosystems outside London as government investment and decision-making continues to evolve. 
    • Represent Plexal at senior meetings, industry forums, conferences and government-facing events.
  • Partnerships & Growth Enablement
    • Develop strategic relationships with consultancies, technology providers, universities, ecosystem partners and delivery organisations. 
    • Build and shape consortium opportunities where partner-led approaches strengthen Plexal's position. 
    • Support priority bids, negotiations and commercial pursuits across the wider organisation. 
    • Share best practice across government sales, account development and opportunity shaping. 
    • Mentor and support colleagues across the commercial and delivery teams to strengthen capability and confidence.
  • KPIs and Commercial Outcomes
    • Significant £m pipeline generated and influenced across government markets. 
    • Material revenue secured through direct and partner-led opportunities. 
    • Number and quality of strategic opportunities shaped prior to procurement. 
    • Growth in multi-year and repeatable revenue opportunities. 
    • Conversion rate improvement across priority pursuits. 
    • Growth in partner-led opportunities and consortium wins. 
    • Strength and depth of senior relationships across government and strategic partners.
    • Contribution to Plexal's long-term positioning across government innovation, adoption and economic growth markets.


Your Skills

  • Commercially driven, outcome-focused and highly proactive. 
  • Naturally curious about government priorities, policy developments and market trends. 
  • Highly credible operating at senior levels across government and industry. 
  • Strong relationship builder with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholder groups. 
  • Strategic thinker capable of translating insight into action. 
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping undefined opportunities. 
  • Collaborative and committed to enabling the success of others. 
  • Resilient, adaptable and able to thrive in fast-moving environments.


Your Experience

Essential:

  • Proven track record of selling into UK government and winning complex public sector opportunities. 
  • Demonstrable success securing and growing contracts valued at £1m+ and/or multi-year engagements. 
  • Strong understanding of government procurement, commercial processes and public sector buying environments. 
  • Experience building relationships with senior government stakeholders. 
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, negotiation and deal strategy. 
  • Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies in complex environments. 
  • Experience working with partners to shape and deliver consortium bids and strategic opportunities. 
  • Ability to operate effectively across strategy, relationship management and hands-on opportunity delivery. 
  • Strong understanding of the relationship between government policy, funding, investment priorities and commercial opportunity.
 
Highly desirable:
  • Experience working across multiple government departments or policy domains. 
  • Understanding of economic growth, devolution, place-based investment and public sector reform. 
  • Experience within innovation, technology, consulting, digital transformation, cyber or AI-related environments. 
  • Experience identifying and developing opportunities arising from policy change, government reform and market shifts. 
  • Existing network across UK government, strategic partners and innovation ecosystems. 
  • Experience operating within high-growth, entrepreneurial or scaling organisations. 
  • Familiarity with government priorities relating to AI adoption, cyber resilience, science and technology, productivity and economic growth.


Who You Are

  • Willingness to undertake regular national travel (>40%) and occasional international travel
  • Open to UK Nationals who hold or are eligible for Security Check (SC) clearance. (See more on clearance eligibility.)
  • Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience
  • Relevant commercial, consulting or public sector credentials are advantageous
  • Commitment to Plexal’s values of diversity, equity, and inclusion


Why us?

As a start-up, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment dedicated to empowering innovators. We embrace individuals who leverage technology and creativity to tackle our greatest challenges head-on. We strongly advocate for maintaining a harmonious work-life balance, our goal is to ensure every member of our team can authentically be themselves and live their best lives. We firmly believe that innovation and creativity flourish when we cultivate a diverse workforce, comprising highly skilled individuals with a wide range of perspectives to contribute.
 
In return we will offer you:

  • Salary: £80,000 - £100,000 depending on skills and experience
  • Annual bonus scheme
  • A generous pension scheme (with a company contribution of up to 10%)
  • Private healthcare, life assurance and critical illness cover
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Volunteering day
Plexal is an equal opportunities employer and we actively encourage applicants from individuals from all backgrounds. We are a Disability Committed employer and are willing to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

jobs.description:
The Role's Purpose

Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact. National Security is a significant sector for Plexal’s Innovation Services business, where we enable our government clients’ adoption of new technology and create innovation ecosystems to enable their adaptation to the opportunity of disruptive and emerging technology. 
 
The Senior Customer Lead National Security is responsible for leading engagement with Plexal’s National Security clients in London and the adjacent region, building strategic partnerships to grow Plexal’s National Security business in region, evolving Plexal’s propositions and client offering in this market, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and success. This role sits in the wider National Security and Defence team, supporting the whole lifecycle of client engagement and delivery.  
 
The successful candidate will combine commercial capacity with government insight, helping Plexal to understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth.


What You'll Do

  • Act as account lead for Plexal’s National Security clients located in London and the wider region, ensuring strong, resilient partnerships through the whole life cycle of Plexal’s client engagement from prospecting, proposal development, opportunity identification, and customer satisfaction in project delivery. Demonstrate highly visible presence with existing clients to augment Plexal’s brand and reputation.
  • Utilise engagement on client delivery to build highly effective client relationships that support Plexal’s account objectives. 
  • Drive net-new business in the customer base, leading a campaign of revenue diversification to broaden Plexal’s engagement across the client business units, and landing material value and duration contracts with the customer base.
  • Expand partnerships with the NS sector supplier base to deliver new revenue opportunities through partnership and new routes to market for Plexal.
  • Work alongside the wider NS and Defence team to develop, refine and market new propositions to Plexal’s NS clients, ensuring that Plexal is able to meet customer requirement and adapts to new opportunities in the NS market.
  • Contribute to the strategy and delivery of the NS & Defence team, providing expert insights into customer needs and procurement trends, and supporting NS&D strategic campaigns across the waterfront of client delivery.  
  • Be a valued contributor to the evolution of Plexal’s GTM function, supporting process improvements and maturation of business development.


Your Skills

  • Able to operate autonomously as an individual contributor, delivering against GTM objectives and targets. 
  • Accountable for personal delivery, and able to work collaboratively in a wider GTM team contributing to overall NS&D objectives. 
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, able to develop rapport and strong relationships with clients, understand client needs and align Plexal to deliver against them.
  • A strategic thinker, able to understand long-term trends in clients and develop credible Plexal propositions. 
  • A collaborative worker, with a strong bias to supporting and enabling broader teams (both GTM and London-based Plexal colleagues). 


Your Experience

Essential: 

  • Proven track record of selling, winning new business and proposition development in National Security
  • Demonstrable experience of working directly with National Security clients, especially those located in London, including demonstration of client delivery and relationship-based sales
  • Extant, valid SC (essential), DV (preferred). NS sponsorship preferred.
  • Experience working with partners to shape and deliver consortium bids and strategic opportunities. 
  • Strong understanding of NS sector procurement and commercial processes.
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, negotiation and deal strategy. 
  • Ability to operate effectively across strategy, relationship management and hands-on opportunity delivery. 
Desirable:
  • Experience of working on technology adoption, innovation ecosystems, or organisational change in government, especially National Security.
  • Demonstrable success securing and growing contracts valued at £1m+ and/or multi-year engagements. 


Who You Are

Due to the nature of this position, our work and our client engagements, the post holder must be willing and eligible to achieve a minimum of SC clearance. Pre-existing SC clearance is welcome.


Why us?

As a start-up, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment dedicated to empowering innovators. We embrace individuals who leverage technology and creativity to tackle our greatest challenges head-on. We strongly advocate for maintaining a harmonious work-life balance, our goal is to ensure every member of our team can authentically be themselves and live their best lives. We firmly believe that innovation and creativity flourish when we cultivate a diverse workforce, comprising highly skilled individuals with a wide range of perspectives to contribute.
 
In return we will offer you:

  • Salary: £80,000 - £100,000 depending on skills and experience
  • Annual bonus scheme
  • A generous pension scheme (with a company contribution of up to 10%)
  • Private healthcare, life assurance and critical illness cover
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Volunteering day
Plexal is an equal opportunities employer and we actively encourage applicants from individuals from all backgrounds. We are a Disability Committed employer and are willing to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

Compétences indispensables : Expérience confirmée en gestion de projets SAP ; Excellente connaissance de l'écosystème SAP (SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA ou solutions SAP) ; Maîtrise des méthodologies de gestion de projet (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall ou SAP Activate) ; Expérience dans la coordination d'équipes multidisciplinaires ; Bonne compréhension des processus métiers et des environnements ERP ; Excellentes capacités de communication et de gestion de la relation client. Compétences appréciées : Expérience sur des projets de migration vers SAP S/4HANA ; Connaissance de SAP BTP, SAP Fiori ou des solutions Cloud SAP ; Expérience dans des environnements internationaux ; Connaissance des bonnes pratiques ITIL ou des processus de Delivery Management. Certifications Les certifications suivant/antes constituent un réel atout : SAP Activate Project Manager ; Certifications SAP (S/4HANA ou solutions SAP) ; PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP ou certification Agile/Scrum. Langues Anglais professionnel obligatoire ; La maîtrise de l'allemand constitue un réel atout ; Le français est indispensable.
