jobs.title: Business development manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
The role

The Business Development Manager is a revenue-generating role with two connected mandates.

**1. Origination - filling the pipeline of projects to be securitised.**

Find, qualify and win issuers who need to raise capital through a securitisation vehicle or bond issuance. Then make the onboarding process fast: keep the deal moving through structuring, documentation, KYC/AML and issuance, and remove the friction that typically stretches these processes out.

**2. Distribution - building the investor side.**

Develop and maintain relationships with professional and institutional investors and distribution partners across Europe, so that the products we structure have a defined route to market. Realiz is currently completing the regulatory framework that will govern its distribution activity; the regulated elements of this mandate will be exercised within that framework once it is in place, and the role is designed to grow into it. In the meantime the focus is on relationship building, market mapping and channel preparation.

This is a role for someone who wants to own a number, not administer a process.

Key responsibilities

**Origination and onboarding**

- Build and manage a pipeline of issuer prospects: SMEs, real estate and infrastructure sponsors, fund managers, corporates and asset owners
- Qualify opportunities against our structuring capacity, risk appetite and economics
- Lead commercial negotiations through to signed mandate
- Act as the commercial owner of each deal through onboarding — coordinating with structuring, legal, compliance and operations to compress time-to-issuance
- Identify and remove recurring bottlenecks in the onboarding process; contribute to making it repeatable

**Investor relationships and distribution**

- Map and develop the investor universe relevant to our products: private banks, family offices, asset managers, wealth platforms, professional investors
- Build long-term relationships and maintain an accurate, current picture of each counterparty's mandate and appetite
- Prepare and maintain the commercial materials and channel infrastructure that support product distribution
- Work with management to align product design and pricing with what investors actually want

**Market presence and strategy**

- Represent Realiz at conferences, industry events and in bilateral meetings across Europe
- Track competitors, pricing and market structure in securitisation, private debt and tokenised assets
- Contribute to commercial strategy, target markets and product roadmap
- Maintain accurate pipeline data in the CRM and report on it regularly

Your profile

**Essential**

- Several years of business development, origination, sales or distribution experience in structured finance, private debt, capital markets, asset management, fund distribution, private banking or a related field
- (Bac +3) Bachelor Formation: Private credit
- A demonstrable network on the issuer side, the investor side, or both - and the ability to activate it
- Working understanding of securitisation vehicles, bond issuance, private placements or fund structures
- Experience operating in a regulated financial environment, and comfort working alongside legal and compliance
- **Fluent French and English (written and spoken)**
- Autonomy: you are able to build your own pipeline and manage your own time without daily direction
- Willingness to travel within Europe and to be present in Luxembourg regularly

**Advantageous**

- **German** (a significant plus given our DACH counterparties and partners)
- Familiarity with tokenisation, digital assets, DLT market infrastructure, MiCA or MiFID II frameworks
- Existing relationships with Luxembourg, Liechtenstein, Swiss, Austrian or German financial institutions
- Experience selling into family offices and professional investors
- CRM discipline (HubSpot or equivalent)


Remarks:

### Compensation and terms

- **Base salary**, set according to profile and seniority
- **Success-based commission**, forming a significant part of total compensation, on business originated and delivered
- **Performance bonus** linked to agreed KPIs
- **Possible participation in a stock option plan**, depending on profile and seniority
- Contract structure (employment or independent) to be discussed according to the candidate's location and situation

jobs.title: Rengøringstekniker søges
jobs.description:
Rengøringstekniker søges – gerne med erfaring i gulv- og murbehandling

Vi søger en dygtig og kvalitetsbevidst rengøringstekniker, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores team. Vi lægger vægt på godt håndværk, grundighed og høj service – og vi ser meget gerne, at du har erfaring med specialrengøring, gulvbehandling og behandling af murværk/facader.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil variere og kan blandt andet omfatte:

  • Daglig og periodisk rengøring

  • Hovedrengøring og specialrengøring

  • Gulvbehandling, herunder grundrens, skuring, polish og pleje af forskellige gulvtyper

  • Maskinel gulvrengøring

  • Mur- og facadebehandling, herunder afrensning og rengøring af forskellige overflader

  • Klargøring og efterbehandling af overflader

  • Anvendelse af professionelle rengøringsmaskiner, produkter og metoder

  • Kvalitetskontrol af eget arbejde

  • Dialog og god service over for kunder

Vi forestiller os, at du

Har erfaring som rengøringstekniker eller med professionel rengøring. Det er en stor fordel, hvis du har praktisk erfaring med gulvbehandlinger og mur-/facadebehandlinger og er vant til at arbejde med maskiner og professionelle rengøringsmidler.

Du arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og går op i at levere et flot resultat. Samtidig forventer vi, at du er stabil, fleksibel og serviceminded og kan indgå positivt i et team.

Relevant uddannelse eller kurser inden for rengøring og overfladebehandling er en fordel, men praktisk erfaring og den rette indstilling vægter højt.

Kørekort B er en fordel

Vi tilbyder

Et alsidigt job med forskellige typer opgaver og mulighed for at bruge dine faglige kompetencer inden for både almindelig rengøring og specialopgaver.

Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, ordentlighed og godt samarbejde. Vi tilbyder gode kolleger, grundig introduktion til opgaverne og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Ansøgning

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig?

Send en kort ansøgning og gerne dit CV. Fortæl gerne om din erfaring med professionel rengøring og særligt, hvis du har arbejdet med gulvbehandling, specialrengøring eller mur-/facadebehandling.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Vi søger en sæson-køkkenhjælp til frokostplatter
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at blive en del af vores køkkenteam på Krusmølle hen over julesæsonen? Vi leder efter en, der kan hjælpe med at lave frokostplatter, preppe lidt i køkkenet og give en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det.

Person 1 arbejdstid:

  • Kl. 08.00 – 16.00

  • Fast fri onsdag og torsdag

Person 1 arbejdstid:

  • Kl. 08.00 – 16.00

  • Fast fri Mandag - Tirsdag

  • Opstart: 9 Oktober – sæson til og med 30. december

Det er et ret fleksibelt job – vi er gode til at mærke stemningen i køkkenet og finde løsninger sammen. Hvis der ikke er så travlt, aftaler vi tit, at man kan smutte lidt tidligere. Og er alt forberedt og klart, kan man nogle dage komme lidt senere. Det handler om at samarbejde og hjælpe hinanden. jobs.title: Deployment Lead - ERP Solutions
jobs.description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for an experienced Deployment Lead to guide complex customer implementations and help finance teams successfully transition onto Rillet.

This role is ideal for someone who has led ERP implementations and understands how to turn complex accounting and operational requirements into practical systems solutions. You may come from an ERP implementation firm, Big 4 finance transformation practice, systems consulting team, or a SaaS company serving finance organizations. You are comfortable owning multiple workstreams, advising senior stakeholders, and navigating the details of configuration, data migration, integrations, testing, and go-live.

You will combine strong implementation judgment with a customer-first mindset—bringing structure to ambiguity, identifying risks early, and keeping customers and internal teams moving toward a successful launch.

We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Lead key parts of customer onboarding and deployment, helping ensure a smooth and timely implementation experience

  • Partner with internal teams across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to execute implementation plans and solve customer problems quickly

  • Learn and analyze client accounting and finance workflows, then translate those needs into clear requirements and practical solutions

  • Guide customers through onboarding, training, change management, and adoption

  • Support data migration, reconciliations, systems setup, and integration coordination

  • Track milestones, drive follow-through, and keep internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the onboarding process

  • Identify risks early, escalate issues quickly, and help keep customer launches on track

  • Build trust with customers by being responsive, thoughtful, and solutions-oriented

  • Maintain clear documentation and provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders

Who We're Looking For

  • 4–7 years in ERP implementation, systems consulting, or finance transformation (e.g., Big 4 or implementation firms)

  • Background in SaaS, high-growth technology companies, or implementation/consulting environments is strongly preferred

  • Hands-on ERP experience (NetSuite, SAP, Workday, etc.), including requirements, configuration, data migration, and go-live

  • Strong understanding of core accounting workflows (close, reconciliations, ASC 606) and how they translate into systems

  • Customer-facing with strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Systems-minded with solid project management skills; able to run multiple workstreams

  • Comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and highly detail-oriented

  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams

The expected base salary range for this role varies by location:

Tier A: $100,000 – $150,000
Tier B: $100,000 – $140,000
Tier C: $100,000 – $130,000

Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. You can view Rillet’s compensation zones here.

Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

 

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

Sterling Technology, a subsidiary of TransPerfect, is the leading provider of premium virtual data room (VDR) solutions for the secure sharing of content, business process automation, and collaboration for the M&A, corporate development, real estate, capital markets, private capital, banking, and legal communities. Sterling has been supporting the M&A and capital markets for over 30 years, initially with financial printing services. Since opening our first VDR in 2010, we have helped customers from over 187 countries and 90 industries successfully complete thousands of deals. With offices in seven major financial centres, Sterling is trusted by its users to deliver exceptional levels of service on their most critical transactions.

Sterling is a fast-growing B2B SaaS technology business.  We have recently been acquired by TransPerfect, the world’s largest provider of language and technology solutions for global business, with offices in over 120 cities on six continents.

Summary:

The main focus of the role is to enhance clients' relationships and develop new accounts within different industries.

Your responsibilities and tasks will include:

  • Create effective approaches to drive new revenue and close new business

  • Identify, qualify, develop, and close sales opportunities

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of Sterling’s services

  • Identify prospective leads; develop new client relationships via cold calling, internet research, networking events, and direct marketing

  • Promote Sterling by educating clients on the company’s various services

  • Present Sterling via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Provide customer support and manage client expectations

  • Quote, manage, and bill projects daily, coordinating with clients and production teams to ensure these run smoothly and profitably

  • Communicate professionally at all levels of seniority

  • Based out of Paris, with travel required within France as needed

Sounds like a match? We look forward to meeting you!

  •  Experience and/or interest in the M&A space

  • Eager to learn, embrace challenges, and driven to succeed

Preferred experience:

  • Experience in a B2B sales/business development role

TransPerfect AI offers a premier product suite that addresses the most critical bottlenecks in the AI lifecycle, from LLM fine-tuning to high-stakes data security. We are in a hyper-growth phase. jobs.title: Director, Business Development
jobs.description:
About TransPerfect

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers — CMOs, Heads of Communication, Procurement Directors, Creative Directors, and Heads of Production

  • Develop tailored pitches and proposals that draw on the full breadth of TransPerfect's service offering, including creative capabilities

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including RFP/RFI responses, commercial negotiation, and contract finalisation

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions, Operations, The Mill creative teams) to design compelling, client-specific solutions

  • Represent TransPerfect at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

  • Contribute to market intelligence — identify trends, competitor movements, and emerging client needs

  • Report pipeline, forecast, and activity accurately


Experience

  • Minimum 3–7 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record in new business development

  • Experience selling , multi-service solutions to corporate clients — ideally in one or more of the following: creative services, digital production, marketing services, SaaS/tech, or professional services

  • Proven ability to close six-figure deals and manage multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales processes

  • Exposure to or genuine interest in creative industries (luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, advertising) — a strong differentiator

  • Experience navigating large organisations — identifying budget holders, managing procurement processes, and building internal champions

 

Skills & Competencies

  • Hunter profile— proactive, autonomous, energised by opening new doors

  • Ability to sell both transactional and strategic engagements depending on client maturity

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills— listens before pitching

  • Comfortable discussing technology, AI, and workflow solutions as well as creative services

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in both French and English

  • Commercially rigorous — accurate pipeline management, disciplined forecasting

 

Languages

  • French — native or bilingual (essential)

Education

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
About Payflows

At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it.

But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool.

We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤

Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter.

That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform, where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control.

We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized.

We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters.

In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future.

Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗

🚀 What you’ll actually do

You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved.

In a typical week, you might:

  • Design and implement new services for a product feature.

  • Refactor an early service to make it more robust.

  • Investigate a performance or production issue.

  • Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature.

  • Review code and help teammates improve.

  • Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations.

  • Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them.

Your time will be split between building new features and improving what already exists. Both matter.

You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the execution layer that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production.

You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏

Python is our core language. It helps us move fast, keep the code readable, and fits naturally with our AI-driven approach. A growing part of the system is built around agents that use our backend as a set of reliable, deterministic tools.

  • Core language: Python

  • Backend: FastAPI + Pydantic

  • Data: PostgreSQL

  • Infra: AWS, serverless when it makes sense

  • Performance: some Rust for critical paths

  • Architecture: multi-service backend, simple enough to reason about

Some parts of the system are clean and well-tested. Others were built quickly and need love. That’s the phase we’re in.

Over the next year, we’ll focus on:

  • Turning core workflows into reliable tools for our agents

  • Simplifying services

  • Improving tests and observability

  • Making performance more predictable

  • Cleaning up early code

We know we’re not perfect, but we care a lot about improving step by step.


✨ Who’s going to thrive with us

You’ll probably feel comfortable here if:

  • You like building products people actually use.

  • You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship.

  • You take initiative and lead by example.

  • You’re curious and enjoy figuring things out.

  • You’re pragmatic about trade-offs.

  • You communicate with kindness and clarity.

This role is a great fit if you’re excited by the idea of:

  • Building systems that are used by AI agents, not just humans.

  • Designing reliable, safe automation in production.

  • Working on a product that is still early and evolving quickly.

You don’t need to know everything about AI. But you should be curious about it and excited to work in a system where agents are part of the core product 🤖

🧩 What you’ll get from this role

  • Real ownership over parts of the system.

  • Direct impact on customers and product decisions.

  • A small, human team where your work is visible and meaningful 🤝

  • A mix of feature work, system design, and technical improvements.

  • Exposure to real scaling and production challenges.

  • The chance to help build an agent-driven product from the inside.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • Flexible remote setup (we only ask you to be at the office the first 3 days of each month).

  • A high-autonomy environment where you have real ownership and space to make an impact.

  • Plenty of room to grow, take responsibility, and shape parts of the product.

  • A culture based on trust, ownership, and clear communication.

This isn’t a huge corporate environment. In exchange, you get autonomy, responsibility, and the chance to shape a product that’s still early in its story—and help build what finance operations will look like in the next decade 🚀

jobs.title: DevOps / Infra Lead
jobs.description:
🌍 Our Vision & Mission

At Payflows, we give finance teams the tools to reclaim their time and energy. Our platform weaves together banking connectivity, payments, AI, and procurement so they can ditch the busywork and focus on what really moves the needle.

🤝 Why Join Us?

We’re a small, mighty team who’ve earned our stripes at Airbnb, Luko, BNP Paribas, and Facebook. It’s not always easy—things move fast, and we expect a lot—but if you’re hungry for impact, you’ll find it here.

🛠️ We’re builders at heart. We move fast, think deeply, ship often — and we’re always hungry to learn more. You'll collaborate closely with product and tech to craft elegant backend systems that scale as fast as we do.

🚀 What You’ll Do

You'll own the infrastructure for a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, infrastructure is not just about uptime; it's about reliability, security, and trust - especially when money and automation are involved. The platform has to be boring in the best possible way: predictable, observable, and safe to deploy to.

  • In a typical week, you might:

    • Evolve our infrastructure-as-code to add a service, a queue, or a whole new environment.

    • Improve our CI/CD pipelines so engineers ship safely and fast, dozens of times a day.

    • Investigate a production issue: a latency spike, a failing deploy, a database under load.

    • Strengthen observability with dashboards, alerts, and traces, so we catch problems before customers do.

    • Harden our security, secrets management, and access controls.

    • Tune cost and performance across our AWS footprint.

Your time will be split between building new platform capabilities and making what already exists more reliable. Both matter.

You'll help shape the foundation that everything else stands on: the pipelines, environments, and guardrails that let engineers and our AI agents act safely in production.

You'll work closely with backend, frontend, and the AI team. We expect you to take ownership of the platform and make it more reliable over time, not wait for tickets.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools

We're an AWS shop, and we lean on managed services and infrastructure-as-code so the system is reproducible and easy to reason with. A growing part of our world is making the backend a set of reliable, deterministic tools that AI agents can call, which raises the bar on reliability even further.

  • Cloud: AWS

  • Infra-as-code: Pulumi (Python)

  • Compute: ECS + Lambda, serverless when it makes sense

  • Data: PostgreSQL on RDS/Aurora

  • CI/CD: GitLab CI

  • Orchestration: Airflow (MWAA)

  • Observability: Grafana Cloud, CloudWatch, Sentry

  • Auth & identity: Cognito, IAM

  • Edge & frontend: API Gateway, ALB, AWS Amplify for the web app

Some of this is clean, version-controlled, and reproducible. Other parts grew fast and live a little too much in people’s heads instead of in code. Closing that gap is a big part of why this role exists.

Over the next year, we'll focus on:

  • Making every environment reproducible from code

  • Better observability and alerting, fewer surprises

  • Tightening the security and compliance posture that comes with handling enterprise finance data

  • Faster, safer deploys

  • Keeping AWS costs sane as we scale


🧑‍💻 What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience with Python or any other OOP language

  • Backend expertise: APIs, microservices, architecture best practices

  • Databases & SQL: Data modeling, query optimization

  • Git lover: Comfortable with version control and code reviews

  • Pragmatic engineering mindset: Build, test, refine, simplify—smart shortcuts when time is tight

🧩 Bonus points if you’ve worked on:

  • B2B SaaS or finance/ERP tools

  • BaaS APIs or payment infra

  • Serverless, AWS, event-driven architecture exposure

✨ Who's going to thrive with us

You'll probably feel comfortable here if:

  • You think in systems and instinctively automate yourself out of repetitive work.

  • You treat infrastructure as code, not as pets.

  • You stay calm during incidents and are genuinely good at root-causing.

  • You care about security, because you're handling other people's money.

  • You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship.

  • You take initiative and lead by example.

  • You're pragmatic about trade-offs.

  • You communicate with kindness and clarity.

You don't need to know everything about AI - but you must be curious about it and excited to build the reliable foundation that agents run on 🤖

🧩 What you'll get from this role

  • Real ownership over the platform the whole company runs on.

  • Direct impact on reliability, security, and how fast every engineer can ship.

  • A mix of platform building, system design, and reliability work.

  • Exposure to real scaling and production challenges.

  • The chance to help build the foundation of an agent-driven product from the inside.

jobs.description:
Töö asukoht Valga maakonnas Valga vallas (tööandja pakub majutust, hüvitab transpordikulud).

Tööülesanded: MTÜ Valga Abikeskus avab uue üksuse, kus pakutakse ööpäevaringset erihoolekandeteenust autismispektrihäirega inimestele.
Tegevusjuhendaja on vahetu teenuse osutaja, kelle tegevuse eesmärk on luua turvaline, struktureeritud ja toetav keskkond, mis arvestab kliendi individuaalsete eripäradega. Tööülesannete täitmine eeldab head füüsilist vormi ja aktiivset kaasamõtlemist teenuse arendamisel ning loomulikult kliente toetavat hoiakut.

Omalt poolt pakume: Motiveerivat töötasu; meeldivat meeskonda; vahetustega töögraafikut (paindlik tööaeg); vajadusel tasuta ööbimisvõimalust asutuses (tuba jagatakse); sõidukompensatsiooni igal kuul; tööalaseid koolitusi; kohapealset väljaõpet; tasuta toitlustust.

Muud nõuded: Otsime inimesi, kes on loomult rahulikud, kannatlikud ja järjepidevad, samas aktiivse hoiakuga ning uuendusmeelsed.
Tegevusjuhendaja väljaõpe ei ole otseselt tööle saamisel nõutav, küll aga eeldame valmidust õppima asumiseks ning kvalifikatsiooni omandamiseks. Ka tööandja pakub koolitamisvõimalusi. Oluline on vähemalt keskhariduse olemasolu ja kasuks tuleb eelnev töökogemus sotsiaalvaldkonnas, loomulikult ka varasemalt läbitud vastav väljaõpe. NB! Isik ei tohi töötada tegevusjuhendajana, kui teda on karistatud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest, mis on suunatud isiku vastu (nt vägivald) või mis seab ohtu teiste inimeste elu ja tervise. Kooli töötajate haridustehnoloogiliste ja digitaalsete pädevuste hindamine, koolitusvajaduse kaardistamine ning asutusesiseste koolituste, seminaride ja töökodade planeerimine ja läbiviimine. Nüüdisaegse digiõppevara ja interaktiivsete õppematerjalide loomise, valideerimise, litsentseerimise ja õppetöösse juurutamise koordineerimine ning õpetajate suunamine autorõiguste järgimisele. Haridustehnoloogia-alastes arendustegevustes, projektides, uuringutes ja koostöövõrgustikes osalemine (sh riiklikul ja rahvusvahelisel tasemel). Info- ja kommunikatsioonitehnoloogia-alaste trendide, vahendite ja võimaluste seire (sh riiklikud ja rahvusvahelised arengusuunad) ning teavitus õppeasutuses uute pedagoogiliste lahenduste rakendamiseks. Organisatsiooni arengut suunavate dokumentide koostamisel osalemine (sh digiplaani koostamine ja õppekavaarendus) ning õppeasutuse esindamine digitehnoloogia-alastes küsimustes erinevates töörühmades ja partnerlussuhetes.

Omalt poolt pakume: arengule suunatud meeskonna toetust;
osalemist erinevates projektides; 56 kalendripäeva puhkust; võimalusel paindlikku tööaega õpingute ajal; vajadusel täienduskoolitusi jm arenguvõimalusi; soodsat koolilõunat; tasuta parkimist; prillitoetust; elusündmuste toetust ja stabiilset sissetulekut; vajadusel elamispinda, koolipidajaga kokkuleppel

Väga hea suhtlemis-, nõustamis- ja esitlusoskus, koostöövalmidus, empaatiavõime ja oskus juhendada erineva digivõimekusega täiskasvanud õppijaid (õpetajaid). jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
📍 London Office (Aldgate East, E1) | Hybrid - 3 days in the office, 2 days remote (or office if you prefer!)

The opportunity

Goodlord is on a mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, and we’re searching for an Enterprise Account Executive reporting directly to our Head of Sales to help us achieve it!

As we accelerate our strategic growth, you will step into a high-impact, pioneer role dedicated to our Enterprise segment (agents managing 1,500+ properties).

Joining an emerging enterprise function backed by dedicated ABM and SDR support, you will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, position value to C-level executives, and help build and scale our Enterprise Go-To-Market playbook.

In this role you'll:

  • Build and execute strategic account plans for high-value enterprise accounts, partnering with dedicated ABM and SDR resources to drive multi-threaded C-suite outreach.

  • Lead rigorous discovery sessions using MEDDPICC to map complex organisational structures, diagnose operational risks, and present tailored ROI business cases.

  • Manage complex enterprise sales motions from initial engagement through legal, info-sec, procurement, and final sign-off for multi-year contracts.

  • Act as a core builder alongside early enterprise leadership to refine, standardise, and scale our Enterprise GTM playbook, templates, and collateral.

What we need from you:

  • Proven track record closing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B SaaS deals, typically £50k+ ARR and/or multi-year contracts, across longer Enterprise sales cycles (often 6–12 months).

  • Hands-on MEDDPICC experience to navigate complex deal cycles and maintain accurate CRM forecasting.

  • Experience multi-threading complex buying committees across C-suite, Operations, Finance, IT/Security, Legal and Procurement.

  • A demonstrable track record of value-led selling – moving customer conversations beyond features and price to build compelling commercial and ROI cases.

  • A builder mindset with comfort operating in scale-up environments where GTM processes are actively being co-created.

It would also be great if you have:

  • Experience selling SaaS into PropTech, Real Estate, Property Management, FinTech or another regulated/operationally complex environment.

  • An executive-level network across major UK letting agency groups, franchise networks, or corporate property managers.

  • Experience as an early hire in an emerging enterprise team, helping build sales collateral, objection-handling guides, and GTM strategy from scratch.

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

jobs.title: Ingénieur procédés analytiques H/F (H/F)
jobs.description:
English version below

À la suite d'une mobilité interne, nous recherchons un Ingénieur procédés analytiques (h/f) pour notre laboratoire.

Rejoindre l'équipe du laboratoire pour jouer un rôle central dans l'excellence analytique de notre activité Électronique, un secteur en forte expansion. Vos responsabilités clés vous placeront au cœur de l'innovation et de l'expertise.

Description du poste :

- Piloter l'innovation analytique : Mener les développements analytiques stratégiques et la qualification de nouvelles molécules pour garantir la fiabilité de nos produits.

- Expertise de pointe : Diriger les développements en ICP-MS et Chromatographie Ionique, spécifiquement pour les molécules organosilicitées et organométalliques.

- Partage de connaissances : Former nos équipes aux techniques analytiques les plus avancées et apporter une expertise spécialisée en ICP-MS et Chromatographie Ionique.

- Assurance qualité : Gérer la qualification des nouveaux fournisseurs de molécules et définir les protocoles de qualification en étroite collaboration avec le service Qualité.

- Interface internationale : Servir de point de contact analytique et technique auprès des laboratoires internationaux d'Air Liquide (notamment Fremont et Dallas) pour des études de corrélation stratégiques.

- Leadership et amélioration continue : Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue en faisant preuve d'une force de proposition affirmée, notamment en matière de sécurité, et en assurant un management transversal efficace.

english version :
- Following an internal mobility within the company, we are seeking a Process Engineer Analytics (m/f) for our laboratory.
- Join the laboratory team to play a central role in the analytical excellence of our Electronics business, a rapidly expanding sector. Your key responsibilities will allow you to be at the forefront of innovation and expertise.
- Drive Analytical Innovation: Lead strategic analytical developments and the qualification of new molecules, thereby ensuring the reliability of our products.
- Cutting-Edge Expertise: Lead developments in ICP-MS and Ion Chromatography, specifically for organosilicate and organometallic molecules.
- Knowledge Sharing: Train our teams on the most advanced analytical techniques and provide specialized expertise in ICP-MS and Ion Chromatography.
- Quality Assurance: Manage the qualification of new molecule suppliers and define qualification protocols in close collaboration with the Quality department.
- International Interface: Act as the analytical and technical point of contact with Air Liquide's international laboratories (notably Fremont and Dallas) for crucial correlation studies.
- Leadership and Continuous Improvement: Actively contribute to continuous improvement, demonstrating a strong proposal-making capacity, particularly regarding safety, and ensuring effective cross-functional management.

Una persona que no solo sepa escribir, sino que pueda combinar creatividad, estrategia y análisis de datos para crear contenido que genere resultados.

This role sits at the heart of Parity's leadership, working directly with our Founder to drive organisational alignment and execution across the company.

About the Role

You will work directly with Gavin Wood, Parity's Founder. Your job is to take his vision, goals and ideas, and turn them into clear decisions, aligned teams, and forward momentum. You will think 12 to 24 months ahead, not just manage what is on fire today. You understand that the decisions made now impact the future, and you treat them accordingly.

You will be a key partner to Directors across the business, our CEO, and the primary bridge between Gavin's priorities and the Acceleration team's execution.

What You'll Do

  • Operate as Founder's technical right hand. You will manage his context, his priorities, and his follow-through. You are available when it matters. You anticipate what he needs before he asks for it.

  • Turn chaos into clarity. Parity moves fast. You will work in an environment of competing half-thoughts, ambiguous mandates, and shifting priorities. Your job is to impose structure without killing momentum, and to spot the counterproductive plays before they cause damage.

  • Think long. You will not just solve today's problem. You will map the second- and third-order consequences of decisions being made now and make sure the right people are thinking about them.

  • Lead cross-functional problem solving. When something falls between departments, you pick it up. You have the technical credibility to engage with engineering leadership and the operational instinct to get things moving.

  • Own the leadership rhythm. OKRs, technical reviews, decision-making cadences, you design and run the operating system for Gavin's leadership team.

  • Manage up, across, and down. You will work with C-Level and Directors across different Functions of the business. Each is different. You will adapt your communication style to each of them without losing your own voice.

Your Skills

  • Technically credible. You have a background in engineering or engineering management. You can hold your own with a CTO, challenge timelines credibly, and evaluate the viability of new technical initiatives. You do not need to be a Blockchain Engineer, but you understand the ecosystem well enough to distinguish substance from hype.

  • A sophisticated operator. You have run complex, cross-functional programmes at a senior level, ideally having led a team or founded a company. You know how to create clarity from ambiguity, manage without authority, and drive decisions in organisations that do not move in straight lines. Experience managing leaders, including more junior managers, is a strong signal.

  • Exceptional communicator. Not just clear, adaptive. You can shift registers between a demanding Founder, Functions Leads, and a junior team member. You know what each person needs to hear and how they need to hear it.

  • A long-term thinker. You are not a damage limitation operator. You think about what the decisions being made today mean in 12 to 24 months. You bring that perspective into rooms where others are only looking at this quarter.

  • Believes in Web3. You do not need deep protocol experience. But you need to understand why this technology matters and be genuinely curious about where it is going. Candidates who are indifferent to the mission do not last here.

  • Thrives in ambiguity. Parity is not a machine. It is a high-conviction, fast-moving organisation with a demanding founder. You find that energising, not exhausting.

  • Academically strong. A high-calibre degree matters. If you have one, lead with it. If you don't, your track record needs to be exceptional.

About Working With Us

Joining Parity means joining teammates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! jobs.title: Senior O&M Asset Manager - Europe
jobs.description:
Your mission

Greetings, fellow seeker of sustainable futures! We're thrilled to present a pivotal role that connects cutting-edge technology with the operational excellence of renewable energy assets across Europe, the Senior O&M Asset Manager. Curious what this quest entails? Let's dive right in:

  • Hold senior accountability for the asset management of PV and ESS portfolios across Europe, ensuring compliance with LTSAs, SLAs, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Asset Managers, setting objectives, reviewing performance, and building capability.
  • Act as the senior escalation point and primary customer interface for complex technical, contractual, warranty, and corrective service issues.
  • Perform and oversee advanced contract analysis, identifying risks, obligations, and value optimization opportunities, and actively support LTSA negotiations.
  • Provide senior technical oversight by reviewing and validating Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), interpreting SCADA data, and assessing equipment logs.
  • Lead service partner performance management in collaboration with procurement and O&M teams, focusing on cost control, service quality, and contractual compliance.
  • Drive a data-driven asset management approach, including availability and performance analysis, spare parts strategy, and lifecycle cost optimization.
  • Ensure strong cross-functional coordination with Projects, Sales, Engineering, and HQ to support asset handover and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute directly to the profitability and long-term value of the O&M business through cost optimization, risk management, and performance-driven decision-making.
  • Champion continuous improvement in processes, reporting, asset performance, reliability, and team ways of working across the European asset management function.


Your profile

All right, all right, that was intriguing, wasn't it? Now, in order to fit in this role and be happy for a long time, your ideal background should look a lot like this:

  • A degree in engineering, business, contracting, or a related technical field is essential.
  • You possess a strong technical background in PV and Energy Storage (BESS) technologies.
  • Extensive experience in O&M asset management, handling complex asset portfolios and long-term service agreements is required.
  • Advanced expertise in contract analysis, including warranties, SLAs, penalties, liabilities, and risk allocation, is crucial.
  • You have a proven ability to review and validate RCAs, and to analyze SCADA data and equipment logs at a senior decision-making level.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams, with the ability to set priorities, coach performance, and drive accountability is expected.
  • You exhibit strong stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills with customers, internal teams, and service partners.
  • You are highly analytical, structured, and commercially minded, with a strong focus on profitability and value creation.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory, and proficiency in other languages is a plus.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word) is necessary, with advanced data analysis skills being an advantage.
  • You can operate effectively within a multicultural, matrix organization, with regular interaction with HQ and senior leadership.

jobs.title: Performance & Development Manager
jobs.employer: ISMG (International Sales and Marketing Group) AB
jobs.description:
About ISMG AB

ISMG AB is a service provider operating within the fast-moving micromobility sector. We work in an environment where efficiency, quality, flexibility and strong operational performance are essential to delivering a reliable service to our clients.

As our organisation continues to develop, we are looking for a Performance & Development Manager to strengthen our team in Stockholm.

This is a key role for someone who combines an analytical and structured approach with a practical understanding of day-to-day operations. You will work closely with company management, the Operations Manager, operational teams and our client to develop our processes, improve performance and support the continued development of the organisation.

About the Role

As Performance & Development Manager, you will be responsible for identifying, developing and implementing improvements across our organisation.

Your focus will be on performance, productivity, quality and continuous improvement. You will analyse operational results, identify opportunities for improvement and turn insights into practical solutions and sustainable working methods.

An important part of the role will be working closely with the Operations Manager and operational teams to understand challenges in the daily operation and develop solutions that create measurable results.

You will also support management by providing analysis, reporting and recommendations that contribute to both operational and strategic decision-making.

This is a hands-on role where you will be expected not only to identify opportunities for improvement, but also to take ownership of implementing and following up those improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

    Monitor, analyse and develop operational KPIs and performance indicators
    Identify trends, inefficiencies and opportunities to improve productivity, quality and service delivery
    Develop and implement processes, routines and standardised working methods
    Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation
    Analyse operational data and translate findings into practical actions
    Follow up implemented improvements and measure their impact
    Develop reporting structures and provide management with relevant performance insights
    Support the Operations Manager with performance analysis, planning and organisational development
    Work closely with operational teams to identify challenges and develop practical and sustainable solutions
    Lead and coordinate internal development and improvement projects
    Apply Lean, 5S and other continuous improvement methodologies where appropriate
    Develop and maintain process documentation, workflows and operational procedures
    Conduct root cause analysis and coordinate corrective and preventive actions
    Identify opportunities for more efficient use of resources and improved cost efficiency
    Support quality assurance and the achievement of agreed service levels and client expectations
    Contribute to the development and implementation of new working methods and operational initiatives
    Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration and high performance

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a person who is analytical and improvement-driven while also being comfortable working close to the daily operation.

You enjoy understanding how and why things work, identifying opportunities for improvement and turning ideas into practical solutions.

You are comfortable taking ownership of projects and initiatives and can work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues, management and external stakeholders.

We believe you have:

    A university degree in engineering, production, logistics, management or another relevant field
    Previous experience in process development, continuous improvement, production, logistics or another operational environment
    Experience leading or coordinating improvement projects
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
    Experience working with KPIs, performance measurement and data-driven decision-making
    Knowledge of Lean, 5S or similar continuous improvement methodologies
    Strong Excel skills and confidence working with operational data
    Experience developing processes, workflows and documentation
    Strong organisational and project management skills
    The ability to take ownership and independently drive improvement initiatives from analysis through implementation and follow-up
    Strong communication and collaboration skills
    Professional proficiency in English

Knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage.

Experience with ERP systems, process mapping, advanced data analysis or other relevant digital tools is also considered an advantage.

Personal Qualities

To succeed in this role, we believe that you are analytical, structured and proactive, with a strong drive to improve both processes and results.

You are results-oriented and enjoy seeing measurable outcomes from the initiatives you implement. At the same time, you understand that sustainable improvements require cooperation and involvement from the people working in the operation.

You communicate effectively with people at different levels of an organisation and are comfortable working with employees, managers, clients and other stakeholders.

You are adaptable and comfortable working in a dynamic environment where priorities can change quickly.

Most importantly, you have a hands-on mindset. You are willing to understand the operation in practice, identify what can be improved and take responsibility for making those improvements happen.

What We Offer

At ISMG AB, you will have the opportunity to take on a role with significant responsibility and a direct impact on how our organisation performs and develops.

You will work closely with both management and our operational organisation and have the opportunity to influence processes, working methods, performance measurement and future development.

The position offers a combination of performance management, process development, project management and continuous improvement within a dynamic and rapidly developing industry.

We value initiative, responsibility and practical problem-solving, and for the right person, this is an opportunity to develop professionally while contributing to the continued growth and development of ISMG AB.

jobs.title: Language Lead - French (Contract)
jobs.description:
About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

 

About the Engagement

You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include:

  • Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel.

  • Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects.

  • Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric.

  • Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations.

  • Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language.

  • Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases.

  • Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators.

  • Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time.

  • Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators.

  • Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes.

  • Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team.

  • Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and identify root causes.

  • Audit datasets for linguistic accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

     

Commitment

Roughly 40 hours per week with flexibility in scheduling. Project hours may vary depending on active studies, data projects, and product needs. Participation in periodic coordination meetings during US Pacific hours is expected.

 

Requirements

  • Native-level proficiency in French as spoken in France.

  • Experience with data annotation, transcription, or language quality assurance.

  • Strong foundation in linguistics or a related field, with the ability to apply concepts like phonetics, prosody, and intonation when evaluating speech and writing annotation guidelines.

  • Strong written English proficiency. All guidelines, feedback, reports, and team communication are in English.

  • Ability to write clear, structured instructions and deliver specific, actionable feedback to annotators.

  • Comfortable working with data and metrics such as inter-rater agreement scores, audit spreadsheets, and structured feedback templates.

  • Self-directed and able to manage feedback cycles, QA reviews, and data projects without close oversight.

Preferred

  • Experience writing or maintaining annotation guidelines or rubrics.

  • Experience training, mentoring, or managing other annotators.

  • Experience with audio evaluation, TTS, or STT.

  • Conversational spoken English proficiency for meetings and calibration syncs.

  • Experience working with distributed, remote teams.


This is a 1099 contract opportunity and will not be eligible for the benefits below. Language Leads work on an ongoing basis, renewable by mutual agreement. You will control your own methods for completing assigned work, supply your own equipment, and are responsible for your own taxes. You must be authorized to work in your country of residence.

 

Note: Cartesia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information to confirm employment eligibility after hire.

More Details

🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.

🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.

🚢 We ship fast. All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.

🤝 We support each other. We have an open & inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed.

Our Benefits (US Employees Only)

💰 Compensation Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package.

🩺 Health Insurance Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family.

🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Parental Leave 9 weeks paternity & 12 weeks maternity leave

🏦 401(k)

🚆 Commuter Allowance A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office.

🏖️ Flexible PTO Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries.

🍲 Meals & Snacks Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily.

🦖 Your own personal Yoshi

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Cartesia is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

Compensation: $25 – $35 per hour

  • • $25 – $35 per hour

De la négociation de partenariats clés au déblocage de nouvelles sources de revenus, en passant par l'élaboration de stratégies de croissance basées sur les données, nous relevons des défis majeurs qui font progresser l'entreprise. Nous recherchons un(e) Employé(e) Polyvalent(e) CDD- 35H pour rejoindre notre équipe à ST Ouen. Ce que vous ferez

En tant qu'Agent d'Exploitation, vous êtes le cœur du site, coordonnant les partenaires en cuisine, les livreurs et les clients pour garantir l'excellence opérationnelle.

Voici un aperçu de votre quotidien :

  • Gérer le Dispatch : Superviser la remise rapide des plats aux livreurs tout en résolvant proactivement les problèmes en direct entre les cuisines et les partenaires.

  • Garantir la Sécurité Alimentaire : Réaliser les contrôles HACCP et de sécurité quotidiens, en veillant à ce que nos normes élevées d'hygiène alimentaire et de sécurité du site ne soient jamais compromises.

  • Résoudre les Problèmes en Temps Réel : Être le premier point de contact pour les réclamations clients, en utilisant nos processus internes pour garantir un parcours client réussi.

  • Viser l'Excellence du Site : Collaborer étroitement avec le Site Manager et l'Assistant Manager pour atteindre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et maintenir un service de haute qualité.

  • Piloter le Terrain : Assurer les procédures d'ouverture et de fermeture, en faisant preuve de la polyvalence nécessaire pour assumer tous les rôles sur le site selon les besoins.

  • Forte capacité de polyvalence : Aptitude avérée à gérer des volumes importants d'informations et à jongler avec plusieurs défis opérationnels simultanément.

Finance Manager
jobs.description:
We're Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world's healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don't choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.

The role

Heidi's UK and Europe business is growing faster than the finance scaffolding underneath it. Central finance across Sydney, Melbourne and Manila runs month-end close, core accounting and day-to-day operations, but the region needs someone on the ground who owns the accuracy of its numbers and sits close enough to the commercial team to shape decisions before they get made. Today, regional leaders wait on Australian hours for answers about their own P&L. You'll end that.

The role has two halves and both carry equal weight. You'll own regional financial control and compliance: the integrity of the balance sheet, the accuracy of management reporting and forecasts, cash, strong local controls, and statutory obligations across Companies House, HMRC and VAT, directed through external advisers. You'll also be a hands-on business partner to UK and Europe leadership, Sales and Customer Success, owning the P&L narrative, bringing a commercial view to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, and making sure teams see the financial consequence of the choices they make. You'll report to the Group Financial Controller with a dotted line to FP&A.

What you'll do

Financial reporting and month-end close

  • Own the integrity of the UK&Europe balance sheet, with reconciliations that stay current, reviewed and explainable

  • Own the accuracy of the UK&Europe monthly group reporting and management accounts with variance commentary that explains movements

  • Be the single point of contact for group finance on anything UK&Europe: queries, adjustments, restatements, consolidation-level questions

Compliance and risk oversight

  • Own the UK&Europe compliance calendar (Companies House, HMRC, VAT) by directing external accountants and advisers

  • Own the adviser relationships (accounting, tax, audit), keeping work well scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi's internal finance standards

  • Build an early-warning process so compliance risk is caught and escalated well before it threatens trading status

  • Be the accountable owner if something in the compliance chain breaks down

Commercial business partnering

  • Be the day-to-day finance partner to UK&Europe leadership, owning the regional P&L narrative, budget vs actual and the "why" behind the numbers

  • Bring a commercial lens to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, flagging risk and opportunity early

  • Translate regional performance into clear, decision-ready input for FP&A and company leadership

  • Give UK&Europe business leaders a reliable, self-serve view of their numbers, so decisions stop waiting on Australian hours

  • Feed central finance the regional inputs it needs at close: accrual estimates, revenue and spend context, then review and sign off on the UK&Europe result

Revenue risk and collections

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to resolve aged and disputed balances and unblock stuck revenue

  • Own the commercial view of collection risk: which accounts, why, and what it means for cash, and feed it into forecasting

  • Drive down UK&Europe DSO by fixing the upstream causes (contracting, disputes, process), not by chasing invoices

FinOps, controls and performance frameworks

  • Build the operating rhythm that turns UK&Europe finance from reactive support into a reliable performance framework: clear KPIs, owners, review cadences and escalation paths

  • Partner with budget owners on spend decisions before they are made, rather than policing them after the fact

  • Strengthen financial controls across spend, approvals, vendor onboarding, card usage, subscriptions and commercial commitments, while keeping the process pragmatic for a fast-moving region

  • Review regional AP and card activity, including prompt removal of leaver access and cards, and escalate anomalies to central finance operations

  • Partner with external accountants, tax advisers, compliance providers and other vendors, making sure work is well-scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi’s internal finance standards

  • Use FinOps-style discipline to connect spend, usage and outcomes, especially across tooling, GTM systems, implementation costs and region-specific operating expenses

  • Create simple documentation and control checks so the region can scale without relying on informal knowledge or one-off fixes

What you'll need

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen — comfortable moving between P&L narrative, deal economics and cash impact

  • Experience business partnering with Sales, Customer Success or regional leadership in a growth business

  • Track record improving collections or DSO by fixing root causes, not just process

  • Experience owning spend or expense controls in a way that supports the business rather than only governing it

  • Comfortable directing (not necessarily performing) statutory compliance and VAT work through external advisers

  • High degree of autonomy and ownership in a small, remote-first global finance team

  • Clear, confident communicator — able to hold your own with commercial leaders and external advisers alike

  • Experience in a multi-entity or multi-currency business

Nice to have

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company

  • Qualified accountant (ACA / ACCA / CIMA or equivalent)

  • Exposure to Companies House, HMRC and Irish Revenue processes

  • Experience with Campfire, Airwallex or similar modern finance tooling

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You'll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we'd like to see. We're medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who've felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we're building isn't always easy. But we didn't choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn't whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you're doing the defining work of your career.

We take care of you.

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

jobs.title: Organist eller Kirkemusiker
jobs.description:
Organist eller kirkemusiker på deltid til Horne-Thorstrup og Hodde-Tistrup pastorater

 

En stilling som organist ved de fire sogne: Tistrup, Hodde, Thorstrup og Horne (4 kirker) er ledig pr. 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Stillingen er på 7 timer pr. uge.

Organisten skal samarbejde med vores fuldtidsansatte organist. Den primære arbejdsopgave er gudstjenester og kirkelige handlinger i weekender og på helligdage. Hertil kommer afløsning ved ferie, sygdom og lignende. 

 

De fire sogne har tilsammen 4.558 indbyggere. Der er 14 ansatte i sognene, inklusive 2 præster. Sognene er kendetegnet ved tæt samarbejde omkring ansatte kirkesangere og organister. Der arrangeres mange aktiviter på tværs af de fire sogne.

Tistrup Kirke har et orgel fra 1969 med syv stemmer, ét manual og pedal, bygget af Brødrene Bruhn.

Hodde Kirkes orgel er et mindre mekanisk instrument med fem stemmer og intet pedal, bygget i 1947 af det anerkendte orgelbyggeri Marcussen & Søn.

Thorstrup Kirke har et lille mekanisk pibeorgel med fem stemmer på ét manual og anhangspedal, bygget i 1953 af Frederiksborg Orgelbyggeri ved Troels Krohn.

Horne kirkes orgel blev bygget i 1957 af det anerkendte mandsfirma Marcussen & Søn. I 1993 blev instrumentet udvidet med yderligere 2 stemmer af Marcussen & Søn, så det i dag indeholder 10 stemmer fordelt på 2 manualer og pedal.

 

Ansættelse sker ved Tistrup Sogns Menighedsråd, men de fire tjenestesteder er ligestillede i planlægningen.

Nærmere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Inge Seemann på telefonnummer 51578755/mail: 8869fortrolig@sogn.dk.

Ansøgningen med relevante bilag sendes på mail til 8869fortrolig@sogn.dk.

Ansøgningen skal være menighedsrådet i hænde senest mandag d. 21. september 2026.

Der kan blive indhentet referencer.

 

Ansættelsen af en organist med eksamen som ”Kirkemusiker med Orgel og Korledelse” eller en organist med PO-eksamen er omfattet af Overenskomst mellem By,- Land- og Kirkeministeriet og CO10 – Centralorganisationen af 2010.

Organister med en kirkemusikalsk kandidat- eller bacheloruddannelse er omfattet af protokollat til akademikeroverenskomsten om overenskomstansættelse af DOKS-organister og faste lærere på kirkemusikskolerne indgået mellem Akademikerne og By-, Land- og Kirkeministeriet.

Aftalerne kan ses på www.folkekirkenspersonale.dk.

Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte organister har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen.

Årslønnen for ansøgere med en kirkemusikalsk kandidateksamen (DOKS) aftales i henhold til ny løn-AC-skalaen. Det vil sige en bruttoløn mellem 360.853,- kr. – 439.707,- kr. årligt (nutidskroner).

Der er knyttet rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt mellem 46.428,- kr. – 72.109,- kr. (nutidskroner). Indplacering og rådighedstillæg ydes efter anciennitet. Derudover kan der efter lokal forhandling ydes kvalifikations- og funktionstillæg.

Årslønnen for ansøgere med kirkemusiker med uddannelse i orgel og korledelse (tidligere PO-organister) aftales i henhold til det aftalte basisløntrinssystem. Basistrin 1 udgør kr. 348.201,- kr. årligt (nutidskroner) og basisløntrin 2 udgør kr. 365.841,- kr. årligt (nutidskroner). Indplacering sker efter anciennitet.

Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 29.476,- kr. (nutidskroner) for tjeneste ved 1 kirke/37.699,- kr. (nutidskroner) for tjeneste ved 2-3 kirker/44.657,- kr. (nutidskroner) for tjeneste ved 4 til 6 kirker/51.488,- kr. (nutidskroner) for tjeneste ved 7 eller flere kirker (vælg det relevante).

Løn og rådighedstillæg kvoteres i overensstemmelse med stillingens ansættelsesbrøk.
