jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Advanced Physical Security of Embedded Systems
jobs.employer: NTNUI-GJØVIK - NORGES TEKNISK- NATURVITENSKAPELIGE UNIVERSITETS IDRETTSFORENING I GJØVIK
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

Department of Information Security and Communication Technology (IIK) at NTNU Gjøvik is seeking a highly motivated candidate for a full-time PhD position in Advanced Physical Security of Embedded Systems. 

You will become part of an active and interdisciplinary cybersecurity research environment and have the opportunity to collaborate with researchers working across hardware security, embedded systems, cybersecurity, and digital forensics.

A significant part of the research will be carried out in the Hardware security and Reverse Engineering Laboratory (HRE Lab), providing the candidate with access to advanced experimental infrastructure and opportunities to contribute to the further development of the laboratory’s research and educational activities. You will work in a collaborative research environment with opportunities for scientific publications, international collaboration, conference participation, and development of hands-on experimental expertise.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Discipline. 


About the project

Modern embedded systems increasingly rely on cryptographic implementations and hardware-supported security mechanisms to protect sensitive information, trusted operations, and critical functionality. While cryptographic algorithms and software-level protections may be theoretically secure, their physical implementation can introduce vulnerabilities that are not visible at the algorithmic level. Sensitive information may leak through power consumption, electromagnetic emissions, timing behaviour, memory or bus activity, while manipulation of voltage, clock, or electromagnetic conditions can cause security mechanisms to behave in unintended ways. At the same time, modern embedded architectures increasingly integrate processors, memories, peripherals, hardware accelerators, security components, and multiple clock and power domains. Interactions between these elements may introduce new and insufficiently understood physical attack surfaces, creating a need for more systematic methods to evaluate and assure the physical security of embedded systems.

This PhD project aims to advance physical security evaluation and hardware security assurance for embedded systems by combining advanced side-channel analysis, fault-injection techniques, AI- and machine-learning-assisted analysis, robustness evaluation, and quantitative security assessment. The research will investigate how physical vulnerabilities arise, how to systematically discover and characterise them, and how to evaluate their practical security impact. This will include established and emerging physical attack mechanisms such as power and electromagnetic side channels, voltage/clock/EM fault injection, and combined attacks, as well as leakage and fault behaviour associated with timing and clock mechanisms, memory and buses, peripherals, hardware accelerators, cryptographic implementations, and interactions between architectural domains. AI and machine learning will be explored as enabling technologies for automated leakage detection and localization, analysis of complex measurements, fault-response characterization, intelligent exploration of large experimental spaces, and adaptive selection of security experiments.

The research will be strongly experimental and will utilize the advanced side-channel analysis and fault-injection infrastructure available in the Hardware Reverse Engineering Laboratory (HRE Lab) at NTNU, together with its hardware analysis and reverse-engineering capabilities. The candidate will design and conduct controlled experiments to investigate vulnerability mechanisms, validate physical attacks, evaluate security countermeasures, and study whether security observations remain valid across different devices, implementations, operating conditions, and experimental configurations. Classical and emerging cryptographic implementations, secure embedded platforms, hardware accelerators, and post-quantum cryptographic implementations may be used as representative experimental targets where relevant. The candidate will also contribute to developing automated measurement and analysis workflows, benchmark implementations and datasets, reproducible experimental procedures, and reusable physical-security testbeds. This will strengthen the HRE Lab as a sustainable experimental platform for advanced hardware security research, future PhD and master’s projects, education, and collaborative research.

The overall ambition is to move beyond individual demonstrations of whether a particular physical attack succeeds or fails toward robust, quantitative, and evidence-based hardware security assurance. The project will investigate how experimental evidence generated through side-channel analysis, fault injection, implementation analysis, robustness testing, and countermeasure evaluation can be transformed into measurable, reproducible, and traceable indicators of hardware security. Such evidence may characterise information leakage, attack effort and complexity, fault susceptibility, countermeasure effectiveness, robustness across devices and operating conditions, reproducibility, and the uncertainty and confidence associated with security conclusions. The longer-term goal is to establish scientific methods and experimental foundations that enable the security of hardware implementations to be systematically measured, compared, and supported by defensible evidence, thereby providing a foundation for future automated hardware security evaluation and quantitative assurance, as well as continued research, laboratory development, industry collaboration, and innovation in trustworthy embedded and cyber-physical systems.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education leading to a PhD degree, including required academic training corresponding to a minimum of 30 ECTS.
  • Conduct high-quality experimental research in advanced physical security of embedded systems, including the design, implementation, and evaluation of side-channel analysis, fault-injection methods, emerging physical attack mechanisms, combined attacks, and relevant countermeasures.
  • Develop AI/ML-assisted and quantitative approaches for hardware security evaluation and assurance, including automated experimentation and analysis, robustness and reproducibility assessment, and the development of reusable experimental platforms, datasets, methodologies, and testbeds within the HRE Lab.
  • Publish research results in high-quality international peer-reviewed journals and conferences and contribute to relevant scientific and popular-science dissemination.
  • Participate actively in the research group and department and engage in relevant international activities, including conferences, research collaboration, and research stays abroad.
  • Contribute to teaching, supervision, assessment, and academic development activities according to the requirements of the position.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in in information security, cybersecurity, electronics engineering, electrical engineering, embedded systems, computer science, or a closely related discipline. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position. 
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Excellent oral and written presentation skills in English (C1-C2 level). 

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience with side-channel analysis and/or fault-injection techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, FPGAs, or hardware-security platforms.
  • Knowledge of cryptographic implementations and hardware-security countermeasures.
  • Experience with hardware reverse engineering, debugging interfaces, or firmware analysis.
  • Experience with machine learning, deep learning, signal processing, or data-driven security analysis.
  • Previous research or experimental experience in hardware/embedded-system security, demonstrated through a thesis, project, publication, or relevant work.
  • Norwegian/Scandinavian language (please state your level).

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you can: 

  • be highly motivated, scientifically curious, and interested in research with practical relevance.
  • demonstrate independence, initiative, persistence, and strong problem-solving skills.
  • be well-organised and systematic, particularly in experimental and laboratory-based research.
  • be flexible, reliable, and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • communicate effectively and be motivated to disseminate research through scientific publications and international conferences.
  • demonstrate integrity, responsibility, and openness to new research challenges.

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work in addition to 12 months of career promotion work. A minimum of three work years of the total term period must be dedicated to the doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Information Security and Communication Technology within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • A cover letter describing your motivation for the position, relevant experience, research interests, and how your background fits the PhD project.
  • CV 
  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees. If you have not completed the master’s degree, you must submit a confirmation that the master’s thesis has been submitted.
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Dr Arvind Sharma, telephone +47 46710948, email: arvind.sharma@ntnu.no. If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Katrine Rennan, e-mail: katrine.rennan@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 1. October 2026.

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage.

jobs.title: Firmware Developer
jobs.description:
**Build the intelligence inside connected devices.**

We are looking for an experienced Firmware Developer to join our engineering team and help develop the next generation of Casambi-enabled products.

Your primary focus will be embedded software development for wireless devices built on Nordic Semiconductor platforms. You will work with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), mesh networking, device communication protocols, and system-level firmware that powers reliable, secure, and scalable lighting control solutions.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to hardware while also understanding complete system architectures, from embedded devices to mobile applications, gateways, and cloud services. We're looking for an engineer who is curious, continuously learns new technologies, and actively uses AI-powered tools to improve development efficiency and software quality.

**What you'll do**

- Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware for wireless products based on Nordic Semiconductor SoCs

- Develop software using Nordic SDKs, including nRF Connect SDK and Zephyr-based solutions

- Implement and maintain Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Bluetooth Mesh, and other wireless communication technologies

- Develop and optimize communication protocols between embedded devices, mobile applications, gateways, and cloud services

- Participate in architecture, design reviews, code reviews, testing, and debugging activities

- Investigate and resolve complex issues across hardware, firmware, wireless communication, and system integrations

- Contribute to device provisioning, security, diagnostics, and over-the-air (OTA) firmware update solutions

- Collaborate closely with hardware, mobile, cloud, backend, QA, and product teams

- Use AI-powered development tools to improve productivity, code quality, troubleshooting, and learning

- Participate throughout the entire product lifecycle, from concept and development to deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement

- Contribute to multiple products and technology initiatives as priorities evolve


**What we're looking for**

**Essential**

- 5+ years of professional embedded software or firmware development experience

- Strong C/C++ programming skills

- Experience developing software for ARM Cortex-M based microcontrollers

- Experience with Nordic Semiconductor development platforms and SDKs

- Solid understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and wireless communication principles

- Experience debugging embedded systems using modern development and test tools

- Understanding of RTOS concepts and embedded software architecture

- Experience with communication protocols and device interoperability

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

- Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and domains

- Experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and software quality

- Strong communication and collaboration skills


**Highly appreciated**

- Experience with nRF Connect SDK, Zephyr RTOS, or Nordic SoftDevice architectures

- Experience with Bluetooth Mesh networking

- Experience implementing secure boot, device security, and firmware update mechanisms

- Experience with Linux-based embedded systems or gateway devices

- Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, and firmware release processes

- Understanding of RF technologies and wireless performance optimization

- Experience bringing products from concept to mass production and customer deployment

- Product-oriented mindset and customer focus


**Why join us?**

You'll work on products that combine embedded systems, wireless communication, cloud connectivity, mobile applications, and real-world customer deployments. This role offers the opportunity to solve challenging technical problems while developing technology used in hundredths of thousands of installations worldwide.

We value engineers who care not only about writing firmware, but also about delivering successful products that solve real customer problems and continue to provide value long after their initial release.

**We are looking for product builders, not just firmware developers. Candidates with experience bringing connected products from idea to customer deployment are particularly encouraged to apply.**

This role is based at our head office in Espoo, Finland, where most of our team works together in a hybrid setting. To be considered for the position, applicants should already hold a valid right to work in Finland, as we are unfortunately not in a position to support relocation or sponsor work permits for this opening. We warmly welcome applications from all qualified candidates who meet this requirement.

_\*Applications are processed with the help of AI (for example, to detect and summarize whether criteria are met), but the final assessment is always made by a human._

jobs.title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
jobs.description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

  • Experience with bioinformatics workflow environments such as snakemake, NextFlow or CWL.

  • Experience in analyzing next-generation sequencing datasets.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred, but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Basic understanding of disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision – We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477 

Application deadline

September 23, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: DIRECTEUR CENTRE DE VACANCES ET D'HÉBERGEMENT DE GROUPES - CDI (H/F)
jobs.description:
Un poste de direction opérationnelle, autonome et responsabilisant dans un cadre privilégié du Médoc.
Nous recherchons notre futur(e) Directeur / Directrice de centre de vacances et d'hébergement de groupes pour assurer la gestion et la coordination générale d'un établissement situé à Montalivet, en Gironde.

Notre centre accueille des groupes en pension complète et dispose d'une capacité d'environ 350 lits. L'activité se déroule principalement d'avril à novembre.
Nous proposons un poste à forte autonomie, au sein d'une structure à taille humaine, pour une personne souhaitant prendre de véritables responsabilités dans la gestion d'un établissement accueillant une clientèle de groupes.

VOTRE MISSION :
Véritable pilote opérationnel du centre, vous êtes garant(e) de son bon fonctionnement général et de la qualité de l'accueil des groupes.
Vos principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :
- Assurer la gestion et la coordination quotidienne du centre ;
- Organiser et superviser l'activité générale de l'établissement ;
- Encadrer et coordonner une équipe d'environ 5 salariés permanents ;
- Participer au recrutement et à l'organisation du personnel saisonnier en fonction de l'activité ;
- Organiser et planifier le travail des équipes ;
- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et au bon déroulement des séjours ;
- Assurer le lien avec les groupes accueillis, les partenaires et les prestataires ;
- Gérer les commandes et les approvisionnements nécessaires au fonctionnement de l'établissement ;
- Veiller au respect des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité ;
- Superviser le bon entretien général du centre et de ses équipements ;
- Anticiper les besoins liés à l'activité et gérer les éventuels imprévus ;
- Participer à la préparation, au lancement et au suivi de la saison.

UNE ORGANISATION QUI VOUS LAISSE UNE VRAIE AUTONOMIE :
Vous ne serez pas amené(e) à assurer seul(e) l'ensemble des tâches opérationnelles du centre.
* Le responsable de cuisine dispose d'une grande autonomie dans l'organisation de son activité.
* La personne responsable de l'entretien et du ménage est également largement autonome dans son domaine.
Votre rôle sera donc avant tout celui d'un responsable et coordinateur général, chargé de donner une direction, d'organiser, d'anticiper, de prendre les décisions nécessaires et de garantir la cohérence du fonctionnement de l'établissement.
En cas d'absence imprévue, d'accident ou de besoin exceptionnel, vous devez toutefois être en capacité d'intervenir ponctuellement et de remplacer temporairement un membre de l'équipe afin d'assurer la continuité du fonctionnement du centre.

Vous êtes autonome, fiable, organisé(e) et doté(e) d'un véritable sens des responsabilités.

Une expérience dans l'un des domaines suivants sera particulièrement appréciée :
- direction ou gestion d'un centre de vacances ;
- hôtellerie ou hébergement collectif ;
- tourisme ;
- village vacances ;
- centre d'accueil de groupes ;
- gestion de site ou d'établissement ;
- restauration collective ;
- structure accueillant du public.

Vous êtes capable de travailler aussi bien dans la réflexion et l'organisation que dans l'action lorsque la situation l'exige.

CDI temps complet à pourvoir dés que possible.
Merci d'adresser votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes présentant votre parcours et vos motivations.

jobs.title: Skal du være socialfaglig medarbejder på Holbrogaard?
jobs.description:
Vi får plads til flere unge derfor søger vi socialfaglige medarbejdere med opstart 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt.

Holbrogaard ligger i naturskønne omgivelser tæt ved det sydfynske øhav i Faaborg. Vi tilbyder miljøterapeutisk og neoaffektiv døgnbehandling til unge i alderen 12-18 (22) år, med begyndende personlighedsforstyrrelser og psykiatrinære lidelser.

Det er en arbejdsplads for omkring 20 medarbejdere med såvel sundhedsfaglige og pædagogiske uddannelser, hvor det faglige niveau er højt. Behandlingen af hver enkelt ung, er nøje tilrettelagt efter den unges individuelle behov og foregår i et omsorgsfuldt bo-miljø.

Skoletilbuddet aftales med den anbringende kommune for hver enkelt ung og foregår i nærmiljøet. Det er med til at skabe den bedste udvikling i den unges liv.

Behandlingen tager udgangspunkt i evidensbaseret miljøterapi og neuroaffektive og systemiske principper. Det betyder, at vores behandlingsmetoder er veldokumenterede og tager hensyn til og inddrager alle aspekter af den unges liv.
For at udvikle fagligheden, er der løbende efteruddannelse og supervision.

Med andre ord: Holbrogaard lykkes, når unge udvikles og styrkes mod et bæredygtigt liv.

Med udgangspunkt i en stærk faglighed og blikket hævet mod ovenstående kerneopgave, arbejder vi bevidst insisterende mod at lykkes sammen med de unge.

Dette stiller store krav til os som behandlingssted og vores pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige handlinger.

Kan du se dig selv ind i ovenstående og har du følgende kvalifikationer hører vi meget gerne fra dig.
  • Har en social eller sundhedsfaglig uddannelse – som pædagog, psykolog, socialrådgiver, ergoterapeut eller social og sundhedsassistent alternativt en anden relevant uddannelse på min. bachelorer niveau.
  • Har erfaring med faglig dokumentation.
  • Psykisk robust og rummelig.
  • Ser arbejdet omkring den unge som en helhedsorienteret opgave der indeholder tæt samarbejde med forældre og anbringende kommuner.
  • Evne til at arbejde selvstændigt, evaluere og prioritere opgaver i samarbejde med kollegaer.
  • Kan bevare overblikket og samtidig fokusere på den enkelte unges behov.
  • Gerne kompetencer til at arbejde motorisk, musisk og kreativt med de unge.
  • Gerne kendskab til psykiatrien.
  • Lyst til at dele og udvikle viden i tæt samspil med kollegaerne.
  • Anerkendende tilgang til kollegaer, de unge og deres familier.
  • At du trives i et tværfagligt samarbejdsmiljø.
  • At du trives med at løse kerneopgaven.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du har erfaring fra psykiatri og døgninstitutioner med lignende målgruppe.

Vi tilbyder:
  • God introduktion.
  • Forplejning når du er på arbejde, attraktiv sundhedsordning.
  • Supervision og efteruddannelse.
  • En engageret og ambitiøs tværfaglig personalegruppe, bestående af både medarbejdere med mange års erfaring på stedet, og nogle medarbejdere ansat inden for det sidste år.
  • Vi lægger vægt på et sundt og udviklende arbejdsmiljø, og høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen – og ser disse to som hinandens forudsætning.

For alle medarbejdere er der obligatorisk deltagelse i behandlingskonference, personalemøder og supervision.

Vi aflønner efter gældende overenskomst med SL/FOA.

Ren straffeattest, børneattest og gyldigt førerbevis er en forudsætning for ansættelse.

Stillingerne er alle på 32 timer pr. uge og arbejdstiderne er dag, aften og fast hver 2. weekend

Ansøgningsfristen er nu!

Sagt med andre ord vi tager løbende kandidater ind til samtale og opslaget vil blive taget ned, når vi er nået i mål med de rette kandidater.

Evt. spørgsmål til stillingerne?
Så er du velkommen til at kontakte leder af Holbrogaard, Jens Simmelsgaard på mobil 2260 0561 eller souschef, Kristoffer Aarup på mobil 2519 4466.

jobs.title: Qualified Carpenter with Glazing Experience - Construction - Lolland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Dansk version længere nede

Bonde Glas is looking for a qualified carpenter with knowledge or experience of the glazing trade to join our team on Lolland in southern Denmark.

You’ll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark (for example, EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit). Unfortunately, we’re not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will work with a wide range of carpentry tasks and work closely with the glazing side of the company. We are therefore looking for a carpenter who is comfortable with varied practical work and interested in working across the two trades.

Who you are

  • You are a qualified carpenter

  • You have knowledge or practical experience of the glazing trade

  • You have a valid driving licence

  • You can communicate in English

  • Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

  • A valid asbestos training certificate is a strong advantage

What we offer

  • Gross hourly wage: DKK 150-200, depending on qualifications and experience

  • Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday

  • Occasional overtime may occur, but weekend work is generally not required

  • Pension scheme

  • Flexible benefits account for extra vacation, salary or pension

  • Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bonde Glas

Bonde Glas is a local glazing company on Lolland. In addition to glazing work, the company also employs carpenters and carries out a wide range of practical assignments.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Please send your application to rekruttering@lolland.dk and write “Bonde Glas” in the subject line.

If you have questions about the position, please contact:

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe’s largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality’s Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit newcomers.lolland.dk

More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk

jobs.description:

Tehtävät käsittävät hotellihuoneiden siivousta, liinavaatteiden vaihtoa sekä sänkyjen petaamista ja huoneen valmistamista asiakkaan käyttöön tämän lisäksi myös yleisten tilojen, sauna- ja allasosaston puhtaanapitoon liittyvä tehtäviä sekä tilojen viihtyvyydestä huolehtiminen. jobs.title: Hoiva-avustaja
jobs.description:
Haemme ikääntyvien kiireettömään ja aktivoivaan kotihoitoon hoiva-avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Kokoaikainen työsuhde on mahdollista työsuhteen jatkuessa.

KotiSenior Oy on yksityinen perheyritys Kuopiossa. Kuulumme osaksi FysioSenior Oy:n yhtiötä. Työllistämme lähes 30 terveysalan ammattilaista tehden päivittäin työtä ikääntyvän väestön laadukkaan ja aktiivisen arjen puolesta. Meillä työskentelee lähihoitajia, hoiva-avustajia ja sairaanhoitaja. Asiakkaat saavat myös lääkäripalvelut ja muistitutkimukset kotiin osana palveluamme. Olemme erikoistuneet ikääntyvien- ja muistisairaiden aktivoivaan kotihoitoon, joka tarkoittaa meillä aikaa tehdä asioita yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa ja olemista myös seurana. Työtämme ohjaa vahvasti arvot - kiireettömyys, luotettavuus, ammattimaisuus ja positiivisuus.

Hoiva-avustajan työ on asiakkaiden kotona tapahtuvaa kiireetöntä kotipalvelua ja työskentelemme pääsääntöisesti ma-pe klo:7-18 välillä. Työnkuva on monipuolinen ruoanlaitosta leivontaan yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa, pyykkihuollossa avustaminen, ulkoilua ja seurana oloa. Asioimme kaupassa yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa, olemme tukena lääkärikäynneillä ja mahdollistamme vierailuja, kun yksin liikkuminen ei enää onnistu. Työskentelemme myös eri hoivakodeissa, joissa tarjoamme asiakkaille ulkoilua, viriketuokioita ja läsnäoloa. Voimme olla mukana asiointikäynneillä ja avustaa monipuolisesti eri asioissa asiakkaan voinnin mukaan. Asiakaskäynnit ovat yleisimmin 1-2h. Käyntialue on Kuopion kaupunkialue. Edellytämme ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttö katsotaan eduksi, jonka käytöstä maksetaan kilometrikorvaukset.

Työntekijässä arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, työhön sitoutumista sekä itsenäistä työotetta. Kehitämme palveluitamme aktiivisesti asiakkaita ja työntekijöitä kuunnellen, joten toiminnan kehittäminen on myös osa työtäsi. Hyvät yhteistyötaidot ja sujuva kommunikointi hoitohenkilökunnan kuin läheisten kanssa on tärkeää. Työ on itsenäistä ja liikkuvaista. Asiakastilanteet ovat joskus nopeastikin muuttuvia, joten joustavaa ja sopeutuvaa otetta työhön tarvitaan.

Perehdytyksestä olemme saaneet työntekijöiltämme hyvää palautetta ja sen koemme yhdeksi tärkeämmäksi tehtäväksi uuden työntekijän aloittaessa. Perehdytämme uuden työntekijän hyvin kentällä asiakkaisiin sekä työtehtäviin tutustuen. Meillä on erinomainen ja kannustava työilmapiiri työskennellä (henkilöstökysely 4,45/5), jossa työntekijän työtä ja persoonaa arvostetaan. Työntekijän työhyvinvointiin meillä halutaan panostaa monin eri tavoin ja sitä kehitämme aktiivisesti mm. tyhy-tiimin avulla. Olemme savuton työpaikka.

Palkkauksessa käytämme yksityisen sosiaalialan tes:ä lähtötasona, mutta neuvottelemme palkkauksen työntekijän koulutus- ja työkokemus katsoen tehtävänkuvaan sopien. Kilometrikorvaus maksetaan käytettäessä omaa autoa.

Työn aloitus on mahdollisimman pian / neuvoteltavissa.

Työnantajana tarjoamme mm.:

\- Mielekkään työn huippu työporukassa

\- Mahdollisuus työajan joustoon

\- Työterveyspalvelut Pihlajalinnassa

\- Vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus

\- Koko henkilöstön tyhy-tapahtumat vuosittain

\- Laadukkaat työvälineet ja työvaatteet

\- E-passin käyttö

Työntekijältämme odotamme:

\- Sosiaali - ja terveysalan koulutus katsomaan eduksi

\- Työhön sitoutuneisuutta

\- Positiivista ja heittäytyvää asennetta työhön

\- Hyviä työyhteisötaitoja ja reilua työkaveruutta

\- Hyviä asiakaspalvelu- ja yhteistyötaitoja

\- Sopeutumista muuttuvissa tilanteissa

\- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

\- Ajokorttia (oman auton käyttö on etu)

\- Tartuntalain vaatima työntekijän 48 §:n rokotussuoja

Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti tehtävään valittavien ikääntyvien tai vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6§:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

Jos koet, että työ KotiSeniorilla herätti kiinnostusta, niin ota rohkeasti yhteyttä ja kysy tehtävästä ja työskentelystä meillä lisää. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuajalla ja valinta tehdään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten laitathan hakemuksen ja Cv:n mahdollisimman mahdollisimman pian.

Etsimme mielenterveys, päihde- ja asunnottomuustyöstä kiinnostunutta lähihoitajaa vakinaiseen ohjaajan tehtävään Alppikadun asumispalveluyksikköön. Aloitus heti tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Olet hyvä tyyppi, joka ei kavahda vauhtia ja vaarallisia tilanteita. Sinulla on kyky sopeutua nopeastikin muuttuviin tilanteisiin ja siedät keskeneräsyyttä. Tarjoamme mahtavan työporukan lisäksi vaihtelevan ja mielenkiintoisen työn, jossa kahta samanlaista päivää ei ole. Saat työllesi kattavan perehdytyksen ja osaavan työyhteisön tuen.

Ohjaajilla on yksikössämme käytössä työvuoroautonomia, joten työvuorot on mahdollista suunnitella henkilökohtaiseen elämäntilanteeseesi sopivaksi. Työ on 3-vuorotyötä ja sisältää sekä arki- että viikonlopputyötä.

Alppikadun asumispalveluyksikkö toimii Asunto ensin-periaatteella tarjoten tuettua asumista asunnottomuutta kokeneille. Yksikössä on 89 asukaspaikkaa ja henkilökunta paikalla ympäri vuorokauden. Yksikön perustehtävänä on turvata asukkaisen asuminen omissa vuokra-asunnoissaan. Kantavana ajatuksena on tarjota asukkaille mahdollisuus ihmisarvoiseen elämään, johon olennaisena osana kuuluu asunto, osallisuuden kokemus omaan elämään, yhteisöön ja yhteiskuntaan.

Ohjaajan tehtäviin asumispalveluyksikössä kuuluvat asukkaan ohjaaminen ja tukeminen erilaisissa arjen hallintaan ja asumiseen liittyvissä asioissa. Työ sisältää asukkaiden fyysisen ja psyykkisen terveydentilan arviointia ja tarpeen mukaan ohjaamista terveydenhuollon ja sosiaalihuollon palveluiden piiriin. Ohjaajan tukena työssä ovat ohjaajien työryhmän lisäksi yksikön sairaanhoitaja, sosiaaliohjaajat, työvalmentaja, tiiminvetäjä, esihenkilö sekä yksikön johtaja.

Palkkaus yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n G21 (2543,33-2871,53). Tarjoamme lisäksi työterveyshuollon ja e-passiedun.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa tuetun asumisen esihenkilö Anu Ratinen puh. 045-77347362. Vapaamuotoiset hakemukset pyydetään jättämään mahdollisimman pian, paikka täytetään heti sopivan hakijan löydyttyä ja haastatteluja tehdään jo hakuaikana, joten ole pian yhteydessä, jos ja kun kiinnostuksesi heräsi!

jobs.title: KS Elektro A/S søger arbejdsleder til elektronikafdeling
jobs.description:
KS Elektro A/S søger arbejdsleder til elektronikafdeling

Vil du stå i spidsen for et stærkt elektronikteam og være med til at sikre høj kvalitet, effektiv drift og motiverede medarbejdere? Så er du måske vores nye arbejdsleder til Elektronikafdelingen. Vi arbejder hovedsageligt på nybygninger og er med fra de første spæde installationer til de sidste, færdige installation ombord på topmoderne fartøjer.

Som arbejdsleder får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse af elektronikafdelingen i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen. Du bliver en central del af produktionen, hvor du sikrer effektiv planlægning, høj kvalitet i arbejdet og synlig ledelse af afdelingens medarbejdere.

Du vil få en alsidig hverdag med ansvar for både medarbejdere, produktion, kvalitet og opfølgning på opgaver og ressourcer.

 

Om opgaverne:

Som arbejdsleder for vores elektronik-team, vil nogle af opgaverne indebære:

  • Daglig ledelse af elektronikafdelingen – samt motivation og udvikling af afdelingens timelønnede medarbejdere gennem synlig og nærværende ledelse.

  • Sammensætning af det rette team til de enkelte opgaver.

  • Planlægning og koordinering af arbejdsopgaver med fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og leveringstid.

  • Samarbejde med øvrige arbejdsledere for at sikre optimal koordinering på tværs af afdelinger.

  • Opfølgning på timeforbrug og materialeforbrug på ordrer.

  • Opfølgning på ekstraarbejde og sikring af overensstemmelse mellem tilbud og udførelse.

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er udlært inden for elektronik (Elektronikmekaniker, elektronikfagtekniker, el-ingeniør, installatør el.lign.). Du kan også være udlært elektriker med interesse/erfaring og flair for elektronik.

  • Har erfaring med at lede og koordinere arbejdet i en medarbejdergruppe

  • Er pligtopfyldende, fleksibel og imødekommende.

  • Erfaring fra den maritime branche er en fordel.

Vi kan tilbyde dig:

  • En fast stilling på fuldtid.

  • Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer.

  • Pensionsordning og sundhedssikring.

  • En anderledes og spændende arbejdsplads, hvor sikkerhed og et godt arbejdsmiljø er topprioriteter.

  • Et stærkt socialt fællesskab og sjove sociale arrangementer.

 

Vil du med ombord?

Hvis du har lyst til at blive en del af et internationalt team, hvor vi sætter kvalitet i højsædet, så skal du sende din ansøgning afsted nu. Vi behandler ansøgninger og indkalder til samtaler løbende.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte vores produktionschef, René Hansen, på tlf. (+45) 26 87 44 33.

 

Ansøgning sendes til:          job@kselektro.dk

Tiltrædelse:                            Snarest muligt – eller efter aftale.

 

KS Elektro A/S er et ungt firma, der har stor erfaring og stærke kompetencer indenfor levering af el- og elektronik løsninger til den maritime industri. Vi beskæftiger ca. 150 medarbejdere i Skagen.

Med vores søsterselskab Karstensens Skibsværft, som er førende indenfor nybygning af pelagiske fartøjer og reparationer af forskellige skibstyper, beskæftiger vi tilsammen over 650 medarbejdere. Dertil har vi en ordrebog på 5-7 nybygninger og mellem 100-150 reparations – og større ombygningsopgaver om året.

jobs.description:
**The opportunity**

We are now looking for a Technical Support Engineer at Hitachi Energy, Grid Automation business in Vaasa, Finland.

In this role you will be responsible for providing advanced global technical support, troubleshooting, and consultation for MicroSCADA customers and internal stakeholders. The role focuses on analyzing complex customer cases, identifying root causes, resolving application and configuration issues, and ensuring reliable system performance. The position requires strong technical ownership, close collaboration with R&D, Service, project teams, and customer-facing organizations, and a customer-oriented mindset to deliver high-quality support and guidance.

**How you'll make an impact**

\- Analyze complex customer cases to identify root causes and implement effective corrective actions.

\- Investigate application issues, system malfunctions, and configuration-related challenges to ensure reliable system performance.

\- Provide advanced technical support through our customer support portal, delivering timely and professional assistance.

\- Advise customers and internal teams on software and firmware updates, patch management, system optimization, and best practices.

\- Perform technical validations, proof-of-concept testing, and customer demonstrations to support new solutions and product enhancements.

\- Deliver technical training sessions for customers, channel partners, and internal stakeholders.

\- Develop and continuously improve training materials and supporting resources to reflect evolving products, features, and customer needs.

\- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring issues, sharing lessons learned, and proposing enhancements.

**Your background**

\- Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Automation, or a related technical field.

\- Strong experience in technical support, SCADA engineering, application engineering, commissioning, or a similar technical role.

\- Solid hands-on experience with MicroSCADA systems is required.

\- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.

\- Excellent collaboration skills, including experience working with international and cross-functional teams.

\- Strong ownership mindset, assertiveness, and accountability for assigned tasks and customer issues.

\- Fluent written and spoken English; additional languages are considered an advantage.

\- Willingness to travel occasionally based on business and customer needs.

jobs.title: Project Researcher (PhD. Student) or Postdoctoral Researcher, Electricity Markets and Flexibility (Electrical Engineering) - 2 positions
jobs.description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The University of Vaasa is seeking two motivated and talented Project Researchers or Postdoctoral Researcher to join the Research Council of Finland-funded Electricity Markets and Flexibility project.

The positions are full-time and fixed-term for three (3) years. The preferred starting date is flexible but agreed together as soon as possible. The positions are located in the School of Technology and Innovations and under electrical engineering discipline. The positions are located in Vaasa.

Background

The Electricity Markets and Flexibility project investigates how electricity markets must be designed, and how demand-side flexibility must be mobilised, for a power system dominated by variable renewable generation to remain reliable and affordable.

The project combines quantitative modelling of markets and the wider energy system with empirical analysis of how flexibility is created, priced, and traded by market participants. A central objective is to understand the interaction between market design choices and the total cost of the energy system, and to quantify the value of flexible demand, including the rapidly growing load from data centres, to system operation, investment, and consumers.

The project will produce new knowledge on electricity market design, system-level cost assessment, and demand-side flexibility, as well as new datasets, modelling methods, and blueprints. The results can be directly utilised in the scientific community, but also to improve decision-making in the public and private sectors.

The two positions are divided between two closely connected research themes. Decided theme is chosen depending on the profiles of the selected candidates.

Theme A: Electricity market design and the cost of the whole energy system

Research on this theme addresses the design of wholesale, balancing, reserve, and capacity markets under high shares of variable renewable generation; price formation, scarcity pricing, and locational signals; network charging and cost allocation; and sector coupling with heat and transport. The work involves system-level modelling of investment and operation to assess how alternative market designs affect the total cost of the energy system, security of supply, and the distribution of costs and benefits among market participants.

Theme B: Power system flexibility in data centres

Research on this theme addresses large data centres as controllable electricity loads. Topics include temporal and spatial shifting of computing workloads, the use of on-site energy storage and backup capacity, thermal flexibility and waste heat recovery, participation in wholesale, balancing, and reserve markets, grid connection and connection agreements, and the techno-economic and business case assessment of flexible operation. The work spans the modelling of data centre flexibility potential and its valuation from the perspectives of the operator, the system operator, and society.

https://www.univaasa.fi/en/about/organisation/schools/technology-and-innovations/

Your role

You will play a key role in the project team and actively participate in the implementation of different activities within the research project. The role emphasises the ability to conduct high-quality research and interact with different national and international stakeholders. Your work will contribute directly to project deliverables and high-quality academic publications.

Key responsibilities in the position:

- Contribute to the projects activities.
- Conduct independent and collaborative research within one of the projects research themes.
- Develop, apply, and document quantitative models and analyses of electricity markets, energy systems, or flexible demand.
- Collaborate with an interdisciplinary group of universities, research organisations, system operators, energy companies, technology providers, and data centre operators.
- Participate in data collection, analysis, and validation activities with industry stakeholders and policy makers.
- Lead and co-author high-quality scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals.
- Support teaching or supervision tasks when applicable (according to university guidelines).
- Present research at academic conferences and project meetings.
- Produce a doctoral dissertation based on the research carried out within the project.

The position may also include other tasks to be agreed upon separately. All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

We expect the selected person to have the ability and motivation for doctoral studies and to complete a doctoral degree.

To be eligible for a full PhD student position, the candidate is required to participate in a separate application process which is arranged at least twice a year in order to be admitted and enrolled as a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa. For more information about eligibility and the application process, please visit the Graduate School's website: [Doctoral education | University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Required:

- You have a masters degree or a PhD in a relevant field.
- Strong proven interest in the research area of the project.
- Demonstrated quantitative and analytical skills, including programming or modelling experience.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Motivation to produce high-quality research outputs.
- Excellent communication skills in English.

Desirable:

- Experience with energy system, power system, or electricity market modelling, and with the associated software and programming environments.
- Experience with optimisation, simulation, econometrics, or data analysis applied to energy or market data.
- Knowledge of data centre operations, computing infrastructure, or ICT energy use (Theme B).

jobs.description:
A Mota-Engil ATIV fornece serviços de gestão e manutenção dos ativos físicos dos seus Clientes, nas diferentes etapas do seu ciclo de vida, integrando soluções para a otimização do seu desempenho operacional e otimização de custos, assim como da sua eficiência energética, hídrica e carbónica.

Para esta oportunidade, o profissional a recrutar deverá ser capaz de realizar tarefas de manutenção de instalações, nomeadamente participar em ensaios de circuitos elétricos, máquinas e aparelhagem, inspecionando periodicamente o seu funcionamento; detetar deficiências de instalação e funcionamento; realizar operações de reparação nos sistemas elétricos; cumprir o plano de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e programada.

Requisitos da função e perfil de competências:
- Formação profissional de nível II/III na área de Eletricidade (preferencial);
- Experiência profissional comprovada na realização de tarefas similares à descrição da função;
- Conhecimentos e experiência profissional na manutenção de edifícios;
- Inscrição na DGEG - Direção Geral de Energia e Geologia (preferencial);
- Capacidade de realizar testes, ensaios e medidas elétricas;
- Valorizam-se conhecimentos de informática na ótica do utilizador;
- Responsabilidade e proatividade;
- Dinamismo e autonomia;
- Carta de condução de veículos ligeiros (obrigatório);

Localização: Lodões, Bragança.

Ao ingressar na ATIV, será integrado num grupo empresarial com forte reconhecimento (nacional e internacional) e a empresa proporcionará momentos de aprendizagem e formação contínua.

jobs.title: Osobní bankéř/ka, Přepážkoví konzultanti v peněžnictví
jobs.description:
Hledáte své první zaměstnání, nebo uvažujete o změně oboru? Nemáte zkušenosti v bankovnictví? Nevadí, rádi Vám s tím pomůžeme.
Staňte se odborníkem a oporou pro klienty v oboru financí - buďte jejich pravou rukou při společném hledání produktů a služeb, které jim zjednoduší a ulehčí život. Příležitost začít svoji kariéru u nás dostanete.

Jak si představit svoji novou roli u nás v Monetě?
"    Po nástupu se vám bude věnovat náš tréninkový tým, který vás provede aplikacemi a bankovními systémy, které budete používat. Představíme vám naše produkty a naučíme vás, jak komunikovat s klienty a budovat s nimi dlouhodobé obchodní vztahy
"    Na pobočce v tom nebudete sami. Každý nováček v Monetě má svého buddyho - seniorního kolegu nebo kolegyni, kteří pomohou v prvních měsících se vším, s čím si třeba nebudete jistí
"    Až budete mít vše v malíku, dostanete na starost své klienty, kterým poradíte se vším, co v jejich životní situaci potřebují a zároveň budete aktivně prodávat produkty a služby banky
"    U svých klientů budete aktivně vyhledávat obchodní možnosti, jak vhodně nastavit jejich produkty a služby
"    Pro klienty se stanete tváří naší banky a společně s celým týmem vytvoříte na pobočce příjemnou atmosféru, do které se budou naši klienti rádi vracet

Bez čeho se neobejdete?
"    Středoškolské vzdělání s maturitou a znalost práce na počítači je něco, přes co nejede vlak
"    Jsme tu pro klienty, a proto nám nesmí chybět chuť pomáhat, vymýšlet vhodná řešení a být zkrátka po ruce se vším, co v oblasti financí potřebují

Čím nám uděláte radost?
"    Pokud už jste dříve působili v bankovnictví, obchodu nebo zákaznických službách
"    Bez zákonem daných certifikací - pokud jste v bankovnictví nováčkem, nevadí. Na všechny zkoušky vás po nástupu zaškolíme, a navíc vám každý rok poskytneme 5 dní volna na přípravu nebo následné vzdělávání


Na co se u nás můžete těšit?
"    Práce v MONETA pro nás znamená příležitost být v moderní bance, která je průkopníkem mnoha inovací, digitálním leaderem na bankovním trhu a určuje trendy, za které získává ocenění, a to nejen v bankovní sféře. V roce 2025 jsme se umístili na 9. místě v žebříčku 100 nejhodnotnějších českých firem, patříme mezi TOP 10 odpovědných velkých firem a zvítězili jsme v kategoriích Počin roku a Klientsky nejpřívětivější banka v anketě Nejlepší banka dle Visa. Každoročně se také umisťujeme na předních příčkách v ceně veřejnosti Zlatá koruna.
"    Na svůj nový tým?- máme tu přátelskou atmosféru, protože nejsme jen kolegové, ale také parťáci, kteří spolu rádi sdílí i méně pracovní témata
"    Stabilní zaměstnání v bankovnictví, které je pilířem každé ekonomiky

KONTAKT: e-mailem Kateřina Ambroz Jaremčuková, e-mail: katerina.ambrozjaremcukova@moneta.cz

jobs.description:
Hledáte své první zaměstnání, nebo uvažujete o změně oboru? Nemáte zkušenosti v bankovnictví? Nevadí, rádi Vám s tím pomůžeme.
Staňte se odborníkem a oporou pro klienty v oboru financí - buďte jejich pravou rukou při společném hledání produktů a služeb, které jim zjednoduší a ulehčí život. Příležitost začít svoji kariéru u nás dostanete.

Jak si představit svoji novou roli u nás v Monetě?
"    Po nástupu se vám bude věnovat náš tréninkový tým, který vás provede aplikacemi a bankovními systémy, které budete používat. Představíme vám naše produkty a naučíme vás, jak komunikovat s klienty a budovat s nimi dlouhodobé obchodní vztahy
"    Na pobočce v tom nebudete sami. Každý nováček v Monetě má svého buddyho - seniorního kolegu nebo kolegyni, kteří pomohou v prvních měsících se vším, s čím si třeba nebudete jistí
"    Až budete mít vše v malíku, dostanete na starost své klienty, kterým poradíte se vším, co v jejich životní situaci potřebují a zároveň budete aktivně prodávat produkty a služby banky
"    U svých klientů budete aktivně vyhledávat obchodní možnosti, jak vhodně nastavit jejich produkty a služby
"    Pro klienty se stanete tváří naší banky a společně s celým týmem vytvoříte na pobočce příjemnou atmosféru, do které se budou naši klienti rádi vracet

Bez čeho se neobejdete?
"    Středoškolské vzdělání s maturitou a znalost práce na počítači je něco, přes co nejede vlak
"    Jsme tu pro klienty, a proto nám nesmí chybět chuť pomáhat, vymýšlet vhodná řešení a být zkrátka po ruce se vším, co v oblasti financí potřebují

Čím nám uděláte radost?
"    Pokud už jste dříve působili v bankovnictví, obchodu nebo zákaznických službách
"    Bez zákonem daných certifikací - pokud jste v bankovnictví nováčkem, nevadí. Na všechny zkoušky vás po nástupu zaškolíme, a navíc vám každý rok poskytneme 5 dní volna na přípravu nebo následné vzdělávání


Na co se u nás můžete těšit?
"    Práce v MONETA pro nás znamená příležitost být v moderní bance, která je průkopníkem mnoha inovací, digitálním leaderem na bankovním trhu a určuje trendy, za které získává ocenění, a to nejen v bankovní sféře. V roce 2025 jsme se umístili na 9. místě v žebříčku 100 nejhodnotnějších českých firem, patříme mezi TOP 10 odpovědných velkých firem a zvítězili jsme v kategoriích Počin roku a Klientsky nejpřívětivější banka v anketě Nejlepší banka dle Visa. Každoročně se také umisťujeme na předních příčkách v ceně veřejnosti Zlatá koruna.
"    Na svůj nový tým?- máme tu přátelskou atmosféru, protože nejsme jen kolegové, ale také parťáci, kteří spolu rádi sdílí i méně pracovní témata
"    Stabilní zaměstnání v bankovnictví, které je pilířem každé ekonomiky

jobs.title: ICT-ratkaisuasiantuntija, yli 12kk
jobs.description:
Varmista automaation ja uusien ICT-palveluiden katkeamaton arki sote-ympäristössä!

Työelämän paras aikaa odottaa sinua Keusotessa!

Etsimme kokenutta ja palvelunhallinnan (ITIL) salat tuntevaa asiantuntijaa määräaikaiseen tehtävään palvelukokonaisuuksien suunnitteluun.

ICT-ratkaisuasiantuntijana tulet toimimaan tietohallinnon ICT-palveluiden yksikössä, jossa roolisi on kriittinen: varmistat, että Keusoten suuren 10 miljoonan euron investointiohjelman tuottamat uudet teknologiat ja automaatiot laskeutuvat jatkuvaan tuotantoon hallitusti, vikasietoisesti ja elinkaarikestävästi.

Tässä roolissa toimit tiiviinä työparina kehityspuolen Ratkaisuarkkitehdille sekä jatkuvien palveluiden ICT- asiantuntijoille, tuoden palvelumuotoilun ja operatiivisen tehokkuuden näkökulman uuden teknologian jalkauttamiseen.

ICT-ratkaisuasiantuntijana tuot "Ops"-näkökulman suoraan kehityshankkeiden ytimeen. Tehtäväsi on varmistaa, ettei uusi älykäs automaatio (kuten AI-toiminnot, edistynyt ohjelmistorobotiikka ja integraatiot) jää irralliseksi, vaan sen tuomat tuottavuushyödyt ulosmitataan sote-palvelutoiminnassa täysimääräisesti sujuvan, vakaan ja loppukäyttäjälle optimoidun palvelutuotannon kautta.

Keskeisiä vastuualueitasi ovat:

- Automaation tuotantoon vienti ja vakauttaminen: Vastaat siitä, että kehityshankkeiden automaatioratkaisut (esim. ServiceNow tai tekoäly) siirtyvät tuotantoon luotettavasti ja ilman manuaalista häiriönhallinnan tarvetta.
- Palveluarkkitehtuurin suunnittelu: Määrittelet ja varmistat yhdessä ict-palveluarkkitehtien kanssa, että uudet järjestelmät täyttävät jatkuvien palveluiden laatuvaatimukset, kuten valvonta-, tuki-, dokumentaatio- ja elinkaarimallit.
- Hankintojen palveluvaatimukset: Osallistut suurten ICT-kilpailutusten (kuten talous-, HR- ja asianhallintajärjestelmät) valmisteluun asettamalla toimittajille tiukat ylläpito-, jatkuvuus- ja palvelutasovaatimukset (SLA).
- Asiantuntijayksikön tekninen tuki: Toimit ICT-asiantuntijoiden ja järjestelmävastaavien teknisenä sparrauskumppanina monimutkaisissa ongelmanratkaisutilanteissa sekä palveluiden muutoshallinnassa (Change Management).

Tehtävään edellytettävä kelpoisuus

- Kelpoisuusehtona tehtävään on soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. tietotekniikka tai tietojärjestelmätiede) sekä vahva käytännön kokemus laajojen IT-palvelukokonaisuuksien ja palveluarkkitehtuurin hallinnasta.

Hakijalta odotamme ja toivomme

Olet luonteeltasi siltoja rakentava asiantuntija, joka ymmärtää sekä modernin IT-arkkitehtuurin mahdollisuudet että arjen sujuvan palvelutuotannon ja loppukäyttäjän tarpeet.

- Substanssiosaaminen: Syvällinen IT-palvelunhallinnan (ITIL) viitekehyksen ja prosessien tuntemus. Hyvä tekninen ymmärrys pilvipalveluista, integraatioista (API) sekä automaatioratkaisujen (RPA/AI) operatiivisesta ylläpidosta.
- Järjestelmäosaaminen: Erinomainen hallinta palvelunhallinnan työkaluista (ITSM) sekä strategiamme mukaisesti Google-ekosysteemin laajamittainen osaaminen.
- Vuorovaikutustaidot: Erinomaiset yhteistyö- ja viestintätaidot. Kyky toimia tulkkina ja koordinaattorina kehityksen, jatkuvien palveluiden asiantuntijoiden sekä ulkopuolisten toimittajien välillä.

Lisätiedot tehtävästä antaa ICT-aluepäällikkö Saku Salonen, p. 040 304 7040, saku.salonen@keusote.fi

Lisätiedot palvelussuhteesta sekä tehtävään esitettävät selvitykset

- Määräaikainen palvelussuhde ajalle 1.1.2027-31.12.2028.
- Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 4930,86 e/kk. Maksamme työkokemukseen perustuvaa lisää.
- Tehtävässä noudatetaan koeaikaa.
- Alkuperäiset työ- ja opiskelutodistukset esitetään mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä.

RESPONSABILITÉS :

Nous recherchons  un(e) Expert Data AWS capable de trouver des solutions innovantes et robustes à l'ensemble des problématiques Data.
Vous aurez la charge de :
- Participer à la conception et réalisation d'une solution Data depuis l'acquisition jusqu'à l'exploitation de la donnée en accompagnant la réflexion des directions métiers
- Identifier, collecter et intégrer les données nécessaires à la résolution de problématiques métier et opérationnelles
- Garantir la qualité des données en mettant en place les outils de mesure et de suivi adéquats en appliquant les règles de Data Gouvernance et de Data Management
- Transcrire des besoins métier en règles de gestion data
- Industrialiser le déploiement de vos réalisations à travers l'implémentation de tests unitaires, d'intégration et de non-régression

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ :

En tant que Expert data AWS vous maîtrisez :
- Maîtrise du langage SQL
- Bonne connaissance d'un langage orienté objet, notamment Python
- Expérience avec un framework de calcul distribué tel que Apache Spark
- Utilisation d'outils de traitement et d'orchestration de données comme Databricks et Azure Data Factory
- Connaissance des outils d' intégration continue : Git, JUnit, SonarQube, Jenkins
- Expérience avec un cloud provider, notamment Microsoft / AWS
- Maîtrise des concepts de modélisation de données, relationnelle et non-relationnelle
Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'une université, vous justifiez d'au minimum 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans un contexte projet Data. Rigoureux(se), proactif(ve) et autonome vous restez en veille technologique et êtes force de proposition. Vous êtes capable de prendre de la hauteur et vous adapter aux enjeux du projet.

jobs.title: Ingénieur Devops Cloud (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Lieu : Carquefou, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d'activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l'environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d'euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l'innovation tels que l'IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays.

Nos engagements, vos avantages***Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée***Un package de rémunération attractif***Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes***Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l'équilibre des collaborateurs***Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

En nous rejoignant à Carquefou, à proximité de Nantes, vous intégrez un site dynamique regroupant nos activités de services numériques permettant d'opérer les systèmes d'informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée.

De formation Bac +5 en informatique ou développement logiciel (école d'ingénieur, Master ou équivalent), vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans le domaine du DevOps.

Vous maîtrisez les outils de Build & Release (Git, Maven, Gradle, Jenkins, Nexus, SonarQube) et êtes à l'aise avec les principaux cloud providers (Google Cloud, AWS et Azure), aussi bien sur les instances que sur les services managés.

Vous êtes également capable de justifier vos choix de solutions cloud sur les volets opérationnels et financiers.

Des connaissances en Ansible et Kubernetes seraient un plus.

Pour réussir dans cette fonction, vous êtes rigoureux(se), doté(e) d'un bon relationnel et appréciez le travail en équipe.

Vous avez le sens de l'engagement ?
Vous êtes force de proposition ?

Le poste d'Ingénieur DevOps Cloud (H/F) est fait pour vous !

CE QUE NOUS POUVONS ACCOMPLIR ENSEMBLE

Au sein du centre de compétences de Nantes, vous intervenez sur des projets innovants et concevez les automatismes du système d'information : intégration, tests automatisés et déploiement continu.

Vous êtes l'interface privilégiée entre les équipes de développement et les équipes d'exploitation pour les sujets liés à l'installation, la supervision, la sauvegarde et l'administration technique.

Vous participez également aux projets de Move to Cloud , en accompagnant la migration d'applications existantes vers le cloud.

Vous pourrez également être amené(e) à contribuer aux réponses à appels d'offres, notamment sur l'analyse des besoins et le chiffrage technique.

En nous rejoignant en tant qu'Ingénieur(e) DevOps Cloud, vous aurez pour principales missions Créer et gérer les infrastructures cloud des projets, aussi bien sur les services managés que sur les instances Mettre en place et maintenir les plateformes de développement, notamment les outils de delivery continu, en accompagnant les équipes projet Préconiser des choix techniques afin de garantir la cohérence des évolutions et conseiller les équipes sur les solutions d'automatisation du système d'information Participer aux mises en production et aux investigations en cas d'incident de production Animer les réunions d'amélioration continue des processus de mise en production avec les équipes de développement et d'exploitation Partager les pratiques DevOps et en promouvoir l'adoption auprès des projets du Centre de Compétences Capitaliser, au niveau national, sur les expériences réussies et les assets réutilisables.

Vous serez amené(e) à travailler sur des projets complexes à forte valeur ajoutée, pour le groupe Thales comme pour ses clients.

La perspective de rejoindre un groupe innovant vous motive ?

Alors rejoignez-nous en postulant à cette offre !

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !
