O(A) candidato(a) selecionado(a) terá um papel fundamental no suporte às operações diárias do gabinete, assumindo responsabilidades transversais entre a contabilidade geral e a gestão de recursos humanos dos nossos clientes.
Principais Responsabilidades:
Dar apoio a todo o processo contabilístico, assegurando a classificação e o lançamento de documentos de acordo com o Sistema de Normalização Contabilística (SNC).
Assegurar a gestão da área de Recursos Humanos, incluindo processamento salarial, comunicação de admissões e cessações, e envio de declarações obrigatórias (DMR, DRI, Fundos de Compensação, etc.).
Apoiar na preparação, cumprimento e submissão de obrigações fiscais e declarativas à Autoridade Tributária e Segurança Social.
Realizar reconciliações bancárias e conferência de contas correntes de clientes e fornecedores.
Prestar apoio administrativo e esclarecimento de dúvidas aos clientes.
Perfil Pretendido:
Formação académica em Contabilidade, Gestão ou área equivalente.
Inscrição ativa na Ordem dos Contabilistas Certificados (valorizada, mas não eliminatória caso se candidate a Técnico de Contabilidade).
Experiência profissional consolidada e comprovada em funções similares, com forte autonomia na área de Recursos Humanos.
Conhecimentos sólidos e atualizados da legislação laboral e fiscal portuguesa.
Domínio de softwares de contabilidade (TOConline, Primavera, Sage]) e ferramentas do Microsoft Office.
Capacidade de organização, rigor analítico e gestão de prazos.

jobs.title: Fachpsychotherapeut / Fachpsychotherapeutin (a) (Fachpsychotherapeut/in - Erwachsene)
jobs.description:
Wir suchen per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte, verantwortungsbewusste Fachpsychotherapeut oder Fachpsychotherapeutin – mit Freude an kollegialer Zusammenarbeit und ganzheitlicher Patientenbetreuung.

Fachpsychotherapeut / Fachpsychotherapeutin (m/w/d)

Tätigkeit

- Sie führen Indikationsgespräche sowie diagnostische Abklärungen inklusive Diagnosestellung
- Sie betreuen eigenverantwortlich Patienten in Einzel- und Gruppentherapien
- Sie übernehmen Fallführung, individuelle Therapieplanung sowie Dokumentation und Berichtswesen
- Sie führen Gespräche mit Angehörigen, Case Managern und weiteren involvierten Stellen
- Sie wirken mit bei Gruppengesprächen, psychoedukativen Angeboten, Patientenvorträgen und Entspannungsverfahren
- Sie nehmen regelmässig an internen und externen Supervisionen, Intervisionen und Fortbildungen teil

Anforderungen

- Abgeschlossene Weiterbildung in Psychotherapie (https://www.bag.admin.ch/de/anerkennungen-von-psychologieberufen) mit in der Schweiz anerkannter Qualifikation
- Fundierte klinische Erfahrung, insbesondere in Einzel- und Gruppentherapie
- Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit und am professionellen Austausch
- Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Sozialkompetenz und Verlässlichkeit
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil

Angebot

- Abwechslungsreiche und anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit in einem motivierten und engagierten Team
- Gute Einführung ins Aufgabengebiet
- Fallbezogene Supervision und laufende Fortbildung, weitere interne und externe berufliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

jobs.title: Recepcionista (Empfangskraft)
jobs.description:
Recepcionista

Descripción de la empresa

Nuestro corazón es turquesa.

Trabajar para Motel One es como estar en casa de un amigo, donde el reconocimiento y el apoyo gozan de la máxima importancia y las cualidades personales son bien acogidas. Nos tratamos de igual a igual y formamos equipo: desde la dirección hasta los becarios.

Con nuestra pasión conjunta por el diseño moderno y la alta calidad de servicio, creamos un hogar para nuestros huéspedes en Motel One. Nuestros más de 80 hoteles en doce países impresionan por su diseño exclusivo, los altos estándares de servicio y las ubicaciones privilegiadas en el centro urbano, siempre a un precio atractivo.

Como fundadores y embajadores del concepto de diseño asequible, nos estamos expandiendo con éxito por las ciudades de Europa y más allá. Únase a nuestro equipo y demos forma juntos a Motel One.

Descripción del empleo

El objetivo de este puesto es ofrecer una atención profesional a nuestros huéspedes, desde una cálida bienvenida en el check-in hasta una bonita despedida en el check-out. Sus responsabilidades también incluirán las siguientes:

- Atender a nuestros huéspedes, incluyendo la realización del check-in y check-out
- Revisar y procesar reservas, sobrerreservas y otras opciones
- Gestionar la facturación, incluida la gestión de pagos, así como transacciones y cobros en efectivo
- Realizar tareas organizativas y administrativas en el front-office y back-office (por ejemplo, gestión de ausencias, respuesta a correos electrónicos)
- Adquirir conocimientos interdepartamentales sobre nuevas áreas de actividad mediante el trabajo en nuestros equipos multiculturales

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Requisitos

Tanto si es un profesional del mundo de los hoteles como si está cambiando de carrera profesional, ¡estamos seguros de que su perfil encajará en nuestra empresa! ¡La personalidad y los dotes de anfitrión son nuestra prioridad! También tendrá que reunir los siguientes requisitos:

- Tener formación en el sector de los hoteles y/o tener experiencia profesional en la industria hotelera/catering o estar buscando un cambio de carrera profesional
- Tener un excelente sentido de la calidad y el servicio, así como dotes de anfitrión y pasión por la industria hotelera
- Ser una persona abierta y comunicativa y tener un sólido dominio del inglés
- Ser una persona a la que le guste trabajar en equipo y que esté dispuesta a proporcionar asistencia en todos los departamentos: ¡en Motel One, los objetivos son conjuntos, así que nos ayudamos entre todos!

jobs.title: Reservierungsmitarbeiter (m/w/d) (Reservierungssachbearbeiter/in (Hotel))
jobs.description:
Reservierungsmitarbeiter (m/w/d)

Stellenbeschreibung

Als herzliche Stimme am Telefon oder als freundlicher Kontakt per Mail: Du bietest unseren Gästen bereits bei der Reservierung einen exzellenten Service. Zusätzlich kümmerst Du dich um:

- Prüfung und Bearbeitung der Reservierungen, Überbuchungen und Optionen
- Pflege von Sihot sowie den elektronischen Reservierungssystemen
- Rechnungserstellung und -kontrolle (Debitoren und Kreditoren) unter Beachtung der Preisvorgaben
- Deposithandling und Überwachung der fristgerechten Zahlungseingänge
- Unterstützung des Sales- sowie des Front Office Teams zu Spitzenzeiten

Benefits:

- Bonus-Programm: Je besser die Gäste ihren Aufenthalt bewerten, desto höher fällt der Bonus für das ganze Team aus.
- International Karriere machen: Unsere nationalen und internationalen Hotels oder Neueröffnungen eröffnen zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten.
- Günstig übernachten in ganz Europa: Vorteile sichern! Mit günstigen Personalraten in unseren Hotels in ganz Europa und in New York sowie weitere attraktiven Rabatten.
- Sich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln: Mit einer umfangreichen Einarbeitung, jährlichen Schulungen und Coachings an der One University richtig durchstarten.
- Gemeinsam feiern: Ob Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unser jährliches internationales Fußballturnier – Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam mit dem Team.
- Kostengünstig und nachhaltig zur Arbeit: Es kann zwischen einem Zuschuss zum ÖPNV oder einem kostenlosen Fahrrad gewählt werden.

Qualifikationen

Ob als Hotelprofi oder im Quereinstieg – Du passt zu uns! Denn Persönlichkeit und Gastgeberqualitäten stehen bei uns an erster Stelle! Außerdem zeichnen dich aus:

- Ausbildung im Hotelfach bzw. Berufserfahrung in der Hotellerie/Gastronomie/telefonischen Kundendienst oder Interesse an einem Quereinstieg
- Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und Serviceorientierung sowie Gastgeberqualitäten und Leidenschaft für die Hotellerie
- Offenes, kommunikatives Auftreten, gute Umgangsformen sowie eine gute Ausdrucksweise in Deutsch & Englisch (Wort & Schrift)
- Teamfähigkeit und Bereitschaft abteilungsübergreifend zu unterstützen – Wir erreichen unsere Erfolge gemeinsam

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator (m/w/d) - Dornbirn (Fachverkäufer/in - Kraftfahrzeuge)
jobs.description:
Was Dich erwartet

Du arbeitest fachübergreifend daran mit, unseren Kund:innen eine exzellentes Erlebnis zu bieten – indem du die täglichen reibungslosen Abläufe an unserem TESLA Standort in Thaur sicherstellst. Du planst, koordinierst und verfolgst alle Prozesse rund um die Fahrzeugvorbereitung und -lieferung, kommunizierst effektiv und steigerst die operative Effizienz. Du verfügst über die technische Kompetenz, um klar und zielgerichtet mit internen Teammitgliedern zu kommunizieren, und bringst die Fähigkeit mit, einen exzellenten Kundenservice zu gewährleisten, um die Begeisterung unserer Kund:innen zu wecken.

Wir bieten

- Karriere und Weiterbildung: Bei Tesla hast du die Möglichkeit zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung durch regelmäßige Performance Reviews, gezielte Trainingsmaßnahmen und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (z.B. Hochvolt- und Sicherheitsschulungen sowie weitere technische Trainings)
- Unternehmenskultur: Tauche ein in unsere inspirierende Unternehmenskultur, in der Innovation, Teamwork und Leidenschaft im Mittelpunkt stehen
- Innovation und Technologie: Arbeite an wegweisenden Projekten und Technologien, die die Zukunft der Automobilindustrie und nachhaltiger Energie mitgestalten
- Vorteile und Zusatzleistungen: Dich erwartet ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket, das neben Tesla-Aktien oder einem Cash Award auch den Zugang zu unserem Corporate Benefits Programm umfasst
- Engagiertes Team und positive Arbeitsatmosphäre: Arbeite in einem engagierten und motivierten Team mit starkem Teamspirit und Zusammenarbeit. Sei Teil eines Teams, das einen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Zukunft und zu erneuerbaren Energien leistet

Was zu tun ist

- Fahrzeugkoordination: Du koordinierst Fahrzeugbewegungen in den Parkplätzen und Lieferhallen, überwachst Liefertermine und sorgst für eine reibungslose Abwicklung von Reparaturen und Vorbereitungen
- Standort: Du sorgst dafür, dass die Standorte gut organisiert und gepflegt sind
- Fahrzeugmanagement: Du übernimmst die Verwaltung der Leihfahrzeugflotte sowie die komplette Abwicklung – von Eingang über Inspektion, Vorbereitung, Versand bis zur Lieferung – gebrauchter Fahrzeuge
- Prozess- und Tool-Support: Du identifizierst Bedarfe deines Teams an Prozessen und Tools und stellst passende Unterstützung (z. B. Schulungen, Kommunikation) bereit
- Kundenzufriedenheit: Du arbeitest eng mit allen Kolleg:innen an deinem Standort zusammen, um am Lieferungstag eine Top-Erfahrung für die Kund:innen zu gewährleisten und unterstützt bei Eskalationen
- Teamwork: Du bist die Schnittstelle zu anderen Teams (Verkauf, Logistik, Service) und arbeitest fachübergreifend mit ihnen zusammen

- TESLA Mission: Du bist begeistert von unserer Mission und unseren Produkten und hast den Wunsch, diese Begeisterung mit anderen zu teilen
- Kundenservice: Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kunden, sowie exzellente Kommunikations- und Sozialkompetenzen und die Fähigkeit starke Beziehungen aufzubauen
- Anpassungsfähig: Du hast starke operative Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben und Prioritäten in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld zu bewältigen
- Lösungsorientiert: Du hast gute Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, potenzielle Probleme zu erkennen und zu lösen, bevor sie entstehen
- Motivation: Du bringst Liebe zum Detail und Fokus auf Genauigkeit mit
- Sprachkenntnisse: Du kannst fließend auf Englisch und Deutsch zu kommunizieren, lesen und schreiben
- Berechtigt: Du besitzt einen gültigen Führerschein und die Berechtigung in Österreich zu leben und zu arbeitenFür diese Position bieten wir ein jährliches Bruttomindestgehalt von € 54 000 auf Basis des oben angeführten Anforderungsprofils bei Vollzeitbeschäftigung an. Entsprechende Berufserfahrung und Qualifikation werden zusätzlich berücksichtigt. Darüber hinaus bieten wir ein Tesla Aktienpaket an.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Specialist (m/w/d) - Dornbirn (Automobil-Fachwirt/in)
jobs.description:
Was Dich erwartet

Als Customer Experience Specialist bei Tesla bist du dafür verantwortlich, unseren Kunden einen freundlichen und informativen Empfang zu bieten. Du bist Teil des Front-of-House-Teams, das den Verkauf und die Auslieferung unterstützt, und fungierst gleichzeitig als Produktexperte, der alle Fragen unserer Kunden beantworten kann. Bei Tesla sind wir davon überzeugt, dass jeder Kunde ein reibungsloses und außergewöhnliches Erlebnis mit seinem Tesla-Fahrzeug verdient. Dein Hauptaugenmerk wird darauf liegen, ein außergewöhnliches Kundenerlebnis zu bieten und sicherzustellen, dass sich jeder Kunde wertgeschätzt, gehört und unterstützt fühlt. Du wirst von der Mission von Tesla angetrieben, den Übergang der Welt zu nachhaltiger Energie zu beschleunigen. Du bist Teil eines größeren Vertriebs- und Lieferteams, das bei allen Aufgaben eng und flexibel zusammenarbeitet. Es wird von dir erwartet, dass du häufig kooperierst und eine Ein-Team-Mentalität an den Tag legst, um die Verkaufs- und Lieferziele zu erreichen.

Was zu tun ist

- Du baust eine Beziehung zu den Kunden auf und versorgst sie mit den Informationen, die sie benötigen, um eine fundierte Entscheidung über den Kauf eines Tesla Fahrzeugs oder Produkts zu treffen
- Du bietest eine umfassende Produktvorführung an und beantwortest alle Fragen, die Kunden zu den Merkmalen, Spezifikationen und Preisen des Fahrzeugs haben
- Durchführung von Probefahrten, bei denen die Fähigkeiten, Sicherheits- und Leistungsmerkmale des Fahrzeugs hervorgehoben werden
- Zusammenarbeit mit dem Auslieferungsteam, um sicherzustellen, dass die Kunden über den Fortschritt ihres Fahrzeugs auf dem Laufenden gehalten werden und regelmäßig Informationen über die Lieferfristen erhalten
- Durchführung von Inspektionen vor der Auslieferung, um sicherzustellen, dass jedes Fahrzeug den hohen Qualitätsstandards von Tesla entspricht
- Unterstützung beim Auslieferungsprozess, einschließlich der Begleitung der Kunden zu ihrem Fahrzeug und der abschließenden Abnahme des Fahrzeugs
- Du fungierst als Ansprechpartner für Anfragen nach dem Verkauf und bietest bei Bedarf Hilfe und Unterstützung an

Was mitzubringen ist

- Hervorragende zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten mit einer natürlichen Fähigkeit, eine Beziehung zu Kunden aufzubauen und mit ihnen in Kontakt zu treten
- Gute Kenntnisse der Produkte von Tesla, einschließlich Fahrzeugen, Solarmodulen und Energiespeicherlösungen
- Die Fähigkeit, Informationen auf leicht verständliche Weise zu vermitteln
- Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung hervorragender Kundenerfahrungen
- Ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mehrere Prioritäten zu setzen
- Flexibilität, bei Bedarf auch an Wochenenden und abends zu arbeiten
- Leidenschaft für die Mission von Tesla, den Übergang der Welt zu nachhaltiger Energie zu beschleunigen

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager (M/W/D) B2B / Life Science Division (Kaufmann/-frau - Marketingkommunikation)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Digital Marketing Manager

Stellenbeschreibung:
Your Future at 3CON

The 3CON Group is an internationally successful hidden champion in plant engineering and special-purpose machinery. For many years, we have been developing high-end solutions for the automotive industry, the life sciences sector, and other demanding industries.

We are 3CON — bold pioneers, dependable problem-solvers, and a family-run global player. With over 800 employees worldwide across Austria, Germany, the USA, Mexico, and China, we shape industrial manufacturing at the highest level.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed and creative individual to join us as a:
Digital Marketing Manager (m/f/d) — B2B / Life Sciences

Your Responsibilities:

● Planning, optimizing, and analyzing performance campaigns (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads), along with ongoing SEO optimization of our new WordPress website.

● Structured qualification and handover of marketing leads to our sales teams.

● Creating white papers, technical articles, case studies, and web content tailored to decision-makers in the pharma and biopharma sectors.

● End-to-end organization of major international trade fairs (e.g. CPHI, Interphex), including compliance with all booth-construction and logistics requirements.

● Strategic development and editorial planning of our social media activities.

● Monitoring campaign and event budgets.

Your Profile:

● Experienced in international B2B marketing, combined with a solid technical understanding of the pharma, biopharma, life sciences sector.

● Sound knowledge of LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, SEO, and analytics tools.

● Fluent, business-level English (written and spoken) is essential — it is our primary working language.

● Very good German (written and spoken) is also required for day-to-day collaboration.

● A structured way of working and strong execution skills when meeting complex deadlines.

● Hands-on experience with WordPress and CRM systems is an advantage.

● Basic graphic design skills for independently creating social media posts and smaller marketing materials are desirable.

● Experience organizing international trade fair appearances.

What We Offer:

● Challenging tasks in an international environment with flexible working-time models.

● State-of-the-art workplaces designed to the latest ergonomic standards.

● Individual development paths through a wide range of internal and external training opportunities.

● The opportunity for assignments abroad at our plants (Mexico, China, USA), including special bonuses.

● An in-house 3CON Health Center with a company doctor, sports offerings, and subsidized therapeutic massages (50% covered).

● An excellent company restaurant serving freshly prepared, regional dishes at preferential prices.

● A genuine team spirit fostered through regular sports, team-building, and social events.

● Exclusive employee benefits (including bike leasing and discounts with partner companies such as Hagebau and the Inntal Logistics Park).

Rewards That Pay Off:

● Compensation is based on the collective agreement for the metal industry. As we set high standards for top performance, we are expressly willing to pay significantly above this baseline — your actual salary will be agreed individually, based on your qualifications and professional experience.

Have we sparked your interest? Then we‘d love to get to know you.

- Du arbeitest aktiv mit dem Business Sales-Lead zusammen, um eine kohärente Strategie für das Wachstum des B2B-Vertriebs in Wien zu entwickeln
- Du optimierst kontinuierlich interne Prozesse, um operative Effizienz sicherzustellen
- Du arbeitest abteilungsübergreifend, um deinen Beitrag zum Gesamtgeschäftsplan zu leisten
- Du besitzt umfassende Produktkenntnisse zu allen Fahrzeugen, Prozessen und Business-Finance-Lösungen und führst regelmäßig Wettbewerbsanalysen durch

- Du hast vertriebliche Erfolge erzielt, vorzugsweise im B2B-Bereich, und kannst konkrete Ergebnisse deiner Arbeit nachweisen
- Du arbeitest selbstständig und setzt dich engagiert für deine Kunden und unser Team ein, indem du starke Geschäftsbeziehungen aufbaust und als respektierter, vertrauenswürdiger Partner agierst, mit dem andere gerne zusammenarbeiten
- Du denkst strategisch, handelst vorausschauend und setzt dich mit Leidenschaft für die Mission von Tesla ein
- Du kannst effektiv Prioritäten setzen, mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig steuern und Deadlines zuverlässig einhalten
- Du liebst es, den Status quo zu verändern und kannst auch in Situationen mit hohem Druck gut arbeiten
- Du bist verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse
- Dein Wohnsitz sollte idealerweise in Wien liegen, da die Position eine Reisetätigkeit von etwa 2–3 Tagen pro Woche umfasst – dabei handelt es sich um Tagesbesuche bei Kunden
- Du bist seit mindestens zwei Jahren im Besitz eines gültigen EU-Führerscheins (Klasse B)Für diese Position bieten wir ein jährliches Bruttomindestgehalt von € 62.000 auf Basis des oben angeführten Anforderungsprofils bei Vollzeitbeschäftigung an. Entsprechende Berufserfahrung und Qualifikation werden zusätzlich berücksichtigt. Darüber hinaus bieten wir ein Tesla Aktienpaket an.

Tesla ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit verwirklicht, und der sich der Diversität am Arbeitsplatz verpflichtet hat. Alle qualifizierten Bewerber für eine Stelle haben die gleiche Chance unabhängig von Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, geschlechtlicher Orientierung, Alter, Herkunftsland, Behinderung, Veteranenschutzstatus, geschlechtlicher Identität oder anderen Faktoren, die durch die geltenden US-, bundesstaatlichen oder örtlichen Gesetze geschützt sind.

Tesla engagiert sich übrigens dafür, Chancengleichheit für Menschen mit Behinderungen zu verwirklichen und ihnen dafür angemessene Vorkehrungen zu bieten. Bitte teilen Sie Ihrem Personalverantwortlichen mit, wenn Sie zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt während des Vorstellungsgesprächs eine spezielle Unterstützung benötigen.

Datenschutz hat für Tesla höchste Priorität. Wir integrieren ihn in unsere Produkte und betrachten ihn als wesentlichen Bestandteil unseres Geschäfts. jobs.title: Empregado de Mesa (Servicekraft - Gastronomie und Gastgewerbe)
jobs.description:
Empregado de Mesa

Descrição da empresa

You create experiences for our guests. As an employer, we create experiences for you. How? At The Cloud One, every day is unique. Never same-same, always thrillingly different. With us, you have the freedom to be who you are – or who you want to be. Because here, individuality is what matters. With equal – and exciting – opportunities for all. We believe in an inclusive culture that puts people like you at the heart of what we do, because we know that you’re the ones who make the difference. For us, respect and success go hand in hand. We’re locally rooted: connected to the city, its culture and its people. Are you with us?

Descrição do emprego

Estamos à procura de um(a) Empregado(a) de Mesa com paixão pelo serviço, atenção ao detalhe e vontade de proporcionar experiências memoráveis aos nossos clientes. A pessoa selecionada irá integrar uma equipa dinâmica e colaborativa numa unidade hoteleira em Lisboa, onde o foco está na hospitalidade genuína e no serviço de excelência.

Principais Responsabilidades:

- Receber e acompanhar os clientes de forma cordial e profissional.
- Apresentar o menu, esclarecer dúvidas e fazer sugestões adequadas.
- Servir refeições e bebidas com eficiência, atenção e simpatia.
- Assegurar que todas as necessidades dos clientes são atendidas durante o serviço.
- Preparar e organizar mesas antes e após o serviço.
- Colaborar com a equipa de sala e cozinha para garantir um serviço fluido.
- Cumprir com os padrões de higiene, segurança e qualidade definidos pela unidade.

Qualificações

Formação e Experiência:

- Experiência mínima de 3 anos em funções semelhantes (preferencialmente em hotelaria ou restauração de luxo).
- Formação na área de hotelaria ou restauração (valorizada).

Competências Técnicas:

- Conhecimento de técnicas de serviço à mesa.
- Capacidade de trabalhar com sistemas de POS.
- Conhecimento das normas HACCP.

Competências Pessoais:

- Excelente comunicação e apresentação pessoal.
- Simpatia, proatividade e atenção ao cliente.
- Espírito de equipa e flexibilidade para trabalhar por turnos, fins de semana e feriados.
- Fluência em português e inglês (outras línguas são valorizadas).

jobs.title: ELEKTRO ODRŽAVATELJ / ODRŽAVATELJICA
jobs.description:
• Provedba investicijskih planova, razrada elektro-dijela idejnog projekta te izrada potrebnih elektro-shema
  • Izrada plana investicijskog održavanja i potrebne dokumentacije te provedba plana
  • Nadzor nad potrošnjom električne energije
  • Održavanje automatskog upravljanja na elektro-motornim pogonima
  • Popravci i izmjene svih dotrajalih elektro uređaja te elektroinstalacija
  • Remont svih dizalica i ostalog postrojenja
  • Drugi poslovi po nalogu nadređene osobe

jobs.title: MEHANIČAR/MEHANIČARKA ODRŽAVANJA
jobs.description:
• Obavlja svakodnevni pregled dizalica i ostalih strojeva te upisuje u propisne obrasce, tablice i knjige
  • Vrši popravke i izmjene svih dotrajalih uređaja na mosnim dizalicama, miješalicama pijeska, kaluparskim strojevima, sačmarilicama, brusilicama, jezgrarskim i ostalim strojevima
  • Obavlja popravak i zamjenu rezervnih dijelova na ostalim uređajima i postrojenjima
  • Vrši remont svih dizalica i ostalog postrojenja
  • Vodi brigu o čistoći alata s kojim rukuje
  • Prijavljuje nadređenom rukovoditelju svako nepravilno rukovanje ili kvar
  • Kod manjih kvarova pomaže ih otkloniti u suradnji s dežurnim elektro-održavateljem ili bravarom
  • Pri izvođenju radova poštuje propisane uvjete rada te mjere zaštite na radu i upute proizvođača opreme za rad
  • Sigurnosne uređaje i osobna zaštitna sredstva koja su mu povjerena na rukovanje održava u ispravnom stanju
  • Sudjeluje u dnevnim operativnim sastancima, izvještava o poremećajima i daje prijedloge za poboljšanja

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager Balkan Region (m/f/d), Valve Application Industry (Sales-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Area Sales Manager Balkan Region (m/f/d)

Valve Application Industry

Fulltime / remote

BEWERBEN (https://www.isg.com/jobs/applications/applyForJobEntry.jsf;jsessionid=f1a326bec20d28b46aca8797bdf9?inseratnummer=110796&refererId=20)

Our client is a globally operating technology group specializing on tailored engineering valves solutions for the Energy Industry. The success factors for growing business are based on innovation, quality, technical performance and continuous progress.

For the Balkan region (Serbia / Romania / Bulgaria / Greece) we are looking for an Area Sales Manager with excellent communication skills!

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop and grow business within and outside assigned responsibilities
- Manage and develop agents and distributors across the region
- Drive portfolio selling of engineered industrial products and solutions
- Activate dormant industrial plants and drive replacement of competitor products in installed base
- Build strong customer intimacy and identify meaningfull customer problems
- Support Sales growth through regular customer visits (min. 3 - 4 days per week on the road)
- Ensure compliance with company processes and procedures
- Archieve budget targets ans Sales KPIs as agreed annualy
- Drive long-term market development and sustainable growth

- Technical or commercial educational background (University degree preferred)
- Minimum 3 years of experience in a Technical and Sales environment in the field of control valves
- Engineers with experience in flow control and valve applications; even those without previous direct sales experience are welcome
- Candidates with relevant experience from neighbouring countries are also very welcome
- Strong problem solving and negotiation skills
- Willingness to travel (about 80 % in the Balkan region)
- Fluent in English, additional languages like Serbo-Croatian, Romanian, Bulgarian is a plus
- Strong commercial mindset combined with technical understanding

Our client offers:

- International and highly professional business environment
- Strong technical support and global organization
- High level of independence and ownership
- Attractive development opportunities within the group
- Various employee benefits
- Competitive salary package including bonus system

Please submit your application under ref. no. 110.796 preferably via our ISG Career Portal (https://www.isg.com/jobs/applications/applyForJobEntry.jsf;jsessionid=f1a326bec20d28b46aca8797bdf9?inseratnummer=110796&refererId=20)  or via eMail. Empfangsmitarbeiter (m/w/d) für Front Office und Bar

Stellenbeschreibung

Mit deinem Talent bereitest Du unseren Gästen einen wundervollen Aufenthalt. Von der herzlichen Begrüßung bei der Reservierung, über das freundliche Lächeln beim Check-In, bis hin zum Servieren von kühlen Drinks in unserer Bar. Es erwartet dich eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit, dabei immer im Fokus: Die professionelle Betreuung unserer Gäste. Du kümmerst dich um:

- Betreuung unserer Gäste sowohl telefonisch als auch beim Check-In/ Check-Out
- Organisatorische und administrative Aufgaben sowohl im Front- als auch Back-Office-Bereich (bspw. Verwaltung der Nichtanreisen, Beantwortung von E-Mails)
- Prüfung und Bearbeitung der Reservierungen, Überbuchungen und Optionen
- Rechnungslegung inkl. Verwaltung der Kostenübernahmen sowie Kassenführung und -abrechnung
- Betreuung unserer Gäste an der Bar und Zubereitung sowie aktiver Verkauf unseres Motel One Lounge Angebots
- Abteilungsübergreifende Einblicke in neue Tätigkeitsbereiche durch die Zusammenarbeit in unseren multikulturellen Teams

Benefits:

- Bonus-Programm: Je besser die Gäste ihren Aufenthalt bewerten, desto höher fällt der Bonus für das ganze Team aus.
- International Karriere machen: Unsere nationalen und internationalen Hotels oder Neueröffnungen eröffnen zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten.
- Günstig übernachten in ganz Europa: Vorteile sichern! Mit günstigen Personalraten in unseren Hotels in ganz Europa und in New York sowie weitere attraktiven Rabatten.
- Sich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln: Mit einer umfangreichen Einarbeitung, jährlichen Schulungen und Coachings an der One University richtig durchstarten.
- Gemeinsam feiern: Ob Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unser jährliches internationales Fußballturnier – Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam mit dem Team.
- Kostengünstig und nachhaltig zur Arbeit: Es kann zwischen einem Zuschuss zum ÖPNV oder einem kostenlosen Fahrrad gewählt werden.

Qualifikationen

Ob als Hotelprofi oder im Quereinstieg – Du passt zu uns! Denn Persönlichkeit und Gastgeberqualitäten stehen bei uns an erster Stelle! Außerdem zeichnet dich aus:

- Ausbildung im Hotelfach oder Interesse an einem Quereinstieg
- Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung in der Hotellerie/Gastronomie z.B. am Empfang / Front Office oder an der Bar

jobs.title: Barman/Barmaid de 2ª (Barmixer/in, Barkeeper/in)
jobs.description:
Barman/Barmaid de 2ª

Descrição da empresa

You create experiences for our guests. As an employer, we create experiences for you. How? At The Cloud One, every day is unique. Never same-same, always thrillingly different. With us, you have the freedom to be who you are – or who you want to be. Because here, individuality is what matters. With equal – and exciting – opportunities for all. We believe in an inclusive culture that puts people like you at the heart of what we do, because we know that you’re the ones who make the difference. For us, respect and success go hand in hand. We’re locally rooted: connected to the city, its culture and its people. Are you with us?

Descrição do emprego

Estamos à procura de um(a) Barman/Barmaid de 2ª com atitude positiva, espírito de equipa e paixão por hospitalidade para se juntar à nossa equipa. Se gostas de criar experiências memoráveis através de cocktails e bom serviço, esta oportunidade é para ti!

Principais Responsabilidades:

- Preparar e servir bebidas alcoólicas e não alcoólicas com criatividade e atenção ao detalhe.
- Criar cocktails clássicos e de autor, garantindo qualidade e apresentação.
- Proporcionar um atendimento simpático, profissional e personalizado aos clientes.
- Manter o espaço do bar limpo, organizado e em conformidade com as normas de higiene e segurança.
- Trabalhar em equipa com os colegas de F&B para garantir um serviço fluido e eficiente.
- Sugerir bebidas e promover produtos de forma proativa.

Qualificações

Formação e Experiência:

- Experiência mínima de 1 ano como Barman/Barmaid (preferencialmente em hotelaria ou restauração).
- Formação na área de hotelaria, restauração ou mixologia (valorizada).

Competências Técnicas:

- Conhecimento sólido de bebidas, cocktails e técnicas de bar.
- Capacidade de trabalhar com sistemas de POS.
- Conhecimento das normas HACCP.

Competências Pessoais:

- Boa comunicação e simpatia natural.
- Proatividade, dinamismo e atenção ao detalhe.
- Espírito de equipa e flexibilidade para trabalhar por turnos, fins de semana e feriados.
- Fluência em português e inglês (outras línguas são uma mais-valia).

jobs.title: Senior Accountant Manager  (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
jobs.description:
Senior Accountant Manager

Opis firmy

Ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach, które imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast, a wszystko to w atrakcyjnej cenie. Jako założyciel i prekursor koncepcji budget design, z sukcesem rozwijamy się w metropoliach Europy i poza nią.

Opis oferty pracy

- Prowadzenie i nadzór nad księgowością operacyjną hoteli w Polsce zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami oraz wytycznymi Centrali;
- Uzgadnianie rejestru VAT zakupu i sprzedaży;
- Raportowanie wyników finansowych dla hoteli w Gdańsku i Warszawie do Centrali, w tym analiza odchyleń oraz rekomendowanie działań korygujących.
- Ścisła współpraca z działem Controllingu, audytorami i pozostałymi działami hotelowymi w zakresie zagadnień finansowych, w tym obsługi procesów KSeF.
- Przygotowywanie przelewów do płatności, księgowanie wyciągów, rozliczanie kart kredytowych
- Przygotowywanie tygodniowych, miesięcznych i rocznych raportów finansowych zgodnie z wymaganiami działu kontroli finansowej.
- Czynny udział w procesach zamknięcia miesiąca, obejmujący uzgadnianie kont, kontrolę kosztów, inwentaryzację oraz weryfikację danych operacyjnych hoteli.
- Zapewnienie terminowego przygotowania dokumentacji do składania deklaracji podatkowych oraz zgodności z przepisami prawa podatkowego.
- Wsparcie w bieżących analizach finansowych oraz projektach związanych z optymalizacją kosztów i efektywnością operacyjną hoteli.

Kwalifikacje

- Wyższe wykształcenie ekonomiczne;
- Min. 4 lata doświadczenia w dziale kontrolingu, mile widziane w branży hotelarskiej;
- Praktyczna, zaawansowana znajomość pakietu MS Office (w szczególności Excel);
- Znajomość języka angielskiego lub niemieckiego - warunek konieczny;
- Znajomość specyfiki finansów hotelowych (USALI) oraz wskaźników charakterystycznych dla branży hotelarskiej;

- Samodzielność oraz dobra organizacja pracy;
- Odpowiedzialność i terminowość;
- Gotowość do odbywania delegacji służbowych.

jobs.title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
jobs.description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
- President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship
- Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future
- You can find all current benefits here: https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits (https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits)

Have we piqued your interest?

Then apply with your CV and a few clicks via our online form! No cover letter is necessary.

Do you have any questions? Then feel free to send us an email at malte.ruetten@softwareone.com.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer L2 / L3 (Third-Level-Supporter/in)
jobs.description:
WE ARE HIRING: Senior Network Hand & Feet Engineer (L2/L3 Physical & Logical Support) – Austria

Excis is a global leader in IT support that is characterized by innovation and collaboration. We are looking for an experienced Senior Network Hand & Feet Engineerwho will be responsible for the end-to-end physical deployment and logical validation of network infrastructures. This position requires in-depth knowledge of OSI layers 1-3to ensure that physical connectivity seamlessly matches logical configurations. Become part of a supportive and growth-oriented company where your technical expertise makes a real difference.

190+ countries | 6,000+ Engineers | 200+ Enterprise Customers

We promote an open, collaborative and growth-oriented corporate culture in which individual achievements contribute to mutual success. From solving complex technical challenges to supporting global enterprise customers, our people are at the heart of it.

Your tasks

- Perform challenging rack and device installations using Rack Elevation Diagrams (REDs) for Cisco Nexus 9k, Catalyst 9500, and other networking components.
- Ensuring mechanical safety, correct power supply and rack integrity.
- Perform structured copper and fiber cabling including SMF/MMF fibers, SFP/SFP+/QSFP+ modules, and ANSI/TIA 606-B cabling.
- Manage patch panels, cross-connect, and coordinate line extensions with telecom providers.
- Configure and troubleshoot out-of-band (OOB) management and console accesses.
- Support for BIOS-based error analysis and on-site boot monitoring.
- Apply in-depth routing and switching knowledge to OSI layers 1-3, including VLANs, STP, EtherChannel/LACP, and protocol validation (BGP, OSPF).
- Collaborate with NOC and infrastructure teams to resolve business-critical network disruptions.

Requirements

- 6-8 years of work experience in a data center or large enterprise campus environment
- Experience installing Ethernet and fiber cabling on Cisco, Arista, Palo Alto and F5 load balancers
- Hands-on experience with routing and switching as well as Cisco IOS, NX-OS, PAN OS or Arista EOS
- Experience in working with Visual Fault Locators (VFL), Light Meters and Fiber Inspection Scopes
- CCNA-Zertifizierung erforderlich; CCNP Enterprise (ENCORE) von Vorteil
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit geschäftskritischen Incidents in Enterprise-Netzwerken und Rechenzentren
- Bereitschaft zur Vor-Ort-Arbeit von Montag bis Freitag (kein Hybrid- oder Remote-Modell)
- Lokale Sprachkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Wichtige Kompetenzen

- Erweiterte Fehleranalyse auf den OSI-Schichten 1–3
- Präzision bei physischer Installation und Verkabelungsstandards
- Ausgeprägte Dokumentations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
- Selbstständiges Arbeiten vor Ort
- Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden IT-Teams

Warum Excis?

Bei Excis zählt Ihre Arbeit. Sie werden Teil eines dynamischen, praxisorientierten Teams, in dem Ihr technisches Fachwissen direkt zur Kundenzufriedenheit und zum Unternehmenserfolg beiträgt.

Wir bieten Ihnen ein unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld mit vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, kontinuierlichem Lernen und der Zusammenarbeit mit modernsten Technologien. Freuen Sie sich auf eine attraktive Vergütung und die Chance, bei einem globalen IT-Dienstleister mitzuwirken, der Innovation und Exzellenz lebt.

Bereit für den nächsten Karriereschritt? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und werden Sie Teil von Excis – gemeinsam liefern wir erstklassigen IT-Support für Enterprise-Kunden weltweit!

jobs.title: Business Developer (German - speaking) - Hybrid  HE04 (Berufsspezialist/in - Vertrieb)
jobs.description:
Experience the power of a game-changing career  

Want to be part of an innovative and growing team? We’re a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. We help well-known brands — the ones you use every day — improve their businesses with technology and integrated solutions, in over 70 countries.  

If you’re looking to grow and be inspired, as a Business Developer (Hybrid), you will be part of our team of game-changers who are powering the brands of the future in tech.  

Career growth and personal development  

This is a great opportunity to experience the power of what’s next and develop “friends for life” at the same time. We’ll give you all the training, cutting-edge technologies, and the continuing support you’ll need to succeed.  

What you will do in this role  

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.  

As a Business Developer (Hybrid) on our team, you will:  

- **Manage OEM Account Information:** - Find and identify existing OEM accounts through research.
- Build and keep a list of new OEM accounts we might want to work with.
- Gather and update details about current OEM accounts, including their industry, what they use our products for (use cases), past successful projects, platforms they use, and other relevant information.
- **Help Partners Use Our Portal:** - Assist in keeping the Partner OEM portal up-to-date and easy to use.
- Develop ideas to get more partners to use the portal as their main source of information.
- **Find Leads for Sales:** - Look at upcoming trade shows to find potential OEM accounts.
- Make lists of specific accounts to target based on certain criteria.
- Research and find key people who work in product management, R&D, etc. at target accounts.
- Check leads to see if they're a good fit before giving them to our sales team (ISRs) or partner teams to follow up on.
- Use existing HP systems to confirm if accounts are a good match for us.

Your qualifications  

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.  

**Concentrix is a great match if you:**  

-  Are proficient or bilingual in German with advanced English
- Experience in researching and managing databases.
- Strong ability to analyze information and solve problems.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills to work well with others.

Nurse

Stellenbeschreibung:
Job Title: Nurse

International SOS is the world’s leading medical and security services company with over 12,000 employees working in 1,000 locations in 90 countries. International SOS Government Services administers the TRICARE Overseas Program providing high-quality, accessible health care services for U.S. Military service members, family members, retirees, and other eligible beneficiaries overseas.

About the role

- Perhaps you live abroad and would like to return to Poland?
- Do you have a Polish nursing license?
- Looking to apply your experience in a new environment?
- Is it time to move away from the demands of clinical care in a hospital environment?
- Do you speak Polish and English?

We are looking for a Nurse (known internally as a Near Patient Nurse) based in Poznan or within proximity, to support our global patient care program, TRICARE. You will be responsible for providing medical case management for patients, visiting them at healthcare provider sites, writing medical reports and providing medical updates.

This is a fantastic opportunity for nurses to move away from the demands of a clinical environment to an on-site case manager role using their medical expertise.

Key responsibilities

- The nurse would provide comprehensive in-patient clinical case management
- Develop and maintain effective relationships with providers, (medical and administrative) internal and external stakeholders and suppliers to ensure excellent delivery of service
- Regularly visit or contact the care providers (civilian and military treatment facility centers) to obtain updates for medical cases
- Liaise with patients to obtain detailed clinical information including past medical history to allow for accurate on-going case management
- Support the medical collection team in obtaining the discharge summary and medical records from the care provider

About you

- Registered General Nurse or equivalent with minimum 3 years of experience with registration to practice in Poland
- Recognized qualification to minimum diploma level or equivalence in practice demonstrated through portfolio/CV
- A demonstrable commitment to professional development
- Able to communicate Polish and proficiently in English
- Own a car and have a clean license
- Passionate about international healthcare

Benefits

- 15,900 PLN car allowance per annum
- 2,400 PLN home allowance per annum
- Structured career development track, with opportunities for progression and advancement
- Warm, supportive, and open company culture
- An opportunity to thrive in a global environment
- We celebrate diversity on a global scale and encourage every colleague to bring their personal best by creating an environment of inclusion and equal support

At International SOS, we offer a great working environment, thanks to our commitment to flexible working, diversity, and development.  We encourage every person to be their personal best by creating an environment of inclusion, equality and support.

jobs.title: DX Head of Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs, EMEA (f/m/d) (Leiter/in - Qualitätsmanagement)
jobs.description:
Location: MAR EB
Department: SHS DX QT-LS
Mode of Employment: Permanent / Full-time
Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management - PL4 - Position Level 4

Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.
We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?

Then come and join our team as DX Head of Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs, EMEA (f/m/d), to lead the Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs function across the EMEA region, ensuring compliance, product safety, and operational excellence across commercial operations and customer services.

You will drive and execute regional quality and regulatory strategies, translating requirements into practical business actions that enable market access, customer satisfaction, and sustainable growth.

You will serve as the Quality Representative for assigned legal entities and champion a pragmatic, risk-based approach that balances regulatory compliance with business objectives.

This position can be located at the following locations:

- Marburg (Germany)- Milan (Italy)- Madrid (Spain).

Your tasks and responsibilities:
Quality Management & Continuous Improvement

- Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS) to meet regulatory and business requirements.- Ensure effective execution of Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering processes (e.g., audits, training, documentation, CAPA, nonconformance management).- Identify and mitigate quality risks in commercial operations through structured risk management.- Drive process improvements that increase efficiency, product quality, and customer satisfaction.- Leverage digital tools and data insights to enhance quality performance, transparency, and decision-making.- Ensure inspection readiness across all markets in the region, manage external inspections and internal audits.

Regulatory Strategy & Compliance

- Define and execute the regional regulatory strategy that supports business growth objectives, ensuring timely submissions, approvals, and adherence to country-specific requirements.- Ensure full compliance with internal policies and external regulations, with a strong focus on product safety and market access. Translate regulatory requirements into clear business implications and actionable guidance for leadership teams.- Act as key interface to health authorities and external stakeholders, representing the organization with credibility and impact.

Commercial & Customer Quality

- Establish governance framework, ensuring Commercial teams, Customer Services teams and Business Partners operate in accordance with local requirements and corporate quality standards.- Ensure product integrity and compliance across commercial operations and customer services.- Ensure on time and accurate Post Market Surveillance & Reporting- Partner with customer-facing teams to resolve quality issues and improve the end-to-end customer experience.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

- Embed a strong quality culture focused on continuous improvement and customer-centricity.- Build and lead a high-performing and engaged regional Quality & Regulatory team, driving accountability, capability, and ownership.- Collaborate closely with global Quality and cross-functional teams to align standards, share best practices, and ensure consistent execution.- Lead interactions with local authorities to support regulatory compliance, product lifecycle activities and business continuity across the region.

Your qualifications and experience:

- You have a university degree in life sciences, engineering, or related field.- You have many years of experience in Quality and/or Regulatory Affairs within medical device / pharma, including leadership responsibility.- You have very strong experience with QMS, regulatory submissions/approvals, inspections (e.g., FDA/NMPA), and product safety/compliance frameworks.- You have a proven track record in international, matrix organizations and multi-market environments.- You possess demonstrated leadership across multiple markets in the region.- You have deep expertise in Quality & Regulatory frameworks, including QMS, audits, and authority interactions.- You have the ability to translate quality and regulatory requirements into clear business actions and decisions, including effectively managing quality and compliance risks across direct and indirect markets within the region.

Your attributes and skills:

- You have fluent English language skills.- You have a strong analytical, data-driven, and problem-solving mindset.- You excel by your effective stakeholder management and communication in global, cross-functional settings.- You have the proven ability to lead, develop, and drive performance of high-performing teams.- You showcase high ownership, execution focus, and change agility.

Our team :
Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.

Our culture:
Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That’s why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success. Check our Careers Site at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.#myabilityshs
Wish to find out more before applying? Contact us: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com, if you wish to discuss any initial questions with our recruitment team. The contact person handling this job ad is Klaus Kouril.
We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Click here (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/en_US/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) to get started.

To all recruitment agencies:
Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.

Siemens Healthineers Germany was awarded the Great Place to Work® certificate.

jobs.title: Pflegeassistent:in in der Hauskrankenpflege - Spannende Einblicke inkludiert (26/09/WPB)
jobs.description:
1 Pflegeassistent:in in der Hauskrankenpflege - Spannende Einblicke inkludiert (26/09/WPB) Voll- /Teilzeit (mind. 30 Wochenstunden)

Ihr Talent heißt "Spaß an der sozialen Interaktion" - Unser Talent heißt Vielfalt.

Gestalten Sie mit uns eine soziale Zukunft

In der mobilen Hauskrankenpflege erhält das Wort "Berufsalltag" eine neue Bedeutung. Denn bei uns sind spannende Lebensrealitäten durch den Eintritt in die persönliche Lebenswelt der Kund:innen inkludiert!

* Sie führen selbständig die von DGKP übertragenen Aufgaben gemäß GuKG § 83 durch, wie zum Beispiel:
** Körper- und Intimpflege, Hautpflege, Inkontinenzversorgung
** Blutdruck- und Blutzuckermessung, Verabreichung von Insulin sowie der vorbereiteten Medikamente
** Versorgung einfacher Wunden, Verbandswechsel sowie Stomaversorgung
* Sie führen die Mobilisation der Kund:innen bzw. die korrekte Positionierung im Bett durch
* Sie unterstützen beim An- und Auskleiden, beim Essen und sind für eine hygienische Umgebung verantwortlich (z.B. Wechsel der Bettwäsche)
* Sie beobachten sorgfältig den Gesundheitszustand der Kund:innen und sorgen so für die Früherkennung von Veränderungen
* Sie pflegen einen vertrauensvollen Umgang mit An- und Zugehörigen und informieren über weitere Angebote (z.B. Netz pflegende An- und Zugehörige, Tageszentren, Palliativteam)
* Sie dokumentieren die Durchführung und Wirkung der gesundheits- und krankenpflegerischen Maßnahmen bzw. die Bedürfnissituation der Kund:innen im elektronischen Dokumentationssystem

All diese Tätigkeiten führen Sie mit Einfühlsamkeit sowie pflegerischer Expertise durch.

Setzen Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten wirksam ein

jobs.title: Senior Consultant (Mid-Level) - Focus Product Management (m/f/d) / Product Owner
jobs.description:
1 Senior Consultant (Mid-Level) - Focus Product Management (m/f/d) / Product Owner Tasks
As a Senior Consultant focused on product management at Trinsik, you own digital products end-to-end - from blank page to live, growing product. In our venture-building teams, you turn client and user needs into a clear product vision, validate fast, and lead cross-functional teams to ship.

What You'll Do
* Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for new digital products, aligned with client business goals and validated against real user needs
* Take products from scratch - frame the problem, shape the proposition, and validate before scaling; create new propositions, not just improve existing ones
* Lead product discovery with user research, analytics, benchmarking and hypothesis validation; size opportunities quantitatively
* Prioritize the backlog by customer value, business impact and technical feasibility, using clear frameworks
* Lead agile teams across engineering, UX/UI, data and QA, coordinating with marketing, sales and operations for launch
* Define success metrics, track them, and run an evidence-based cycle of experimentation, learning and iteration
* Use generative AI and agents to accelerate definition, validation and prototyping - AI as part of how you work
* Contribute to commercial outcomes - help ship revenue-generating propositions and deliver against targets

Requirements
* Hands-on experience across the full digital product lifecycle - discovery, definition, delivery and measurement
* Exposure to 0-to-1 work: you've helped create and validate new products or features, not only maintained existing roadmaps
* 3-5 years in product management / product ownership for digital products
* Commercially minded - you've worked to clear targets and are keen to own a number
* Data-literate: fluent with product analytics, A/B testing and funnel/CRO optimization; you use data as evidence
* A clear writer - your documents move discussions forward and help teams decide
* High agency and comfort with ambiguity: you set your own priorities and move without waiting for a perfect brief
* Strong stakeholder management with senior stakeholders and clients, written and verbal, in German and English
* A growth mindset: curious, self-driven, and comfortable being challenged

Nice to have
* Experience in venture building, startups, or innovation consulting
* Technical fluency to dialogue with engineering (APIs, web/mobile architectures)
* Product marketing or positioning background
* Solid command of agile methods (Scrum, Kanban) and prioritization frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, ...)

Benefits
The Numbers: €60,000 - €70,000 gross annually (positioned according to your competencies)

Daily Perk: your choice: a public transport subsidy or a tax-free daily lunch allowance.

Permanent discounts with 600+ top brands via our Corporate Benefits platform.

Flexibility & Trust: Flexible hours and home office to balance life while keeping a vibrant team dynamic.

Change of Scenery: Work remotely from anywhere in the EU, up to 20 calendar days/year, or use sabbatical options.

Exciting Playground: Dive into different industries, apps and digital solutions with plenty of creative freedom.

Latest Software: We work with what's current. If you know something newer and better, let's test it.

International Team: An experienced crew in Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.

Flat Hierarchies: Your input finds open ears - from designs to business ideas or party plans.

Feedback Culture: open, and direct.

Cool Workplace: Collaboration happens right in the middle of Vienna.

Application process
We run a 3-stage process to understand who you are - and help you understand us. We position the role based on competencies, not titles.

As a Business Development Manager - Partnerships & Growth at Trinsik, you drive partner acquisition for a global leading digital loyalty platform. Your core mission is targeting, reaching out to, and securing high-value brands to bring valuable offers into our loyalty ecosystem.

You manage the outreach pipeline end-to-end - from initial contact to signed partnership - and are measured on conversion. Our job is to build groundbreaking rewards platforms. Your job is to bring top-tier brand partners on board.

What You'll Do
º Own B2B partner and customer acquisition end-to-end for client projects - from target identification to closed deal

º Understand the value proposition of new or existing products fast, and translate it into sharp, conversion-focused outreach

º Build and manage the pipeline: prospecting, outreach sequencing, follow-up, qualification and closing

º Track, report and optimize the funnel - response rates, conversion, pipeline health - and react to the data

º Represent our clients' ventures and brands credibly to partners and decision-makers, often at senior level

º Test, learn and iterate on messaging, channels and targeting to lift conversion

Requirements
º A proven track record in (B2B) outreach, business development, sales or partnerships - you've built pipeline and closed deals

º The ability to understand a new offering fast and articulate its value convincingly

º A sales-, conversion- and success-driven mindset: you measure yourself on outcomes, not activity

º End-to-end ownership: comfortable running the full acquisition process independently, with structure and discipline

º Excellent communication and negotiation skills, written and verbal, in German and English

º Confident with CRM / pipeline tools and a data-informed approach to tracking and optimization

º A growth mindset: curious, self-driven, and comfortable being challenged

Nice to have
º Experience in high-profile brand acquisition or strategic partnerships

º Background in venture building, startups, or agency/consulting environments

º Familiarity with AI tools for outreach, research and pipeline automation

Benefits
The Numbers: €50,000 - €60,000 gross annually (positioned according to your competencies)

Daily Perk: your choice: a public transport subsidy or a tax-free daily lunch allowance.

Permanent discounts with 600+ top brands via our Corporate Benefits platform.

Flexibility & Trust: Flexible working hours and home office to balance your life, while keeping a vibrant team dynamic in our offices.

Change of Scenery: Work remotely from anywhere within the EU (up to 20 calendar days/year) or take advantage of our sabbatical options.

Latest Software: We work with what's current. If you know something newer and better, let's test it.

International Team: A well-established, experienced crew located in Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.

Flat Hierarchies: Your input finds open ears-whether it's about designs, business ideas, or party plans.

Feedback Culture: open, and direct.

Cool Workplace: Collaboration happens right in the middle of Vienna.

In a nutshell
Position: Full Time

Entry Level: Mid-Level

Location: Vienna

Application process
We run a 3-stage process to get a clear picture of who you are - and to give you a clear picture of us. We position the role based on competencies, not titles.

1st Stage
Chemistry Check & Initial Technical Exchange: 30 min, virtual, with Maria (Head of People)

2nd Stage
Technical Skills: 60min in person, with two of our colleagues

3rd Stage
30 min virtual with Manuel (Partner)

jobs.description:
1 Expert, Science and Technology (F/M/D) Job ID: REQ-10085657

As an Expert in the Method Development Team in Process Analytical Sciences (PAS), you will be responsible for physicochemical method development, optimization, and robustness testing in late-phase pharmaceutical drug development. Using state-of-the-art technologies and scientific expertise, you will support Drug Substance (DS) and Drug Product (DP) process development within a multidisciplinary project team. We are seeking an experienced scientist with strong analytical expertise, proficiency in data and digital tools, and comprehensive knowledge of DS and DP process development.

The role combines experimental laboratory work with technical documentation. The ideal candidate should therefore be comfortable working both in and outside the laboratory.

This position is limited to an 18-month fixed term.

Standort: Österreich / Schaftenau

This role is based in Schaftenau, Austria. Novartis cannot offer relocation support; please apply only if the location is accessible to you.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities

· Plan, organize, perform, and document physicochemical method development, including HPLC and CE, in compliance with internal quality and HSE standards.
· Use chromatographic, statistical, and other software tools to increase efficiency.
· Support the implementation, handover, and transfer of analytical methods
· Collaborate with PAS laboratories, Analytical Experts, and cross-functional teams to ensure effective analytical workflows.
· Design and execute physicochemical analytical approaches for DS, DP, and process intermediates in accordance with Quality by Design principles.
· Interpret analytical results and apply data and digital solutions to improve efficiency.
· Author and review scientific reports, support regulatory submissions
· Manage multiple priorities, communicate challenges proactively, and resolve complex issues.
· Promote knowledge sharing, present results internally, and contribute to publications, presentations, and patents.
· Evaluate new analytical technologies, develop innovative methods using DoE principles, and ensure alignment with scientific standards.

What You Will Bring to the Role

· University degree in pharmaceutical technology, biotechnology, biochemistry, chemistry, chemical engineering, or another relevant natural science discipline.
· At least 2 years of experience with an MSc or 1 year with a PhD in the (bio)pharmaceutical industry.
· Knowledge of Analytical Development.
· Expertise in biologics DS and DP process development using QbD principles.
· Excellent collaboration skills, including communication, teamwork, and problem-solving.
· Proficiency in written and spoken English; German is beneficial.
· Strong proficiency in digital technologies.

Rewards

In addition to a market-competitive base salary, we offer an attractive incentive program, a modern company pension scheme, childcare facilities, learning and development opportunities, and worldwide career opportunities within the Novartis group.

              Kas ir Atbalsta personas pakalpojums lēmumu pieņemšanā?

Atbalsta personas pakalpojums lēmumu pieņemšanā ir personai ar garīga rakstura traucējumiem sniegts atbalsts lēmumu pieņemšanā, lai palīdzētu viņai vienlīdzīgi ar citiem sabiedrības locekļiem īstenot savu tiesībspēju un rīcībspēju. Atbalsts lēmumu pieņemšanā ļauj personai paust savu gribu, izvēli, plānot un pašai pieņemt lēmumus par savu dzīvi, veselības un sociālo aprūpi, finansēm un īpašumiem, kā arī palīdz personai paplašināt savu dabisko atbalsta loku, palīdz pilnveidot spējas pārstāvēt sevi un aizsargāt savas tiesības un intereses. Pakalpojuma ietvaros atbalsts tiek nodrošināts 6 dzīves jomās: tiesību un interešu aizstāvības jomā, finanšu jomā, ikdienas dzīves jomā, veselības aprūpes jomā, sociālā aprūpes jomā un atbalsta loka veidošanā.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer – Aerospace & Optical Communications
jobs.description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.description:

Warehance is looking for a Customer Success & Support Specialist who is detail-oriented, technically capable, curious, and great with people.

Warehance is a warehouse management system that helps businesses manage orders, inventory, shipping, and fulfillment, making e-commerce and retail distribution faster and more efficient.

This is a problem-solving role. Youâll work directly with customers to understand what theyâre trying to accomplish, investigate issues, answer technical and operational questions, and communicate solutions clearly.

What Youâll Do

What Weâre Looking For

You donât need to know everything on day one. You do need to be willing to learn, care about finding the right answer, and communicate it well.

    En nous rejoignant à Carquefou, à proximité de Nantes, vous intégrez un site dynamique regroupant nos activités de services numériques permettant d'opérer les systèmes d'informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée.

    De formation Bac +5 en informatique ou développement logiciel (école d'ingénieur, Master ou équivalent), vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans le domaine du DevOps.

    Vous maîtrisez les outils de Build & Release (Git, Maven, Gradle, Jenkins, Nexus, SonarQube) et êtes à l'aise avec les principaux cloud providers (Google Cloud, AWS et Azure), aussi bien sur les instances que sur les services managés.

    Des connaissances en Ansible et Kubernetes seraient un plus.

    Vous avez le sens de l'engagement ?
    Vous êtes force de proposition ?

    Au sein du centre de compétences de Nantes, vous intervenez sur des projets innovants et concevez les automatismes du système d'information : intégration, tests automatisés et déploiement continu.

    Vous êtes l'interface privilégiée entre les équipes de développement et les équipes d'exploitation pour les sujets liés à l'installation, la supervision, la sauvegarde et l'administration technique.

About SunnyData
At SunnyData, a leading DataBricks technology partner, our mission is to empower customers with scalable architectures, robust data engineering pipelines, seamless data consumption layers, and advanced ML and AI applications. As a QA Engineer with a strong focus on Data, you will understand requirements and translate them into effective test cases, execute and automate those tests, and track testing progress and defects.

Â 

The Impact Youâll Have

  • Understand requirements and translate them into test plans and test cases, ensuring requirements traceability.

  • Document, track, and validate the resolution of software defects in collaboration with Engineering.
