jobs.title: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English
·         Be an EU citizen
 
Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
·         Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
·         Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
·         Start date: as soon as possible
·         Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
·         Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

jobs.title: Allround-håndværker søges til fast ansættelse/All-round tradesperson wanted for full-time position
jobs.description:
Dansk:

Vi søger en erfaren og ansvarsbevidst allround-håndværker, som har primært erfaring og gode faglige kompetencer inden for tømrer- og malerfaget.

Arbejdsopgaverne vil blandt andet omfatte tømrerarbejde og mindre renoveringsopgaver, opbygning og afretning af undergulve, lægning af klikgulve, lamelgulve og massive trægulve samt montering af lister, paneler, aflslibning af trægulve og behandling af trægulve. Derudover vil arbejdet bestå af spartling, opsætning af filt og maling af vægge, lofter og træværk.

Der kan også forekomme reparationer, vedligeholdelse og forskellige mindre håndværksopgaver, som kan berøre eller trække på andre håndværksfag.

Vi leder efter en fagligt dygtig og alsidig person med relevant brancheerfaring. Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar for dine opgaver og levere et pænt resultat med fokus på kvalitet og detaljer.

Du skal kunne kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk. Kørekort er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder fast fuldtidsansættelse med ordnede forhold, løn efter kvalifikationer og varierede opgaver i Storkøbenhavn og Nordsjælland. Du bliver en del af en virksomhed med et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde, ansvarlighed og høj faglig kvalitet vægtes højt.

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt mandag til fredag kl. 7.00–15.00. Opstart hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

Hvis stillingen lyder som noget for dig, bedes du sende en kort ansøgning og dit CV til info@gp-byggeservice.dk.

English:

We are looking for an experienced and responsible all-round tradesperson with strong practical skills and experience, primarily within carpentry and painting.

The work will include carpentry and minor renovation projects, building and levelling subfloors, installing click flooring, engineered flooring and solid wooden floors, as well as fitting trims, skirting boards, floor sanding and floor coating. The position will also involve filling, installing wall lining and painting walls, ceilings and woodwork.

There may also be various repair and maintenance tasks, as well as smaller assignments involving other building trades.

We are looking for a skilled and versatile professional with relevant industry experience. You must be able to work independently, take responsibility for your assignments and deliver high-quality results with attention to detail.

You must be able to communicate in Danish or English. A valid driver’s licence is an advantage but not a requirement.

We offer permanent full-time employment with proper working conditions, salary based on qualifications and varied projects across Greater Copenhagen and North Zealand. You will join a company with a positive working environment where teamwork, responsibility and professional quality are highly valued.

Working hours are generally Monday to Friday from 7:00 to 15:00. The position is available for an immediate start or by agreement.

If this position sounds suitable for you, please send a short application and your CV to info@gp-byggeservice.dk.

jobs.title: Senior Service Engineer, High Voltage; DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for renewable energy and a sharp eye for technical details? Are you excited about managing projects from start to finish but also want to use your technical skillset and knowhow hands-on offshore? If so, we want to hear from you!

Your position 

As our new Senior Service Engineer in the Renewable division, you will be a valuable member of the Medium and High Voltage Service team, whose mission is to execute medium- and high-voltage service projects across disciplines for offshore assets, e.g. OSS, rigs, and WTGs. You will have the chance to drive all aspects of the project process, from initial client inquiries to final execution. Moreover, this role provides an exciting opportunity for you to make a lasting impact on the projects you work on and advance your professional development.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be our Global HQ in Esbjerg, and you should live within daily driving distance of Esbjerg. The position is full-time, and up to 90 travel days per year should be expected.
“You will be part of a team of fantastic and competent colleagues who prioritise teamwork and a ‘winning as a team’ mentality. Our team values a flexible work atmosphere with an emphasis on balancing work and personal life, as well as opportunities for professional growth. In this role, you will have great opportunities to bring your own ideas to the table and play a key role in shaping our projects and services.”                                                              – Christian Poulsen, Head of MV & HV Service

Your tasks & responsibilities 

As a Senior Service Engineer, you will be responsible for managing and executing MV & HV Service projects from a technical perspective in collaboration with cross-functional teams, external partners, and customers. Moreover, you will apply your expertise hands-on by using your specialist knowledge to execute the service. You will be responsible from the initiation and tendering of the project through to delivering a solution and finally executing it offshore. This will involve collaborating with various teams across the organisation and externally.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • You will have end-to-end technical responsibility for specific projects in the MV & HV Service team, from tendering, clarification, and planning to execution.
  • Provide technical assistance and calculations to support projects across the organisation.
  • Perform hands-on offshore special technical testing and troubleshooting.
  • Coordinate and plan work packages for execution, both on- and offshore.

Your profile & qualifications

As a person, you enjoy having a lot of responsibility and thrive in an environment where you communicate daily with many stakeholders. You are driven by completing tasks to the best of your ability and remain in control, even in fast-paced situations. You have a safety-focused mindset and never compromise when it comes to safety on the job. Additionally, you are service-minded and greatly enjoy collaborating with your colleagues.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • An engineering degree or similar qualification within electrical systems.
  • Broad know-how of MV and HV systems and technologies from the offshore wind industry.
  • In-depth knowledge of electrical systems.
  • A proven track record of servicing protection systems for both low voltage and high voltage.
  • Broad knowledge of electrical systems: high, medium, and low voltage.
  • Desire and willingness to travel and perform hands-on onsite work.
  • Fluency in English, written and verbal.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 
So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 

Change. With us. 

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Christian Poulsen, Head of MV & HV Service at +45 2294 4199.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Liikunnanohjaaja-uinninvalvoja (määräaikainen)
jobs.description:
Tarjoamme:

-Monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen työn, jossa pääset ohjaamaan vesiliikunta-, kuntosali- ja sisäliikuntaryhmiä, pääasiassa työikäisten ja senioreiden parissa.
-Vastuullisen tehtävän, joka sisältää uimahallin valvontaa ja asiakaspalvelua.
-Kattavan perehdytyksen, kannustavan työyhteisön ja esihenkilön tuen - meillä et jää yksin!
-Monipuoliset henkilöstöedut, kuten liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun 200 e/vuosi (ePassi), maksuttoman uinnin Kirkkonummen uimahallissa sekä lakisääteistä tasoa paremmat työterveyshuollon palvelut.
-Viikoittaisesta työajasta on käytettävissä 1-2 tuntia työtehtävien kannalta oleellisen fyysisen kunnon ylläpitoon ja kehittämiseen.

Olet etsimämme henkilö, jos:

-Sinulla on kokemusta liikunnanohjauksesta eri kohderyhmille.
-Osaat työskennellä itsenäisesti, mutta arvostat myös tiimityötä ja muiden työyhteisön jäsenten ammattitaitoa.
-Sopeudut helposti muuttuviin tilanteisiin ja olet valmis tukemaan tiimiäsi sijaistamalla tarvittaessa eri liikuntaryhmissä.

Pätevyysvaatimukset:

-Tehtävään soveltuva liikunta-alan tutkinto.
-Uinninvalvojan testiuinnin hyväksytty suorittaminen. Kirkkonummen uimahallin ison altaan syvin kohta on neljä metriä. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden testiuinnin harjoitteluun etukäteen.
-Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä hyväksyttävä rikosrekisteriote (laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2002).

Eduksi katsomme:

-Molempien kotimaisten kielten hyvän hallinnan.
-Aiempi kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä.

Työaika ja palkkaus:

-Yleistyöaika 38 tuntia ja 15 minuuttia viikossa, sisältäen aamu-, ilta- ja viikonlopputyötä.
-Tasopalkka 2 677,42 euroa kuukaudessa (KVTES).
-Tehtävää täytettäessä koeaika on puolet määräaikaisuuden kestosta.

Hakemukset toimitetaan Kirkkonummen kunnan nuoriso- ja liikuntapalveluihin torstaihin 17.9.2026 klo 12:00 mennessä sähköisesti osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi (työavain KIR-03-294-26).

Testiuinteja ja haastatteluja voidaan käydä jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän mahdollisuuksien mukaan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Toma søger Servicemedarbejder til kunde i Aalborg Øst
jobs.description:
Er du serviceminded, fleksibel og god til at arbejde selvstændigt? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Vi søger en servicemedarbejder til en alsidig stilling hos en af vores kunder i Aalborg Øst, hvor du får en kombination af faste rengøringsopgaver og forskellige service- og ad hoc-opgaver på tværs af kundens bygninger.

Om jobbet

Du arbejder 5 timer dagligt, mandag til fredag, kl. 06.00–11.00, svarende til 25 timer om ugen.

Din arbejdsdag består af:

  • 3 timers fast rengøring i et område, som du får ansvaret for

  • 2 timer til service- og ad hoc-opgaver på tværs af kundens bygninger

Ad hoc-opgaverne kan blandt andet være ekstra rengøringsopgaver, udbedring af mangler og andre praktiske opgaver, der opstår i løbet af dagen.

Du skal derfor trives med en arbejdsdag, hvor nogle opgaver er faste, mens andre opstår løbende og kræver, at du er fleksibel og kan omstille dig.

Du får stillet en mobiltelefon til rådighed, så du kan modtage de løbende opgaver.

Vi søger dig, der

  • Er fleksibel og trives med forskellige typer opgaver

  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • tager ansvar for de opgaver, du får tildelt

  • har øje for kvalitet og den gode service

Erfaring med rengøring eller facility service er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og tager ansvar for dit arbejde.

Vi tilbyder

En alsidig arbejdsdag med en god kombination af faste opgaver og variation. Du får frihed under ansvar og bliver en vigtig del af den daglige service hos vores kunde.

  • Grundig oplæring

  • Gode og ordnede arbejdsforhold

  • Løn i henhold til overenskomst

  • Sundheds- og pensionsordning

Arbejdstid: Mandag–fredag kl. 06.00–11.00
Ugentligt timetal: 25 timer
Arbejdssted: Tomas kunde i Aalborg Øst
Tiltrædelse: 1. oktober 2026

Har du spørgsmål?
Kontakt Serviceleder Nina Bindner på mail: nina.breitner@toma-as.dk

Send din ansøgning med billede og CV hurtigst muligt, da vi løbende inviterer kvalificerede ansøgere til samtale.

Ansøgning sendes til: job@toma-as.dk

Toma er landsdækkende i Danmark, og vi har 750 dygtige medarbejdere.

Vi stiller krav til kvalitet, bæredygtighed, uddannelse, og arbejder seriøst med miljø og arbejdsmiljø.

Vi er medlem af Servicenormen, er ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001 certificeret, samt har certifikat på Svanemærket rengøring.

Vi investerer i vores medarbejdere både socialt og udviklingsmæssigt, og tilbyder spændende karrieremuligheder for de rette kandidater.

Vi lever for vores serviceløfte om at skabe gode service-oplevelser og give folk en bedre arbejdsdag.

jobs.title: Määräaikainen kunnaninsinööri 31.3.2027 asti
jobs.description:
Oletko maalaisjärjellä ja työtä pelkäämättömällä asenteella varustettu teknisen puolen asiantuntija? Meillä on avoinna määräaikainen kunnaninsinöörin virka, jossa pääset hyödyntämään laaja-alaisesti osaamistasi kiinteistöpuolen tehtävissä. Keskeisin tehtäväsi on osallistua päivittäiseen kiinteistöjen kunnossapitotyöhön siistijöiden ja kiinteistönhoitajien esihenkilönä ja huolehtia ennakoivasta kunnossapidosta. Kiinteistömassan hallinta ja siihen liittyvän kiinteistöstrategian laadinta sekä liikunta-alueiden ja kunnan tiealueiden kunnossapito tulee olemaan sinun vastuullasi.

Kunnaninsinööri on ennen kaikkea kuntalaisten käytettävissä ja siksi toivomme sinulta myös hyviä asiakaspalvelutaitoja.
Kunnalla on käytössä Avux-kiinteistönhallintaohjelmisto.

Toimeen valittavalta vaaditaan:
- Tehtävään soveltuvaa insinöörin tutkintoa (esim. talotekniikka tai rakennustekniikka) sekä kokemusta kiinteistöhoidon tehtävistä.
- kunnallisalan tuntemusta
- kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksen tekoon
- hyviä yhteistyötaitoja
- hankintaosaamista ja kokemusta kilpailuttamisesta
- halua ja kykyä toimia kentällä käytännön hommissa ja tahtoa tarvittaessa vaikka hypätä moottorikelkan selkään latuja ajamaan.

Arvostamme myös näitä taitoja:
- kykyä oppia ja motivaatiota työskennellä kuntatoimintaympäristössä
- valmiutta kehittää uusia toimintamalleja sekä käyttää digitaalisia työkaluja
- kestävän kehityksen ja elinkaarimallin osaamista

Tarjoamme sinulle
- vastuullisen ja itsenäisen roolin organisaatiossa
- julkisen sektorin hyvät lomaedut ja selkeät työehdot (TS)
- TS:n mukaisen palkan
- arvoiltaan monikulttuurisen ja eteenpäin pyrkivän kuntatyönantajan

Saamen kielen taito katsotaan erityiseksi ansioksi.

Hakemukset pyydetään lähettämään 27.9.2026 klo 16.00 mennessä sähköisesti Kuntarekry-järjestelmän kautta www.kuntarekry.fi.

Leatgo don teknihkalaš beali áššedovdi, gii jurddašat áššiin geavatlaččat itge bala bargamis? Mis lea rabas mearreáigásaš gielddainšenevrra virgi, mas don beasat geavahit iežat máhtu viidát giddodatbeali doaimmain. Dehálamos bargun lea oassálastit giddodagaid beaivválaš ortnegisdoallanbargui čorgejeaddjiid ja giddodatdikšuid hoavdan ja fuolahit ovddalgihtii ortnegisdoallamis. Giddodagaid hálddašeapmi ja dasa gullevaš giddodatstrategiija gárvvisteapmi sihke lihkadanbáikkiid ja gieldda geaidnoviidodagaid ortnegisdoallan bohtet leat du ovddasvástádusa vuolde.

Gielddainšenevra lea eandalit gielddaolbmuid geavaheamis ja danin mii vuordit dus maiddái buori áššehasbálvalusmáhtu.
Gielddas lea geavahusas Avux-giddodathálddašanprográmma.

- gieldasuorggi dovdamuš
- máhttu iehčanas barggildeapmái ja mearrádusdahkamii
- buorit ovttasbargodáiddut
- háhkanmáhttu ja hárjánupmi gilvalahttimis
- dáhttu ja máhttu doaibmat giettis geavatlaš doaimmain ja dáhttu dárbbu mielde vaikko njuiket mohtorgielkká ala láhtuid vuodjit.

Mii atnit árvvus maiddái dáid dáidduid:
- čehppodaga oahppat ja movtta bargat gieldadoaibmabirrasis
- návccaid ovddidit ođđa doaibmamálliid sihke geavahit digitála bargoneavvuid
- suvdilis ovdáneami ja eallingeardemálle máhtu

Mii fállat dutnje
- vásttolaš ja iehčanas rolla organisašuvnnas
- almmolaš sektora buriid luopmoovdduid ja čielga bargoeavttuid (gieldasuorggi teknihkalaš bargoveaga virge- ja bargoeaktosoahpamuš)
- bálkká gieldasuorggi teknihkalaš bargoveaga virge- ja bargoeaktosoahpamuša mielde
- gieldabargoaddi, man árvvut leat máŋggakultuvrralašvuohta ja figgamuš beassat ovddosguvlui

Sámegiela máhttu gehččojuvvo erenomáš ánsun.

jobs.title: Computer Numerical Control Operatives
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Our client, Fox Bros. Engineering Limited, based in Gorey, Co. Wexford, is currently seeking Computer Numerical Control Operatives for immediate start for their facility in Gorey, Co. Wexford. Qualifications: A minimum of 3 years’ CNC operation experience is required. There are no minimum academic requirements. A CNC or related certification is a plus but is not required. Key Responsibilities - Set up, maintain, and control CNC machines to execute production orders accurately and efficiently. - Program CNC machines, ensuring required parameters, tolerances, and measurements are met while maintaining quality and safety standards. - Monitor automated machines to ensure proper operation and optimal performance. - Perform test runs to verify machine settings and ensure product quality. - Remove processed workpieces and inspect finished products for accuracy and defects. - Remove and report inadequate or non-conforming workpieces. - Set up machine controllers and supply machines with appropriate tools and materials. - Perform routine machine maintenance and troubleshooting as required. - Ensure equipment availability and readiness for scheduled production. - Follow all safety guidelines and company procedures. Key Requirements - Ability to competently perform all job duties listed above - Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience as a CNC Operator in a manufacturing or production environment. - Proven experience reading and interpreting standard blueprints and technical drawings. - Demonstrated experience in machine setup, maintenance, and programming. - Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, quality standards, and Statistical Process Control (SPC). - Ability to consult and interpret technical documentation, blueprints, and drawings. - Experience programming CNC controllers and using automatic programming functions. - Proficiency in CAM software. - Ability to troubleshoot machining issues efficiently. - Competence in operating precision measuring equipment (e.g., calipers, micrometers, gauges). - Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining quality standards. - Good problem-solving and analytical skills. - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Annual remuneration: €36,605.00; Pay rate €18.05 per hour Work Location: Fox Bros. Engineering Limited, Ballycanew, Gorey. Co. Wexford Number of hours work each week: 39 If you're interested in this role, please apply with an up-to-date CV to info@crewitresourcing.com or call 019020688 to enquire for more details.

jobs.title: Machine Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Our Team as a Machine Automation Engineer!

We're currently seeking a talented Machine Automation Engineer to join our Semiconductor ALD Business Unit. In this role, you'll design the software and automation that brings our atomic layer deposition (ALD) equipment to life - building control solutions for fully automated system clusters used in semiconductor manufacturing around the world.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

As a Machine Automation Engineer you will design, develop and maintain the automation software for Beneq ALD equipment. Alongside project deliveries, your work will drive the continuous development and maintenance of our existing automation systems — from the first line of code in our development laboratory all the way to commissioning at customer sites.

Key Responsibilities include:

* Design, develop and maintain software solutions that meet high safety and reliability standards for controlling machines in a fully automated system cluster

* Design and improve HMI applications and user interfaces for machine operations

* Conduct and participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to best practices

* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyse requirements, translating them into technical specifications

* Create and maintain technical documentation for the software systems

* Conduct testing activities during tool delivery, including simulation testing in our development laboratory

* Commission equipment at customer premises

* Support our Software Application Support Engineers with questions coming from the field



What We're Looking For:

To excel in this role, you should have:

* A strong engineering background with 4+ years of experience, typically a BSc or MSc degree in automation engineering.

* Experience with automation instrumentation and electrical drawings.

* Experience with structured text coding (IEC 61131-3) in a PLC environment.

* Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases (Postgres, MSSQL).

* Familiarity with UML and other modelling methods.

* Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD tools.

* Knowledge of HTML5 and JS-based HMI design tools.

* A solid understanding of software development methodologies and software quality assurance principles.

* Solid problem-solving skills, a self-guided and customer-oriented mindset, and a can-do attitude.

* A technical mindset with great attention to detail, a structured way of working and strong documentation skills.

* Excellent communication skills in English.

* Willingness to travel approximately 50–60 days per year to customer premises worldwide.

Bonus Skills (Not Required but Nice to Have):

* Knowledge of Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 or Codesys environments.

* Experience with C#.

* Experience from the semiconductor industry or other high-tech equipment manufacturing.

What We Offer:

At Beneq, you'll have the unique chance to work in a global high-tech environment that blends the dynamic energy of a fast-growing company with the stability and resources of a larger enterprise. You'll work on our own product development, with global operations and services in Japan, Taiwan, China, the USA and the EU - so your work reaches customers on nearly every continent.

We value diversity and support personal and professional development, offering a collaborative workspace where you can thrive alongside colleagues from over 20 different nationalities. The role is mainly office-based in Espoo, with remote work possible up to 40% when work activities allow it, and occasional clean room activities to support testing or to upgrade and troubleshoot our equipment.

Working at Beneq means being part of a supportive team that values curiosity and innovation. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while advancing your career in a truly global industry.

Interested? Here's What to Do Next:

If you're excited about joining our team in Espoo, we'd love to hear from you! Please submit your application, including your CV and cover letter, via the apply link to our recruitment portal by 30 September. We encourage you to apply early - we may start the interview process during the application period.

For more information about the role, please contact Joonas Taipalus, Lead Automation Software Development Engineer, at +358 50 491 6424. He will be available for inquiries during the application period on Mondays and Wednesdays between 12.30 - 15.00 EET. Please note that applications are only accepted through our recruitment portal.




Beneq is the home of atomic layer deposition. Our mission is to be dedicated to the success of the More-than-Moore device makers by delivering best in class, innovative, and flexible ALD equipment and service solutions. In 1984, we established the worlds first industrial production using ALD. Today, we lead the market with products for semiconductor device fabrication, R&D, and varied ALD solutions. We operate globally and employ 170+ people on three continents. We are a unique employer that combines the hands-on, dynamic mindset of a fast-growth startup with the solid funding and resources of a larger enterprise. Beneqs team of engineers and experts are committed to delivering world class ALD solutions and enabling technology mega trends through advanced solutions. Beneq is headquartered in Finland with legal entities in the USA and Japan.

jobs.title: Directeur(trice) d'Hôtel 5* (H/F)
jobs.description:
Vous souhaitez relever un nouveau défi dans un établissement haut de gamme ?
Dans le cadre de son développement, notre client reconnu pour la qualité de son exigence et matière de service recherche son/sa futur(e) Directeur(trice) d'Hôtel pour son établissement situé au cœur du Piémont des Vosges, dans le Bas-Rhin (67).
Véritable ambassadeur(rice) de l'établissement, vous serez responsable de la gestion globale de l'hôtel, en collaboration étroite avec la direction, et veillerez à garantir une expérience client d'exception, tout en accompagnant les équipes dans une dynamique de performance, d'engagement et d'excellence opérationnelle.
Vos missions :
Management et encadrement des équipes
- Encadrer, fédérer et accompagner les équipes opérationnelles et supports (hébergement, réception, restauration, technique, administratif).
- Développer une culture d'excellence, de service et de cohésion.
- Assurer le recrutement, l'intégration, la formation et l'évolution des talents.
- Mettre en place un management de proximité favorisant la performance et l'implication des collaborateurs.
Pilotage et gestion de l'établissement
- Assurer la gestion globale de l'hôtel (exploitation, budget, rentabilité et qualité de service).
- Suivre et analyser les indicateurs de performance (chiffre d'affaires, taux d'occupation, coûts, satisfaction client).
- Élaborer les budgets annuels et définir les plans d'actions nécessaires.
- Garantir le respect des standards 5 étoiles ainsi que des procédures internes.
Gestion de l'information et reporting
- Structurer et analyser les données d'exploitation afin d'accompagner la prise de décision.
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la direction générale ou du groupe.
- Déployer des outils de suivi et de pilotage fiables et performants.
Expérience client et qualité de service
- Garantir une expérience client personnalisée et irréprochable à chaque étape du séjour.
- Superviser la qualité des prestations et le respect des standards d'un établissement haut de gamme.
Développement et performance de l'établissement
- Définir et déployer la stratégie de développement commercial et opérationnel .
- Optimiser la rentabilité tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence.
- Identifier les axes d'amélioration et piloter les projets d'évolution.
Profil recherché:
- Formation supérieure en hôtellerie, tourisme ou management hôtelier.
- Expérience confirmée de 7 à 10 ans en direction ou exploitation hôtelière haut de gamme, au sein d'un établissement 4 ou 5 étoiles.
- Parcours professionnel démontrant une capacité à s'inscrire durablement dans les fonctions occupées et à accompagner le développement d'un établissement sur le moyen/long terme.
- Solide expérience en management d'équipes et gestion opérationnelle, avec un leadership fédérateur, une forte présence sur le terrain et une réelle capacité d'adaptation.
- Forte culture du résultat et du pilotage économique : maîtrise du budget, reporting et des principaux indicateurs de performance hôtelière (RevPAR, taux d'occupation, chiffre d'affaires, coûts d'exploitation et rentabilité).
- Excellente maîtrise des code de l'hôtellerie haut de gamme, avec un sens aigu du détail, de la qualité de service et de l'expérience client.
- Anglais courant indispensable, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, afin d'évoluer auprès d'une clientèle internationale.

jobs.description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Since opening in 1962, The Ocean Club, A Four Seasons Resort, Bahamas has been a playground for celebrities and discerning travellers set along an 8-kilometre (5-mile) stretch of natural, white-sand beach on Paradise Island. Connect with Bahamian beauty in an enclave of remarkable seclusion, where intimate low-rise buildings are immersed in 14 hectares (35 acres) of Versailles-inspired lawns and gardens. Wake up to breakfast on your private balcony, then indulge in a restorative treatment in one of our Balinese-style spa villas or head out for a round of golf at Ocean Club Golf Course. However you spend your day, be sure to join us back at Martini Bar and Lounge for a nightcap.

The Ocean Club offers a rich roster of activities including water sports such as snorkeling, sailing and wind-surfing along with land-based activities including world-class golf and tennis plus a relaxing spa.

jobs.title: Irrigation Technician
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

Responsible for the operation and maintenance of all irrigation and drainage systems on the island and grounds. This role is based on MSC's island reserve, Ocean Cay. Staff accommodation provided.

Your Impact

  • Watering lawns, palms and flower beds and other areas as needed or scheduled.
  • Monitors daily water usage and informs Maintenance Engineer of any needed adjustments to the irrigation water usage and computer settings.
  • Operates irrigation heads in dry areas needing additional water.
  • Designs, implements and maintains mechanical and electrical components of island irrigation system.
  • Repairs equipment associated with irrigation (i.e., irrigation pipes and irrigation heads valves etc.).
  • Performs preventive maintenance on all equipment associated with irrigation.
  • Maintains complete records on all equipment maintenance associated with irrigation.
  • Controls expenses associated with irrigation equipment and activities.
  • Maintains inventory and ordering of parts needed for irrigation equipment.
  • Performs all record-keeping relative to irrigation system including weather and rainfall data; assists in recording fertilizer and pesticide applications.
  • Performs daily tank and pump water usage reports.
  • Helps apply or water-in pesticides and fertilizers under the supervision of the Pesticides Application Specialist through fumigation.
  • Operates dump trucks and other light equipment in hauling materials and removing debris.
  • May occasionally supervise crews for special projects.
  • Performs other appropriate tasks assigned by the Supervisor.

Your Journey so far

  • Fluent English, verbal and written. Knowledge of any other core language is an advantage.
  • High School diploma and GED required.
  • Some experience working for a landscaping service or golf course grounds crew, specifically working with the irrigation system.
  • Proven ability to work within a harmonious and diverse culture team environment.
  • Working knowledge of basic electricity and hydraulics related to an irrigation system, including automatic valves and controllers and various types of pumps and pumping systems.
  • Knowledge of Rainbird system preferred.
  • Knowledge of principles and practices of turf grass management and general horticulture.
  • Knowledge of pump station maintenance, operation, and repair.
  • Knowledge of tools, methods and materials used in grounds maintenance work.
  • Ability to operate irrigation pumps, sprayers and drip irrigation systems.
  • Knowledge of and ability to perform required role in emergency situations.

Your Essentials

Eligible to live and work in a remote location, in the Bahamas

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Description des tâches:
As a Wholesale Negotiator, you will secure, implement, and manage on an end-to-end basis wholesale discount agreements with partners and third-party Mobile Networks on behalf of Vodafone Markets. This role is a rare opportunity for a customer-obsessed commercial professional and/or Wholesale Negotiator within the Roaming industry to take this business to the next level.
As a Wholesale Negotiator, you will play an important part within Vodafone Roaming Services (VRS), based in Luxembourg. Commercial acumen, strong negotiation skills as well and the ability to establish or to already have a network in the roaming world are key selection criteria. Joining us as a Wholesale Negotiator, you can be part of our empowering global roaming function. You will:
Develop the wholesale strategy with a view to optimizing wholesale roaming cost and revenues
Prepare, lead and carry out negotiations with roaming partners in your own portfolio under strict deadlines
Co-define and implement a steering strategy, considering coverage, pricing and existing or future partnerships
Manage stakeholders – Internal, External, Partner Markets, Enterprise Units - to align strategies and build strong, productive relationships
Manage end-to-end the deal-making, implementation, and harvesting cycle of individual wholesale relationships by working closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and other stakeholders. Create long-term financial plans and budget

2+ years of experience in wholesale, commercial analytics, business analysis, or related telecommunications/commercial functions.
Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, with experience developing 100+ business cases, profitability assessments, forecasting, and revenue optimization recommendations.
Advanced data analysis and reporting capabilities, with the ability to analyze large datasets, identify trends, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable business insights.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience preparing reports and presentations for senior stakeholders, Directors, and Executive Committee audiences.
Strong commercial acumen, with experience supporting wholesale agreements, pricing validation, commercial performance analysis, and market opportunity assessments.
Stakeholder management experience, with the ability to collaborate effectively across commercial, finance, operational, and international teams.
Results-oriented mindset, demonstrated through revenue protection initiatives, fraud detection, process improvements, and operational efficiency gains.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into practical business recommendations and strategic actions.
Experience in budgeting, forecasting, and business performance management, supporting commercial planning and decision-making processes.
Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and data analytics tools; experience with SQL and business intelligence/reporting tools would be an advantage.
Ability to work effectively in multicultural and cross-functional environments, managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting.
Bachelor's degree in business administration, Management, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
Knowledge of wholesale telecommunications, roaming, commercial agreements, and market analysis would be highly desirable

Niveau d'étude demandé egal Bachelor (Bac +3)

Bachelor's degree in business administration, Management, Economics, Finance

About the FSTM:

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Department of Life Sciences and Medicine (DLSM) belongs to the Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine of the University of Luxembourg. We combine basic and translational, biomolecular and computational research to address critical questions in human health and disease with a main focus on cancer biology. We investigate mechanisms that govern tumor initiation, migration and invasion, metastasis, cell cycle control, the tumor microenvironment and drug resistance by using a combination of experimental in vitro, in vivo and in silico approaches. Next to its research mission, DLSM is coordinating all teaching programs in Life Sciences, Medicine, Nursing and Allied Health Professions.
Health and Medicine are a strategic priority of the University of Luxembourg and are presently in an ambitious phase of development. The department is therefore broadening its research focus to include cutting-edge trends in medical and biomedical sciences, extending beyond the field of cancer research. This strategic expansion requires additional expertise in teaching pharmacology across various fields, including Medicine, Life sciences, Nursing, and Allied Health Professions.

Your role:

The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine of the University of Luxembourg is looking for an Associate or Assistant Professor (depending on qualifications) in Pharmacology for its Department of Life Sciences and Medicine (DLSM).
The successful candidate will establish and lead an internationally recognized, independent pharmacological research programme in an area of biomedical relevance. The person will contribute to advancing the scientific profile of the institution through high-impact research, successful acquisition of competitive funding, and active interdisciplinary collaboration.
The candidate will additionally play a key role in shaping our educational mission by delivering high-quality teaching in pharmacology at the bachelor, master, and doctoral programmes, with a special focus on Medicine and Life Sciences.
In addition, the individual will mentor early-career researchers and contribute to academic leadership through strategic planning and team management.
Expertise in computational approaches - such as machine learning, artificial intelligence, or other data-driven methodologies - will be an asset.
This position is part of the University of Luxembourg's tenure-track scheme, which offers the assistant professor the possibility to obtain tenure and promotion to the rank of associate professor upon positive evaluation. The evaluation takes place within 48 months of appointment and covers the professor's performance with respect to the above-listed expectations.

Your profile:

• Candidates must have a solid record in their field of research (Pharmacology in an area of biomedical relevance)
• Candidates must have earned a Ph.D., postdoctoral training and management expertise in leading an independent research team
• Candidates must have experience in teaching molecular and cellular pharmacology, integrated pharmacology and/or clinical pharmacology and therapeutics
• Candidates must have experience in teaching in their wider fields of expertise ideally at all levels including bachelor, master, and doctoral degree with a special focus on Medicine or Life Sciences
• Candidates using computational tools (e.g., machine learning, artificial intelligence, or other approaches) are also encouraged to apply

Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer:

• Access to state-of-the-art facilities for imaging, in vivo studies, robotic drug screening, and bioinformatics
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities

All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

With more than 1,000 doctoral students among 7,500 students as well as 300 professors, the University is distinguished by its international and multilingual character, an interdisciplinary approach and a personalized learning environment.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance has over 2,700 students enrolled in four Bachelor's programmes, thirteen Master's programmes, doctoral studies and several continuing education courses. The Faculty is home to the Doctoral School of Law and the Doctoral School of Economics, Finance and Management. Teaching and research at the FDEF benefit from the proximity of European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre and its dynamic business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.
The Faculty of Law, Economics, and Finance of the University of Luxembourg is searching for an Associate Professor or an Assistant Professor (Tenure Track) in Procedural Law.

Regarding the teaching portfolio, the candidate will be expected to teach procedural law and civil procedure, as well as related subjects such as enforcement law or international litigation. The selected candidate will be expected to conduct high-level research, on the one hand, in Luxembourg civil procedure, and on the other hand, on more general issues that could lead to publications in leading international journals. As one of the university's strategic priorities is digital transformation, the selected candidate will be expected to conduct research on the impact of the digital revolution on civil procedure and judicial systems, where appropriate in collaboration with colleagues from the Faculty or the University.
The successful candidate will also be willing to work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders. The candidate is expected to be willing to seek external funding from various sources and to be ready to contact and actively engage with other research institutions and industry to establish research cooperations in Luxembourg and beyond.

jobs.title: AI Enablement & Automation Engineer (80-100%, f::m::d) - Remote (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
Remote AI Enablement & Automation Engineer (80-100%, f::m::d) Salary: 65000 - 75000 EUR per year. At OnlineDoctor AG we are looking for a Machine-Learning engineer! Our tech stack: AI, AI Agents, Cloud, Confluence, Support, JIRA, Security, SharePoint. Requirements: - Professional experience in software engineering, automation engineering, systems integration, internal tooling, or a comparable hands-on technical role.

- Proven experience independently designing, building, and maintaining software, integrations, or automation solutions used in day-to-day operations.
- Strong practical programming or scripting skills and experience working with APIs, webhooks, data sources, business systems, and automation or integration tools.
- Practical familiarity with generative AI, AI assistants, or AI-supported workflows. Deep machine-learning or AI research expertise is not required.
- Understanding of authentication, authorization, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and basic cloud-security practices.
- Ability to understand operational problems and translate them into pragmatic, reliable, and maintainable technical solutions.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.. Your responsibilities are: Process Automation & Solution Development
- Work closely with teams across the organization to understand workflows, identify bottlenecks, and uncover opportunities for process improvement and automation.
- Design and build internal automation and AI-enabled solutions, including assistants, agents, document workflows, extraction and classification, and knowledge search.
- Build and maintain integrations between AI services and systems such as SharePoint, Teams, Jira, Confluence, Zoho, and other internal tools using APIs, webhooks, scripting, and automation tools.

Solution Ownership & Operations

- Take ownership of solutions beyond the prototype stage, including testing, deployment, monitoring, documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
- Maintain and further develop existing automation and AI solutions across the organization.
- Establish reusable standards for integrations, access controls, testing, monitoring, error handling, documentation, and human review.

AI Enablement & Governance

- Support teams in evaluating automation and AI ideas, developing suitable solutions, and using approved tools effectively.
- Identify and prioritize internal automation and AI use cases based on value, feasibility, effort, data sensitivity, risk, and expected adoption.
- Work closely with IT, Security, Privacy, Quality Management, Regulatory, Legal, and other relevant experts to translate agreed requirements into practical technical controls.
- Work closely with the responsible compliance, security, privacy, quality, AI, and regulatory experts.
- Translate agreed requirements into effective technical solutions and operational controls.. Category: Machine-Learning Developer / Engineer Location address: Waisenhaustrasse 15, Munich, Germany. Salary: 65000 - 75000 EUR per year. OnlineDoctor AG - More about us and the role:Join OnlineDoctor: Were Expanding!

We are a fast-growing telemedicine company focused on improving access to dermatological care. Our platform uses technology to connect patients with dermatologists, enabling them to receive diagnoses and treatment plans remotely and asynchronously.

Were looking for an AI Enablement & Automation Engineer to help us improve and automate internal processes across OnlineDoctor. You will work closely with teams across the organization to understand their workflows, and identify opportunities for automation, turning them into reliable technical solutions.

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on solving real operational problems. You will build and maintain automations, integrations, internal tools, and AI-enabled workflows, while ensuring that solutions are reliable, maintainable, secure, and appropriate for a regulated healthcare environment.

You will work closely with the responsible compliance, security, privacy, quality, AI, and regulatory experts. You are not expected to make governance or regulatory decisions independently; your responsibility is to understand agreed requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions and operational controls.

What we offer:

- Flexibility: You decide if you want to work remote or if you prefer to visit one of our Offices (Hamburg, St. Gallen, Zürich). We offer you a flexible schedule and a working time model that suits you.
- Learning culture: We offer you a steep learning curve in your daily work and support you in your personal and professional development through regular retro and inspiration sessions as well as advanced training. We are open for ideas and impulses and help you with the implementation.
- Team events: Skiing in Switzerland, white water rafting in Vienna - we regularly get together with our entire team and thus increase our teamwork.
- Fair salary: An attractive salary is a matter of course for us.
- Additional benefits: Free choice of laptop, home office allowance, additional vacation day, etc.
- Our Values: Respect and tolerance are part of our DNA. We actively support diversity and inclusion, believing they are the keys to a successful and healthy company culture.

Work Location & Relocation:
Due to current legal and regulatory reasons, we can only hire team members who live in Germany or Switzerland. If youre based elsewhere but excited to join OnlineDoctor, were happy to discuss and support your relocation to either country.

Ready to Join Us?
If weve convinced you, get in touch to apply for this position. We look forward to meeting you soon!  last updated 35 week of 2026

jobs.title: Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based  is a senior leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across three global regions — Americas, EMEA, and APAC — serving approximately 17,000 software engineers worldwide. The Director is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, people leadership, and the ongoing transformation of the SD function.

Please send your CV in English.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic Leadership

- Define and execute the global Service Delivery strategy aligned with GES and GTI priorities.- Set the vision, operating model (Follow-the-Sun), and performance standards for SD across all three regions.- Lead the annual planning cycle for SD: headcount, budget, initiatives, and OKRs.- Represent the SD function at GES leadership reviews, executive briefings, and cross-functional forums.- Drive continuous improvement in service delivery maturity, tooling, and process standardization.

Operational Excellence

- Own the end-to-end SLO/SLA framework for the SD function globally; ensure targets are met and reported.- Partner with the Global Operations Excellence (GOE) team to enforce standards, monitoring, and governance.- Ensure all regions are aligned on tooling, processes, CMDB accuracy, and asset management practices.- Oversee the successful delivery of global programmes (e.g., PCD migration, device refresh, CMDB clean-up…etc).- Identify operational risks and blockers across regions; escalate and resolve proactively.

People Leadership

- Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization.- Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors.- Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function.- Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

- Serve as the primary SD point of contact for peer GTI functions.- Build and maintain strong relationships with key business stakeholders.- Collaborate with regional SD leads and managers to address customer escalations and service issues.- Provide regular operational reporting to the Senior Director, GES and GTI leadership.

Engineering Segments Engagement

- Own the customer relationship between GES and engineering segments globally; serve as the primary point of contact for segment leads regarding infrastructure, service quality, and engineering productivity.- Establish and maintain a regular engagement cadence with segment representatives to understand development pipeline needs, CI/CD tooling requirements, and environment pain points.- Proactively identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering experience — including build performance, environment stability, tooling access, and onboarding friction.- Collaborate with SD Leads, GOE, and Architecture & Standards teams to translate segment feedback into actionable service improvements and capacity planning inputs.- Track and report on segments satisfaction, developer productivity trends, and GES contribution to engineering velocity — escalate where GES environment is a constraint on delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Extensive relevant experience in infrastructure management, service delivery, or technology operations, with a significant portion of that time spent in senior leadership — managing global or multi-regional teams at scale.- Proven track record leading large, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries and regions.- Deep understanding of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and IT governance practices (COBIT or equivalent).- Strong experience managing budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation at a global scale.- Demonstrated ability to drive transformation programmes and change across complex organizations.- Experience operating in a matrixed, multinational corporate environment.- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable presenting to executive audiences.- Sound understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle management, and software asset inventory at enterprise scale.- Demonstrable knowledge of data center operations and management, including RDC/colocation environments, capacity planning, and infrastructure governance.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup/recovery frameworks.- Familiarity with vulnerability management processes, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination with information security teams to ensure compliance.- Familiarity with software development practices and the software development lifecycle (SDLC); ability to engage credibly with engineering and development teams on environment and tooling requirements.- Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and common pipeline patterns; exposure to CI/CD platforms, sufficient to understand engineering dependencies and environment requirements.- Understanding of developer workflow tooling and environment needs — including source control, build systems, artifact management, and test infrastructure — as they relate to GES infrastructure provisioning and support.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering, or large-scale enterprise Technology environments.- Hands-on or oversight experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack, or equivalent platforms).- Experience with high-performance or grid computing environments — including job scheduling, compute cluster management, and distributed compute platforms.- Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery.- Experience working with or transitioning to cloud-managed or hybrid infrastructure models.- Prior experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role — or significant direct collaboration with software development teams; comfort discussing CI/CD pipelines, build performance, and developer environment requirements.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required; Managing Professional or Strategic Leader tracks highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation or Practitioner — IT governance and control framework knowledge.- ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor — advantageous for security governance oversight.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Practitioner or PRINCE2 Agile.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This is a global role with flexibility on base location.
Regular international travel to regional sites and team face-to-face meetings is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Senior Director, Global Engineering Services (GES)
Direct reports: Regional SD Leads — Americas, EMEA, APAC
Functional scope: Full global SD organization

Why us?
A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we Work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.title: Külaliskorterite koristaja
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Dream Stay OÜ on pikaajalise kogemusega lühiajalise rendiga tegelev ettevõte, kelle hallata on üle 120 külaliskorteri Tallinnas.
Seoses suvise hooaja ja suurenenud töömahuga otsime oma meeskonda külaliskorterite koristajaid nii täis- kui osalise koormusega. Võimalik on töötada ka ainult nädalavahetustel (näiteks laupäevast esmaspäevani) — töö sobib hästi lisatööks või hooajaliseks tööks suveperioodil. Enamik külaliskortereid asub Tallinna vanalinnas ja kesklinnas või nende vahetus läheduses. Pakume tööd külaliskorterites. Palun arvestage, et kõik korterid – kokku umbes 120 – asuvad erinevates hoonetes. Autot tööks vaja ei ole — liikumine objektide vahel toimub ühistranspordiga ning see aeg on samuti tasustatud. Linna peal pesu vedama ei pea: puhta pesu toob kohale meie kuller. Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid on olemas apartementides või keldriruumides. Koristaja peab endaga kaasas kandma vaid meilt saadud lappe, kindaid ja mõned švammid. Töö sisaldab vahetusi nädalavahetustel ja pühade ajal — see on turismisektoris töötamise loomulik osa. Esmaspäevast reedeni töögraafikut kahjuks pakkuda ei ole võimalik ning väikeste lastega tööl viibimine ei ole lubatud.

Omalt poolt pakume: * Kaasaegseid töövahendeid
* Sõbralikku ning toetavat kollektiivi * Töötulemustele vastavat töötasu

Muud nõuded: Oled sobiv kandidaat, kui sul on olemas töötahe, armastad puhtust ja korrektsust ning oled võimeline töötama iseseisvalt.
Varasem töökogemus sarnasel ametikohal on väga hinnatud ja annab eelise. Oluline tingimus on nutitelefoni kasutamise oskus, kuna põhiline suhtlus ja töökorraldus toimub grupivestluses.

jobs.description:

Om jobbet

Kundens maskinpark omfatter alt fra gamle maskiner med relæstyring til nye produktionsanlæg med PLC, HMI og robotter. Du arbejder med alt fra fejlfinding på eksisterende anlæg til design og programmering af nye styringer – og både med el, mekanik og pneumatik. Du skal derfor trives med praktiske opgaver, hvor du indimellem får snavsede fingre. Vi forbereder løbende kundens produktionsanlæg med fokus på sikkerhed, driftsoptimering og betjening – og fungerer som kundens tætte rådgiver.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi forventer, at du er uddannet elektriker, tekniker eller lign. og har erfaring med eller flair for PLC-programmering; gerne Rockwell og Siemens. Du har den rette indstilling, bidrager positivt og tager ansvar for opgaven, indtil den er løst. Du hjælper dine kollegaer og holder den gode tone – og er derudover mødestabil.

Kjærgaard tilbyder dig

Du får en spændende stilling i en lille afdeling med ordnede forhold, kompetence kollegaer og gode muligheder for personlig udvikling i et selvstændigt og udfordrende miljø. Efter endt oplæring skal du deltage i vores vagtordning (ca. hver 8-10. uge). Du kommer til at arbejde i et uformelt miljø, hvor vi vægter samarbejde, kvalitet og faglig stolthed højt. Du får en central rolle i vores værksted og bliver en del af et stærkt hold.

  • et alsidigt job hvor du både arbejder med montage, service og tilpasning

  • frihed under ansvar og mulighed for selv at præge din hverdag

  • et fagligt stærkt miljø med gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone

  • en arbejdsplads hvor vi prioriterer trivsel og ordnede forhold

  • løn efter kvalifikationer

Du skal kunne identificere dig i overensstemmelse med vores værdisæt K7.

Ansøgning og CV

Vi arbejder på at besætte stillingen hurtigst muligt og tager ansøgere ind løbende. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte divisionschef Morten Winther Juhlin på mwj@kia.dk eller 4080 0020.

Send din ansøgning ved at klikke på “Søg stillingen”-knappen til højre. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.
